9d6fc9ca.title: Senior Consultant (SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC for FP&A)
9d6fc9ca.description:
cbs APAC is a leading international consultancy headquartered in Heidelberg, Germany. We deliver high-end quality consulting and technology services to large industrial corporations that run SAP. **For more information about our company, please visit our website at** **cbs APAC****.**

Ø **Job Title :** Financial Planning & Analytics (SAC + Group Reporting)

Ø **Employment Type :** Full-time

Ø **Experience Level :** Senior Solution Consultant

**Role Overview**

cbs is looking for an experienced Senior Consultant with strong expertise in **Financial Planning & Analytics (FP&A)** to support initiatives around **BDC, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and SAP Group Reporting.** The role focuses on helping clients design and implement end-to-end budgeting, planning, and financial analytics solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Advise clients on **FP&A** processes and best practices for **enterprise planning and budgeting.**
* Design and implement end-to-end budgeting, forecasting, and planning solutions using **SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).**
* Support financial consolidation and reporting scenarios using **SAP Group Reporting.**
* Facilitate workshops with business stakeholders to gather requirements and define planning models.
* Implement planning models aligned with financial structures
* Translate finance and controlling requirements into SAC planning and analytics solutions.
* Support integration of SAC with SAP S/4HANA and other relevant financial data sources.
* Contribute to solution architecture and ensure alignment with enterprise analytics strategies.
* Provide guidance during testing, deployment, and user adoption phases.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong experience in **Financial Planning & Analytics (FP&A),** including budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
* Hands-on experience with **SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Planning.**
* Experience with **SAP Group Reporting** for SAP & NON- SAP Entities
* Experience implementing end-to-end planning and budgeting solutions in SAP environments.
* Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA Finance and finance data models.
* Experience in client-facing consulting roles with strong stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on finance transformation or analytics initiatives.
* Knowledge of enterprise performance management and financial consolidation processes.
* Ability to conduct business workshops and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Experience into Project Management / Presales

**ME: This is you**

* An analytical and problem-solving consultant with the desire to develop your own skills and talents.
* An eloquent and extroverted person happy to support our pre-sales cycle.
* Passionate and determined while appreciating teamwork.
* Willing to take over responsibility and make decisions.
* Able to lead a small team, with strong social and communication skills.

**WE: That's us**

* A great team of passionate consultants.
* Strong personalities that are fair, open, and respectful to each other.
* Attractive and competitive salary and package.
* A company that continuously invests more than 6% of its revenue in the education of its employees.

Interested in sharing the ONE passion? We’d love to hear from you! Don’t hesitate to contact us by phone, email, or LinkedIn. We look forward to receiving your application documents, which should include your résumé (along with project descriptions), salary expectations, and references (if available). If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

**Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.**

#**FP&A, #SAC, #GroupReporting, #BI/BW**

dd61c3d2.title: Security Architect – Wiz.io / CSPM
dd61c3d2.description:
Job Title: Security Architect – CSPM / Wiz.io Experience: 10+ Years Location: Remote Project Duration: 3 Months Engagement Type: Contract Workload: Minimum 2 days per week, with the possibility of scaling up to full-time Job Overview We are seeking an experienced Security Architect with strong expertise in Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and hands-on experience with Wiz.io for a consulting engagement with a utility-sector client. The consultant will assess the client's cloud security posture, review existing technical documentation, validate AI-generated technical outputs, and develop a comprehensive security architecture and detailed implementation design for Wiz.io across Microsoft Azure and SAP environments. The ideal candidate must have strong architectural expertise, practical Wiz.io implementation experience, and the ability to translate technical requirements into actionable security solutions. Key Responsibilities - Review and assess existing project documentation related to CSPM, Wiz.io, and cloud security architecture. - Design and evaluate security architecture for implementing Wiz.io across cloud environments. - Assess cloud configurations, vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and security risks across Microsoft Azure and SAP environments. - Review, validate, and refine AI-generated technical outputs for accuracy and alignment with security best practices. - Refine AI prompts and provide technical context to improve AI-generated security recommendations. - Develop high-level security architecture and evaluation frameworks for assessing cloud security posture. - Conduct discovery activities to gather technical requirements, existing security controls, and integration dependencies. - Identify security gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities in existing cloud environments. - Prepare detailed Wiz.io implementation design documentation, including architecture, integration requirements, configuration considerations, and recommendations. - Collaborate with client stakeholders to validate requirements and align the proposed architecture with business and security objectives. - Support the transition from discovery and high-level design to detailed implementation design. Mandatory Skills & Qualifications - 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, cloud security, or security architecture. - Strong expertise in Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM). - Direct, hands-on experience designing and implementing Wiz.io solutions is mandatory. - Strong understanding of cloud security assessments, configuration management, vulnerability management, and cloud risk identification. - Experience assessing and securing Microsoft Azure environments. - Experience working with or assessing security configurations across SAP environments. - Ability to review technical documentation, evaluate existing architectures, identify security gaps, and develop detailed implementation designs. - Experience translating business and technical requirements into scalable cloud security architecture. - Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. - Ability to work independently in a consulting engagement with a flexible workload. - Availability to overlap with Australian business hours for at least four hours per working day. Good-to-Have Skills - Experience using AI tools for technical consulting, architecture documentation, or security assessments. - Knowledge of prompt engineering and techniques for improving AI-generated technical outputs. - Previous experience with utility, electricity, energy, or other critical infrastructure clients. - Experience delivering cloud security architecture consulting engagements for large enterprises. Engagement Details - Duration: 3 months. - Work Location: Fully remote. - Initial Phase: Part-time discovery, documentation review, requirements gathering, and high-level architecture design. - Workload: Minimum 2 days per week, with the possibility of increasing based on project requirements. - Final Phase: Approximately 1–2 weeks of full-time engagement may be required to complete the detailed implementation design. - Time Zone Requirement: Minimum 4 hours of overlap with Australian business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM Australian local time). Expected Deliverables 1. Assessment and review of existing CSPM and Wiz.io documentation. 2. Validation and refinement of AI-generated technical consulting outputs. 3. Cloud security architecture assessment and high-level design. 4. Documented client requirements, security gaps, risks, and integration dependencies. 5. Detailed Wiz.io implementation design document with architecture recommendations and technical considerations. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a senior Security Architect with proven, hands-on Wiz.io architecture and implementation experience, combined with strong CSPM expertise. The candidate should be comfortable working independently in a consulting environment, validating AI-assisted technical deliverables, and producing enterprise-grade cloud security architecture documentation. Important: Candidates must have direct Wiz.io architecture and implementation experience, along with relevant cloud security assessment expertise. General cybersecurity or Azure security experience without practical Wiz.io experience will not be sufficient. How to Apply Interested candidates can share their updated resumes highlighting relevant Wiz.io implementation, CSPM, Azure security architecture, and SAP security assessment experience. Contact Details: Email: sonia@achutha.com WhatsApp: 9025372346

Application Question(s):

* How many years of hands-on experience do you have designing and implementing Wiz.io (CSPM) solutions in enterprise cloud environments?
* Do you have hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and SAP security assessments, and can you work remotely with at least 4 hours of overlap with Australian business hours?

65e58211.title: Solution Architect, Public Sector India
65e58211.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

As the Solution Architect for Public Sector India, you'll be the technical lead for ServiceNow's entry into the Indian public sector. You'll turn government digitisation programs into solution blueprints, proof of concepts, and winning bids, with AI at the centre of the story.

**Purpose:**

Design and deliver AI-led architectures aligned with the India AI Mission & ministry priorities, proof of concepts, and tender responses that win public sector business in India and build trust with government technology leaders and SI partners.

**India Public Sector Context:**

* Who we serve: central ministries, state governments, PSUs, regulators, smart city and urban bodies, and digital public infrastructure programs.
* Where ServiceNow fits: citizen grievance and service delivery, case management, GRC, IT operations for large government estates, workflow over legacy systems, and AI-assisted operations.
* How deals happen: tender-led (RFP/RFQ, GeM), SI and partner-led bids, price-sensitive evaluation, long sales cycles.
* What shapes the design: data residency, MeitY-empanelled cloud, CERT-In and security audits, the DPDP Act, and Make in India preferences.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with Public Sector BD & Sales Leads for the GTM plan for Central and State Ministries, Public Sector Banks and Higher Education / Universities
* Lead architecture sessions with government CIO, IT, and NIC teams, translating program goals into actionable blueprints.
* Own the technical response on RFPs and tenders: compliance matrices, architecture, sizing, and clarifications.
* Build and run proof of concepts and demos across AI, workflow, and integration that prove value in days, not weeks.
* Design within government constraints: hosting, data localisation, security, AI governance, and integration with legacy and national platforms.
* Co-sell with SIs and partners on solution scope, bid strategy, and delivery handoff.
* Partner with Sales, Solution Consultants, Specialists, Product, and Legal on deal strategy and risk.
* Work with regional AI experts to shape and validate AI solutions and proof of concepts.
* Build reusable India public sector assets: reference architectures, AI use-case patterns, an RFP response library, and a compliance FAQ.
* Mentor Solution Consultants on public sector sales motions.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8-10 years of exclusive public sector pre-sales experience (government, PSU, or SI/OEM on government programs).
* Excellent communication: executive presence, storytelling, and strong written and verbal skills. Able to simplify complex architecture for non-technical decision makers and earn credibility with CIOs, senior officials, and SI architects.
* AI fundamentals (LLMs, agents, RAG, data readiness, responsible AI and governance), with the drive and capacity to reach expert level within 12-18 months.
* Proven track record on tenders and RFPs, with fluency in procurement and compliance requirements.
* Depth in enterprise workflow or ITSM platforms (ServiceNow preferred; fast ramp expected if not), plus integration, API, data, and automation architecture.
* Trusted advisor on deal strategy, not only demos.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, NCR (New Delhi), with regular travel to government offices.

**Good to Have:**

* Hands-on ServiceNow experience, including Now Assist and AI Agents.
* Familiarity with MeitY empanelment, GeM, CERT-In, the DPDP Act, and the IndiaAI Mission.
* Existing government and SI network.

**What We Offer:**

* A structured AI upskilling path to expert level over 6-12 months.
* Direct access to regional AI experts for design, proof of concepts, and deal support.
* Ground-floor ownership of a new vertical in India.

TR21

 **Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

60c3b12c.title: Pre-sales Engineer, Chemistry | Luma New
60c3b12c.description:
**Our Why At Dotmatics**

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

**We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.**

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

**Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics**

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

**We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.**

**What do we need**

Dotmatics is seeking a Field Application Scientist/Pre-Sales Engineer to deliver compelling technical messaging and product demonstrations in support of new business opportunities. In this role, you will work closely with customers, as well as Sales and Services teams, to understand customer use cases, workflows, and technical requirements. You will also support the planning and execution of Proof-of-Concept projects and evaluations, and contribute to the delivery of customer training in conjunction with these initiatives.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead end-to-end demo cycles, RFP responses, and technical customer engagements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and consultants, developing executive sponsors for Dotmatics and identifying opportunities to increase satisfaction and deepen long-term partnerships.
* Architect and design solution proposals and bids aligned to customer requirements and business outcomes.
* Support, attend, and lead internal and external meetings, discussions, and negotiations with stakeholders, consultants, and third-party vendors to drive preferred outcomes.
* Provide coaching and technical support to sales professionals and BDRs throughout the sales cycle.
* Partner with sales teams and customers to define technical requirements and advise on fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Ensure effective handover of proposed solutions to delivery teams and Customer Success Managers, potentially remaining engaged with customers as a trusted advisor for future opportunities.
* Maintain up-to-date technical expertise across the Dotmatics SaaS portfolio by participating in ongoing training provided by Commercial leadership and Development.
* Provide structured feedback and collaborate with Product Management to ensure the Dotmatics product portfolio continues to meet the evolving needs of customers and regional markets.

**We are looking for** **people who** hold an advanced degree in Chemistry or Biochemistry and have a minimum of 3-5 years experience in a customer facing role. You will be experienced in presenting solutions and utilising knowledge of Pre-sales best practice for software demonstrations. **In this role you should be willing to travel to customer sites up to 40%.**

The key skills we are looking for

* Extensive knowledge of antibody drug development and molecular biology
* Personal use of AI-driven work practices
* Working Knowledge of Scientific/informatics software
* Understanding of SaaS architecture, integrations and security
* SQL and Python in order to build prototypes of workflows and integrations to enable customer understanding the configuration extensions
* Experience with Dotmatics’ applications such as Snapgene, Geneious Prime and Biologics, and Prism
* Modeling scientific data, and crafting solutions, based on product knowledge and industry best practices
* Conduct & deliver needs analysis to understand scientific challenges, business needs, and critical requirements
* Working understanding of implementing, supporting, and/or integrating scientific systems

You may also demonstrate

* Additional language skills
* An understanding of the lifecycle of pharma, biopharma industries
* An understanding of Consumer Packaged Goods industry processes
* Written and oral communication & presentation skills for internal & external audiences

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

**Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.**

e628274a.title: Oracle Cloud PPM - Consultant, Functional Transformation
e628274a.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Enterprise Performance**
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
**Oracle cloud PPM - Consultant , Functional Transformation**
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
**Work You’ll Do**
As an Oracle Consultant, you will be involved in the implementation of Oracle Projects processes. Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Developing programs across all RICEFW components and process areas, ensuring high-quality deliverables in line with our CMMI-certified standards.
* Reviewing functional specifications, preparing technical documentation, translating requirements into efficient code, and performing thorough technical unit testing.
* Maintaining comprehensive documentation throughout the build phase and actively participating in review processes, including self and peer reviews.
* Collaborating with functional teams for issue resolution.
* Tracking timesheets accurately.
* Using project management tools as trained.
* Capturing minutes of meetings (MOM) during technical reviews.
* Demonstrating strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Working effectively within structured, process-driven environments.

**The Team**
Deloitte’s Oracle Enterprise Solutions practice provides services from ERP and Cloud Strategy, through Business Transformation and Applications Implementation, to Operate and Cloud Release Management. We modernize our client’s business and core environments to leverage technology innovations around Cloud, Digital, Mobility, and Social Collaboration. Our team helps clients address digital transformation by designing modern applications and industry-specific solutions to deliver outcomes that improve flexibility, scalability, and cost management.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 3 to 6 years of experience in the implementation of Oracle Projects processes.
* Well-versed with Oracle modules of Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Management, Project Contracts, Project Resource Management, Grants Accounting.
* Professional with at least 2 end-to-end implementations.
* Good working knowledge of modules interacting with Oracle projects like Payables, Fixed Assets, Receivables, Time & Labor.
* Demonstrated experience as a senior resource assisting in the definition of systems strategy, gathering and documenting business requirements, leading fit-gap analysis, as-is and to-be business process designs, conference room pilots (CRPs), functional configuration, testing, client user training.
* Experience in being a trusted advisor to the client in terms of providing solutions meeting the client requirement including process improvements.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
* Strong oral and written communication skills, including presentation skills (MS Visio, MS PowerPoint).
* A Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, or Accounting.

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Well-versed with Microsoft Project plan or equivalent.

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from an accredited university.

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

VCF Cloud Architect

**Experience:**
10–20 Years

VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF)

VMware Cloud Foundation consultant

**VCF Cloud Architect**
to design, implement, and manage enterprise private/hybrid cloud solutions using
**VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF)**

  .

**Role Description**
Cloud Architect, Codon Platform (AWS and Azure)
  
  
Location: UST Hyderabad
  
  
Type: Full time, in-house
  
  
**About The Role**
Codon is UST's governed developer platform: a web chat and a browser terminal that put Claude to work on ServiceNow and other enterprise platforms, with every write
  
  
audited, every secret brokered, and every destination controlled at the network edge. It runs today on AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, EFS, internal ALB with blue/green
  
  
deployments, a Squid egress tier) with Azure for identity (Entra) and Key Vault, reached over a transit gateway, SD-WAN and Zscaler.
  
  
We are hiring the person who owns this architecture end to end and takes it from a single-tenant dev and pilot footprint to a secure, multi-tenant, resilient product. You
  
  
will be the technical authority for infrastructure, the counterpart to our network, security, identity and AI gateway teams, and the hands that write the Terraform.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Architecture and roadmap
  
  

* Own the target architecture for Codon across AWS and Azure: landing zone, account and subscription structure, network, identity, data, secrets, observability.
* Design and deliver multi-tenancy: tenant isolation at the account, network, data and identity layers; per-tenant cost attribution; tenant onboarding as code.
* Design and deliver disaster recovery and business continuity: RPO and RTO targets per tier, cross-region strategy, backup and restore drills, runbooks that are

rehearsed, not written once.
  
  

* Define the environment model (dev, test, pilot, production) and the promotion path between them, including the deployment gate that holds a release until its checks

Security
  
  

* Raise the platform to a documented security posture: least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secret rotation with zero downtime (we already rotate database and gateway

keys), private endpoints, egress allow-listing, encryption and key management (KMS and Key Vault).
  
  

* Run threat modelling for the platform's trust boundaries, including an AI agent with a shell inside a container, and close the findings.
* Prepare the platform for internal security review and for customer audits (SOC 2 style evidence, logging and retention, access reviews).

Build and operate
  
  

* Write and review the Terraform (modules, environment roots, policy as code). Everything is code; nothing is clicked in a console.
* Own the CI/CD and release tooling with the product team: image builds, SBOMs, the deployer, evidence capture.
* Set up observability that answers questions in minutes: central logging, metrics, tracing, ing, cost dashboards.
* Lead incident analysis across teams. Recent examples from our own log: a rotated database password that silently broke new connections, an egress path that drops for

hours on a shared security gateway, a load balancer whose private addresses changed under a fixed route.
  
  
Work with others
  
  

* Be the single technical contact for UST's Network, Cloud, Security, Identity and AI gateway teams; turn their constraints into designs and their requests into tickets

with evidence.
  
  

* Pair with the product engineers daily. Review their infrastructure changes, teach them the platform's rules, and keep the design records current.
* Guide one or two platform engineers as the team grows.

What you bring
  
  
**Experience**

* 12 to 14 years in software or infrastructure engineering, of which at least 10 years hands-on in public cloud, with production ownership on both AWS and Azure. Depth on

one, real delivery on the other.
  
  

* You have designed and operated at least one multi-tenant SaaS platform and at least one cross-region DR setup, and you can describe what broke in each.
* You have written Terraform for years, not months. You can read a plan and tell what will be replaced and why.

Technical
  
  

* AWS: VPC design, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, ECS or EKS, RDS, EFS, ALB and NLB, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, Route 53, Organizations and SCPs.
* Azure: Entra ID (enterprise apps, SAML and OIDC, conditional access), Key Vault with private endpoints, VNets and Private Link, Azure Policy, hybrid connectivity.
* Networking: routing across cloud and on-premises, SD-WAN and security gateways such as Zscaler, TLS and certificate lifecycle, DNS split-horizon.
* Security: zero trust principles, workload identity, secret rotation, container hardening, audit logging, compliance evidence.
* Containers and delivery: Docker, Fargate or Kubernetes, blue/green and canary deployments, GitHub Actions or equivalent, SBOM and vulnerability management.
* Comfortable reading application code (TypeScript or Python) well enough to find where an infrastructure assumption lives.

Ways of working
  
  

* You write things down: decision records, runbooks, incident reports with evidence. You prefer a diagram and a table to a meeting.
* You test in production-like conditions and rehearse failures before they happen.
* You are direct with other teams about what is theirs and what is ours, with the logs to show it.

Certifications (any two, or equivalent demonstrated experience)
  
  

* AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional
* Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* A security credential such as AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or CCSP

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience hosting LLM or agent workloads: gateways, key brokering, cost metering per user, isolation of agent sandboxes.
* Enterprise platform background: ServiceNow, Salesforce or SAP integration patterns.
* FinOps practice: cost allocation by tenant, rightsizing, commitment planning.
* Exposure to regulated environments and customer audits.

First six months, what success looks like
  
  

* A written target architecture for multi-tenant Codon on AWS and Azure, reviewed with Security and Network, with a sequenced plan.
* Production environment stood up as code with the deployment gate, logging, ing and cost reporting in place.
* A DR design with targets agreed, and the first restore drill completed and documented.
* The current security findings closed, secret rotation proven without downtime, and an audit evidence pack that a reviewer can read.
* Standing working agreements with the Network, Identity and AI gateway teams, with named contacts and response expectations.

**Skills**
AWS, Azure Policy, AWS Transit Gateway, AWS Fargate

7214940e.title: Senior Azure Cloud Platform Engineer
7214940e.description:
**Description**
Senior Azure Cloud Platform Engineer
  
  
Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Leadership & Strategic Guidance: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to cross-functional teams (cloud engineers, data engineers, business stakeholders) to architect robust Azure-based data solutions. Ensure alignment of cloud solutions with business objectives, considering current and future growth. Stay updated with the latest Azure innovations, trends, and best practices to recommend the best solutions for complex business needs.
* Azure Data Lake and Database Solutions: Design and deploy scalable and high-performance Azure Data Lake storage solutions to handle large volumes of unstructured and structured data. Architect, configure, and manage Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, and other database offerings to ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and optimized performance.
* Databricks Administration & Integration: Manage, configure, and administer Azure Databricks environments, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and security of data processing workloads. Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and analysts to integrate Azure Databricks with other Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse) to build scalable data processing and analytics solutions. Implement best practices for managing Databricks clusters, notebooks, libraries, and jobs to ensure efficiency and cost optimization. Perform regular monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning of Databricks workloads, ensuring high reliability and uptime.
* Cloud Migration Strategy & Execution: Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for migrating on-premises data and applications to Azure with minimal disruption to business operations. Use Azure-native tools (e.g., Azure Migrate, Data Migration Assistant) to facilitate seamless migration of data assets to the cloud.
* Azure Data Factory (ADF) Expertise: Design, implement, and maintain efficient data pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) to orchestrate and automate workflows across various sources and destinations. Optimize pipeline performance, manage dependencies, and ensure seamless data movement across hybrid cloud environments.
* Database Services Optimization: Administer and optimize Azure Database offerings such as Azure SQL Database, SQL Managed Instances, and other relational/non-relational databases. Design high-availability, fault-tolerant architectures, and ensure efficient data replication, backup, and recovery.
* Performance Tuning & Optimization: Identify and address performance bottlenecks within Azure-based data solutions, applying performance tuning strategies to maximize system efficiency. Ensure that systems are optimized for cost efficiency, scalability, and reliability by monitoring usage patterns and implementing proactive optimization strategies.
* Security & Compliance: Implement strong security measures across Azure data solutions to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data. Leverage Azure's security features, including encryption, role-based access control (RBAC), firewalls, and auditing tools to meet compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2). Conduct regular security assessments and work with teams to enforce security best practices across all cloud solutions.
* Collaboration & Communication: Engage with stakeholders from business units, IT, and data engineering to understand business requirements, design appropriate solutions, and ensure smooth project delivery. Present project updates, technical challenges, and solutions to executive leadership and other stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment with organizational goals. Facilitate collaborative decision-making and knowledge sharing among cross-functional teams to achieve optimal solutions.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Lead the design and implementation of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using tools like Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, Terraform, or Azure Bicep to automate infrastructure provisioning and management. Ensure that IaC practices are embedded in the development lifecycle for consistent, repeatable, and scalable cloud deployments.

**Qualifications**
**Experience:**
6+ years in cloud architecture, with at least 4 years focused on Azure cloud solutions and architecture design.
  
  
**Technical Skills:**

* Expertise in Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and related Azure data services
* Strong proficiency in Azure Data Factory (ADF) for data pipeline orchestration and ETL process design
* Databricks administration and optimization experience, including cluster management, job execution, and integration with Azure services
* Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform, ARM templates, or Azure Bicep
* Familiarity with Azure Databricks and other advanced data processing services
* Deep understanding of cloud security best practices, including access control, data encryption, and compliance standards
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools

**Soft Skills:**

* Leadership experience, with a track record of successfully driving technical initiatives to completion

**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com
  
  
**Additional Information**
Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
  
  
**Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Azure Lead Cloud Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of Azure-based cloud solutions, with a focus on data mesh solutions, infrastructure automation, and migration. The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in cloud architecture, especially in building Infrastructure as Code (IaC), designing scalable Azure Data Lake and database solutions, and driving migration strategies. As a technical leader, you will guide cross-functional teams to ensure that our cloud architecture aligns with business goals, follows best practices, and optimizes performance, security, and compliance.

08270ede.title: Service Delivery Manager
08270ede.description:
**About Rackspace Cyber Defence**
Rackspace Cyber Defence is our next generation cyber defence and security operations capability that builds on 20+ years of securing customer environments to deliver proactive, risk-based, threat-informed and intelligence driven security services.
  
  
**Our purpose**
is to enable our customers to defend against the evolving threat landscape across on-premises, private cloud, public cloud and multi-cloud workloads.
  
  
**Our goal**
is to go beyond traditional security controls to deliver cloud-native, DevOps-centric and fully integrated 24x7x365 cyber defence capabilities that deliver a
**proactive**
,
**threat-informed**
,
**risk-based**
,
**intelligence-driven**
approach to detecting and responding to threats.
  
  
**Our Mission Is To Help Our Customers**

* Proactively detect and respond to cyber-attacks – 24x7x365.
* Defend against new and emerging risks that impact their business.
* Reduce their attack surface across private cloud, hybrid cloud, public cloud, and multi-cloud environments.
* Reduce their exposure to risks that impact their identity and brand.
* Develop operational resilience.
* Maintain compliance with legal, regulatory and compliance obligations.

**What We’re Looking For**
To support our continued success and deliver a Fanatical Experience™ to our customers, Rackspace Cyber Defence is looking for an India-based Security Delivery Manager.
  
  
This role is particularly well-suited to a self-starting, experienced and motivated Security Delivery Manager, who is commercially-aware, service-oriented and has a proven record of accomplishment in service delivery management, service management and/or customer success.
  
  
The Security Delivery Manager will be the face of Rackspace’s security services, delivering excellent customer service for our customers. Core delivery areas will include service delivery management, operational governance, contractual management, and financial performance.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Service Delivery Management

+ Oversight of customer onboarding and service transition.
+ Own the customer relationship and act as the customer’s key contact for your assigned customers.
+ Act as a service escalation point for internal and external teams (e.g. during major incidents.)
+ Prepare and deliver Monthly Security Service Reviews (MSSRs)
+ Serve as the operational interlock between customers and Rackspace delivery team(s).
+ Collaborate with wider account team(s) to deliver strategic initiatives.
+ Provide on-call services to customers (if applicable)
+ Proactively engage customers and identify opportunities for continual service improvement (CSI)
+ Build strong relationships with assigned customers and understand their business challenges.
+ Identify and drive opportunities to grow assigned accounts, in collaboration with the wider account team(s)
+ Solicit customer feedback ,testimonials, case studies and references to support both Customer Success and continuous improvement initiatives.
+ Willing to work in flexible working hours.

* Operational Governance

+ Regular engagement with internal service providers
+ Managing the performance of internal teams
+ Driving customer outcomes through service delivery teams
+ Assist in the development of policies and standards with specific regard to service design, service transition, service management and continuous service improvement.
+ Maintain service documentation to ensure business visibility of service processes.

* Contractual Management

+ Be the subject matter experts for your customers’ security contracts.
+ Ensuring new requirements are captured and contractually incorporated.
+ Ensure the required teams are engaged for key contractual milestones e.g renewals.

* Financial Performance

+ Monitor and manage the financial performance for your assigned customers contracts.
+ Forecast financial performance throughout the life of the service.
+ Highlight key commercial levers that may affect financial performance to key internal stakeholders.
+ Where possible, identify and deliver financial performance enhancing measures.

**Skills & Experience**

* Should have 5+ years’ experience in service delivery management, service management and/or customer success; ideally within a managed security services (MSSP) environment.
* Experience in monitoring and improving service performance.
* Managing key stakeholders both internal and external, understanding expected outcomes
* Experience of working with public cloud environments such as Azure, AWS and Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience of common service management standards such as ITIL or ISO 20000; as well as service transition.
* Knowledge of common project management practices such as Prince II, Agile and SCRUM; ideally in a DevOps-centric environment.
* Knowledge of security standards (good practice) such as NIST, ISO27001, CIS (Center for Internet Security), OWASP and Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) etc
* Ideally, you will have experience delivering managed security services such as Attack Surface Management, Managed Detection & Response, Managed Extended Detection & Response and/or Defensive Security Services.
* A highly self-motivated and proactive individual who wants to learn and grow and has an attention to detail.
* Highly organised and detail oriented. Ability to prioritise, multitask and work under pressure.
* An individual who shows a willingness to go above and beyond in delighting the customer.
* A good communicator who can explain security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**About Rackspace Technology**
Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. We support customers in more than 120 countries with AI capabilities spanning private cloud, public cloud, applications, data and cyber resilience.
  
  
**More on Rackspace Technology**
Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. We welcome you to apply today and want you to know that we are committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender reassignment or identity or expression, genetic information, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, military or veteran status, nationality, ethnic or national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any legally protected characteristic. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.  

**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**

Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.

**Inclusivity and Diversity**

WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.

**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**

Join our close-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.

**With us, you can.**  
**Apply today.**

Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. 6fca7520.title: Delivery Manager
6fca7520.description:
**Delivery Manager**

Client Delivery & Operations • Digital Marketing

**Purpose of the Role**

Ensemble delivers digital marketing and AI services to a growing base of clinical and healthcare clients. The Delivery Manager owns the system that keeps that growth running smoothly — making on-time, on-scope delivery the standard across every account by owning intake, planning, capacity, cadence, and quality end to end.

This is a dedicated operations role focused on one outcome: consistent, reliable delivery. It is the foundation that lets clients trust us with more work and lets the team do its best work without friction.

**Reporting**

**Reports to:**
COO / Managing Director

**Works with:**
Account leads, the offshore (India) delivery team, and specialists across SEO, Paid Ads, Creative, Video, Web Development, Content, and AI.

**Core Responsibilities**
**1. Own on-time delivery across all accounts**

•  Hold end-to-end accountability for every client deliverable shipping on time and to standard.

•  Maintain one live view of all work in flight — status, owner, due date, and risk — so nothing stays invisible until it is already late.

**2. Plan capacity and resources**

•  Forecast team capacity against committed work and flag over-allocation
**before**
it causes slippage.

•  Balance workload across the offshore team and specialists; reassign to clear bottlenecks.

•  Translate client commitments into realistic timelines the team can actually hit — push back when they can’t.

**3. Control intake, priorities, and scope**

•  Run a disciplined intake process — no work starts without a clear scope, owner, and deadline.

•  Set and communicate priorities across accounts; resolve conflicts between competing client demands.

•  Catch scope creep early and escalate the trade-off rather than silently absorbing it into the timeline.

**4. Run the delivery cadence**

•  Lead a recurring delivery rhythm (daily standup + weekly account review) that surfaces risk early.

•  Coordinate across time zones so the offshore team stays unblocked and handoffs don’t stall overnight.

•  Track dependencies and escalations and drive them to resolution.

**5. Enforce quality**

•  Review deliverables before they reach the client — nothing ships below standard.

•  For healthcare and clinical clients, ensure work meets compliance expectations (HIPAA-aware handling, compliant tracking and reporting).

•  Reduce rework by catching issues internally, not at the client.

**6. Report to clients and leadership**

•  Give clients clear, consistent status updates — progress, what’s next, and any risks to the timeline.

•  Give leadership an honest, data-backed view of delivery health and where it is at risk.

**7. Build the delivery system**

•  Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, and workflows so delivery is predictable, not heroic.

•  Continuously remove recurring blockers and improve throughput without simply adding headcount.

•  Mentor coordinators and the offshore team toward accountability and ownership.

**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)**

Delivery health is measured, reviewed monthly, and owned by this role:

**Metric Target**

1. On-time delivery rate ≥ 95% of deliverables shipped by the committed date
2. Rework rate < 10% of deliverables needing rework after internal review
3. Client-reported quality issues Trending down quarter over quarter
4. Team utilization 75–85% (productive, not overloaded or idle)
5. SLA / turnaround compliance ≥ 95% of requests handled within agreed timeframes
6. Delivery visibility 100% of active work tracked in one live source of truth
7. Escalation handling Risks flagged and resolved before the deadline, not after

**Qualifications**

•  Minimum 5+ years in project or delivery management, ideally in a digital or creative agency.

•  Proven track record improving or scaling on-time delivery across multiple concurrent accounts.

•  Working knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social, creative and video production, web development, content, and analytics — enough to judge quality and timelines, and to execute hands-on, if essential.

•  Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams across time zones.

•  Familiarity with healthcare or clinical client requirements (HIPAA awareness) is a strong plus.

•  Strong on process design, prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management.

**Ideal Candidate**

An operations leader who makes delivery boringly predictable. Organized, calm under competing deadlines, hands-on and relentless about removing blockers and building the systems that let good quality work ship on time — every account, every time.

**CTC:**
As per market for the right fit candidate

660dad0b.title: Delivery Manager
660dad0b.description:

With nearly 3,000 experts across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Americas, we partner with iconic businesses like Tesco, Coca-Cola, Meijer, Procter & Gamble and Metro to turn data into growth, innovation and measurable value for their customers.

dunnhumby’s Technology and Engineering team builds the platforms, pipelines and systems that make customer data science possible at scale. From the data infrastructure that ingests billions of transactions to the APIs and cloud architecture that power our products, we engineer reliable, high-performance software trusted by the world’s leading retailers and brands.

6b9fa692.title: Sr Program Manager, Tech - Program Management (Tech)
6b9fa692.description:
**About the Role**  
  
You will report to the Head of Global IT Support & IT Supply Chain and own the operational maturity of our global IT Service Desk. The role carries direct accountability for the roadmap behind cross-functional programs that change how we support 30,000+ employees across 300+ offices.
  
  
Day to day, you will run our shift-left and AI-first programs: growing virtual-agent deflection, merging Tier 2 and application operations into a single administration team, and restructuring vendor contracts around automation and reliability outcomes instead of headcount. You will set SLA standards, lead executive-level escalations, and make the calls on where to invest engineering effort versus vendor capacity.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the regional IT Service Delivery roadmap. Use operational data to find systemic gaps and design strategies that keep support capacity ahead of business growth.
* Run the shift-left and AI-first program: grow virtual-agent ticket deflection past 200K per year, consolidate Tier 2 and application operations into one team, and bring Tier 3 into IT Ops so escalations stay under one roof.
* Set and enforce SLA, QA, and vendor-governance standards across managed service providers. Restructure vendor compensation so it rewards deflection, auto-resolution, mean time to resolve, and quality-not headcount.
* Act as the final escalation point for high-stakes technical incidents. Coordinate rapid response across engineering, security, and business technology teams, and own crisis communication to executives.
* Run a portfolio of global initiatives (office launches, M&A integrations, major tool rollouts). Manage dependencies, critical paths, and resource constraints across parallel workstreams.

* 8+ years in IT program management or IT operations leadership, with direct experience managing global or multi-regional service delivery teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with AI-driven service transformation: virtual-agent deflection, automated ticket resolution, or self-service portal rollouts.

**Competency**

Spots organizational disconnects early and moves to fix them without being asked. Junior PgMs treat this person as a reliable source of ground truth.

Deep, working expertise in IT service delivery, ITSM, AI-driven support, and vendor management. Uses that knowledge to find gaps and push improvements before they become urgent.

Gets things done through others without positional authority. Pulls diverse viewpoints together into a clear recommendation and moves the group to act.

Grows the team's capacity by recruiting, building reusable tools and automation, and improving processes in ways that make the whole organization faster.

**The role**
As a senior technical program manager (STPM), you'll lead our most complex, cross-team and cross-geography programs, such as cloud cost optimization, platform migrations, and large multi-team launches. You'll turn ambiguity into clear plans, keep every team aligned on what matters, and give senior leadership an honest, current view of progress, risks, and trade-offs.
  
  
You'll also be the bridge between executive leadership and engineering. You'll translate business priorities into engineering plans, and translate technical reality into decisions leaders can act on. You won't manage the engineers, but you'll earn their trust and drive results through influence.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* **Lead complex programs end to end.**
  Own programs that span multiple engineering, product, data, and finance teams across time zones, from scoping and planning through launch and post-launch review.
* **Coordinate product and engineering roadmaps.**
  Align product and engineering roadmaps across teams and regions. Reconcile priorities, capacity, and dependencies, keep one integrated view of what ships when, and flag trade-offs early so leadership can make informed calls.
* **Drive cost and efficiency initiatives.**
  Partner with engineering and finance to analyze cloud and infrastructure spend, identify savings, set targets, and track delivery against them.
* **Keep leadership informed.**
  Run regular program reviews and steering committees. Write concise executive updates covering status, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions needed, and business impact.
* **Bridge executives and engineering.**
  Translate strategy and customer priorities into technical roadmaps and milestones, and explain technical constraints and trade-offs in plain business terms.
* **Manage dependencies and risk.**
  Surface cross-team dependencies early, own the critical path, escalate with clear options and recommendations, and keep the plan honest.
* **Define and track metrics.**
  Set KPIs, SLAs, and success criteria for each program, and report results with data that leaders can trust.
* **Build repeatable ways of working.**
  Improve planning, intake, prioritization, and delivery processes across engineering. Standardize the practices that work.
* **Raise the bar.**
  Mentor program managers and engineering leads, and share best practices across the organization.

**What you'll bring**

* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering management, or a closely related role, including 5+ years leading cross-functional programs with software engineering teams.
* A track record of delivering large, multi-team programs across geographies, with measurable outcomes in scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
* Strong technical depth. You can discuss architecture, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and CI/CD with engineers and spot risk before it becomes a delay.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You've presented to VP and C-level audiences and can turn complex detail into a clear story and a clear ask.
* Experience leading cost reduction or efficiency programs, including cloud spend (FinOps), vendor contracts, or resource optimization.
* Proven ability to influence without authority, resolve conflict, and make decisions with incomplete information.
* Comfort with program tooling (Jira, Confluence, or similar) and with building dashboards and reports from engineering and financial data.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Background as a software engineer or technical lead.
* Experience at a SaaS, ecommerce, or data and AI company operating at scale.
* Experience with generative AI or agentic AI product development.

**How we'll measure success**

* Programs deliver on agreed scope, timeline, and budget, with risks raised early.
* Cost and efficiency targets are met and tracked transparently.
* Leadership has a current, accurate view of program status and the decisions needed.

**Why CommerceIQ**
You'll work on programs that shape how leading brands win in ecommerce, with direct access to senior leadership and real influence on how engineering operates. We put customers first, communicate clearly, and value people who take ownership.

39d081e9.title: Product & Program Manager - Hardware
39d081e9.description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

**Kryon Technology Pvt. Ltd. (iLabs Group) is building India’s next-generation integrated electronics manufacturing platform for PCBA and motor controllers. Our portfolio spans AC indoor/outdoor controllers, BLDC motor controllers, remotes, IoT gateways, routers, STBs and networking devices. We are setting up a high-speed SMT + assembly facility in Sri City supported by a strong design & sourcing ecosystem. As a fast-scaling 0→1 organization, we are looking for hands-on leaders who can build systems, teams and capabilities from scratch in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.**

We are looking for a Hardware Product and Program Manager to own our product portfolio, customer-facing product strategy and end-to-end program delivery at our Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) company. You will bridge customers, engineering, supply chain and manufacturing: turning customer requirements into manufacturable, cost-competitive products, and delivering each product and customer program on scope, cost and schedule from concept to volume production. Where applicable, you will also manage our own-design (ODM) offerings.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy and Portfolio

•        Define product roadmap and positioning for ODM/own-brand products and value-added service offerings (design, testing, box build, aftermarket).

•        Track market trends, technologies and competitors in target segments such as automotive, industrial, consumer, medical and IoT.

•        Identify new product and service opportunities that make better use of our manufacturing capabilities.

Customer Requirements and Engagement

•        Gather and translate customer requirements into clear product specifications, BOM targets and acceptance criteria.

•        Support RFQ/RFP responses with technical inputs, feasibility assessment and costing in coordination with sales and engineering.

•        Be the technical and product point of contact for key customers through the development and ramp phases.

Program Management

•        Own end-to-end delivery of assigned customer and ODM programs, from kick-off to volume production, against agreed scope, cost, quality and timeline.

•        Build and maintain integrated program plans covering design, NPI, procurement, tooling, test development, certification and production readiness, with clear milestones, owners and dependencies.

•        Run program governance: weekly cross-functional reviews, stage-gate reviews (EVT, DVT, PVT, MP release) and customer program reviews, with documented actions and closure tracking.

•        Plan and coordinate resources across design, firmware, test, quality, procurement and the factory, resolving conflicts across programs.

•        Maintain a risk and issue register with owners, mitigation plans and escalation to management when needed.

•        Manage program budget and cost tracking, including NRE, tooling, prototype and certification costs, and report variances against plan.

•        Control scope and changes through a formal change-control process, assessing impact on cost, schedule and quality before approval.

•        Give management and customers regular status reports with milestone status, slippages, risks and recovery plans.

•        Manage multiple programs at once, prioritizing against capacity and business value.

•        Conduct post-program reviews and capture lessons learned to improve the NPI and program process.

Product Development and NPI

•        Manage products through the lifecycle: concept, EVT, DVT, PVT and mass production.

•        Work with design, firmware, test and quality teams to meet performance, cost and timeline targets.

•        Ensure Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Test (DFT) and Design for Cost (DFC) reviews are done before release.

•        Coordinate smooth handover from NPI to volume production.

Cost, Supply Chain and Manufacturing Alignment

•        Own product cost structure, including BOM cost, yield, cycle time and margin targets.

•        Work with procurement on component selection, alternates, long-lead items and supplier qualification.

•        Work with the factory on line capability, test strategy and capacity planning.

Compliance and Quality

•        Ensure products meet applicable standards and certifications (BIS, CE, FCC, RoHS, UL, IPC, ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 13485, as relevant).

•        Manage ECO/ECN process and product change impact on cost, quality and delivery.

Lifecycle Management

•        Monitor product performance, field returns and customer feedback.

•        Manage component obsolescence, end-of-life planning and product revisions.

Required Qualifications

•        B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics or a related field (MBA is a plus).

•        5 to 8 years of experience in hardware product management, NPI or program management, preferably in an EMS, ODM or electronics manufacturing environment.

•        Hands-on experience taking at least one hardware product from concept through mass production.

•        Proven experience managing hardware programs end to end, including planning, stage-gate governance, risk management, budget tracking and customer reporting.

•        Strong understanding of PCBA, SMT/THT processes, box build, testing (ICT, FCT) and the NPI process.

•        Good knowledge of BOM management, costing and component sourcing.

•        Experience working with customers on requirements, quotations and technical reviews.

•        Familiarity with PLM/ERP systems and project tools (MS Project, Jira or similar).

Preferred Qualifications

•        Experience in one or more domains: automotive electronics, industrial controls, medical devices, consumer electronics, IoT or power electronics.

•        Program management certification such as PMP, PgMP or PRINCE2.

•        Knowledge of quality tools such as FMEA, APQP, PPAP and Six Sigma.

•        Understanding of embedded systems and firmware development cycles.

•        Exposure to global supply chains and import/export compliance.

Skills and Competencies

•        Customer-focused, with strong commercial and technical judgment.

•        Ability to balance cost, quality and schedule trade-offs.

•        Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

•        Cross-functional leadership without direct authority.

•        Structured, data-driven decision making.

•        Strong planning, risk management and follow-through discipline.

•        Ability to manage multiple customers, products and programs simultaneously.

What We Offer

•        Opportunity to shape product strategy and program delivery in a growing EMS business.

•        Exposure to diverse products and industries.

•        [Compensation, benefits, growth opportunities]

* Up to 50% travel across the region.

**What We’re Seeking**

* Exceptional executive-level communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to engage C-suite stakeholders, boards, and senior leadership, translating complex business insights and technical detail into business impact, ROI, and actionable strategy across strategic planning documents, proposals, and business cases.
* Experience in credit and/or fraud risk management, with a proven track record of achieving meaningful loss reduction and/or customer experience improvements, complemented by sales experience as a vendor and demonstrated project leadership and results orientation.
* Comprehensive understanding of the risk management lifecycle across the entire customer journey, with senior-level expertise across multiple credit and fraud risk domains including originations, transactional/payment fraud, online/mobile banking fraud, application fraud, first party fraud, customer management, and collections.
* Extensive experience working with payment processors, payment gateways, payment networks, issuers, and acquirers, including authorization flows, real-time decisioning, and processor, gateway, and network-specific operating models.
* End-user knowledge of credit and fraud risk management solutions, authorization systems, authentication solutions, loan origination systems, and other decision management platforms.

**Our Offer to You**

* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
  
  
FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
  
  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
  
  
Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
  
  
FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.
