bd2d412a.title: IAM Solution Architect - Saviynt
bd2d412a.description:
**Role Overview:**

We are hiring a seasoned IAM Technical Architect to own the end-to-end technical solution on the Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud (EIC) platform and to lead a team of IAM Consultants and Senior IAM Consultants delivering Saviynt engagements out of India. Beyond deep, hands-on Saviynt platform mastery, this role requires strong Java engineering ability to extend the platform, hands-on command of the Saviynt Terraform provider to run identity configuration as code, and a working command of Saviynt's AI-powered Intelligence Suite so you can advise clients on where AI fits their IGA roadmap. You will be the final technical authority for your engagements and the primary technical mentor for your consulting team.

**Role & Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage a team of IAM Consultants and Senior IAM Consultants across Saviynt engagements - assigning work, reviewing configurations and connector code, and owning the technical quality of the team's deliverables.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point and final design authority for Saviynt EIC solutions.
* Architect and design end-to-end IGA solutions on the Saviynt EIC platform, aligned to enterprise security standards and business requirements.
* Produce solution architecture artifacts - HLD, LLD, integration designs, data flow diagrams - and define technical standards, patterns, and best practices for the team.
* Lead application onboarding onto Saviynt, including provisioning/de-provisioning, access request, and certification setup for target systems.
* Design and configure Joiner - Mover - Leaver (JML) lifecycle workflows, birthright access, and automated provisioning rules.
* Implement Access Request System (ARS), Access Certification / Access Reviews, Segregation of Duties (SoD), and preventive/detective controls.
* Design and govern RBAC models, including role mining, role engineering, entitlement management, and role lifecycle.
* Architect and develop custom connectors and platform extensions in **Java** - using Saviynt's connector framework/SDK and REST-Java based connectors - and extend workflows/rules using Java, Groovy, and JavaScript where out-of-the-box capability falls short.
* Build and configure connectors to target systems (Active Directory, Azure AD / Entra ID, Workday, SAP, ServiceNow, databases, REST/SOAP APIs, SCIM, LDAP).
* Configure Saviynt workflows, rules engine, analytics, control center, request forms, SAV roles, and email templates.
* Define and own the organization's Infrastructure-as-Code strategy for Saviynt using the **Saviynt Terraform provider** - designing reusable Terraform modules for security systems, endpoints, connections, enterprise roles/entitlements, and job control resources, and establishing CI/CD, state management, and environment-promotion practices (dev/stage/prod).
* Evaluate and advise clients on adopting Saviynt's **AI-powered Intelligence Suite** - Access/Identity Intelligence recommendations, ISPM for human and non-human identities/AI agents, and the Integration & Onboarding Agent - aligning adoption with client risk and compliance goals.
* Lead performance tuning, troubleshooting, and remediation of the Saviynt platform and integrations.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to Consultants and Senior Consultants; review code and configuration for quality and security.
* Partner with security, compliance, audit, and business stakeholders to support regulatory requirements (SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, etc.) and audit evidence.
* Support upgrade, migration, and platform modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy IGA tools to Saviynt.
* Define and drive the IAM/IGA roadmap, contributing to Zero Trust and least-privilege strategies.

  

**Skills:**

* 8 - 12 years of overall IT experience with a strong focus on IAM/IGA, including proven experience leading and mentoring a team of consultants (2+ years in a technical lead/architect capacity).
* 6+ years of hands-on Saviynt experience, including architecture, design, and implementation on the EIC platform.
* Deep expertise across Saviynt modules: Access Request, Access Certification, SoD, Role Management, application onboarding, connectors, workflows, rules, and analytics.
* Strong hands-on **Java development experience** - core Java, Java-based custom connectors, Saviynt's connector SDK, and Groovy scripting - to build and extend Saviynt integrations beyond out-of-the-box capability.
* Proven hands-on experience with the **Saviynt Terraform provider** - designing and maintaining Terraform resources (security systems, endpoints, connections/connectors, enterprise roles, entitlements, job control, transport packages) to manage Saviynt configuration as code across environments; strong general Terraform/HCL and CI/CD (Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps) skills.
* Solid working knowledge of Saviynt's **AI-driven Intelligence Suite** - Access/Identity Intelligence recommendations, ISPM for human and non-human/AI-agent identities, and the Integration & Onboarding Agent - with the ability to advise clients on adoption roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of core IAM/IGA concepts: identity lifecycle, provisioning/de-provisioning, RBAC/ABAC, entitlement management, access governance, and least-privilege.
* Experience integrating Saviynt with directory services and enterprise applications - AD, Azure AD/Entra ID, Workday, SAP, ServiceNow, and custom apps via APIs.
* Working knowledge of authentication and federation protocols: SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos.
* Familiarity with SSO, MFA, and PAM ecosystems, and how IGA integrates with them.
* Solid grasp of security frameworks and compliance (SOX, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST).
* Proven experience leading solution design, documentation, and technical delivery in complex enterprise environments.

1d609551.title: AI/Solution Architect
1d609551.company: National e-Governance Division (NeGD), Digital India Corporation
1d609551.location: Noida, New Delhi, Delhi / NCR, India
1d609551.description:
**Role Summary**

  

The AI/Solution Architect will be the design authority for AI services built by in-house teams and empanelled agencies, defining the reference architecture and ensuring that components built once are reused across government departments. The role requires depth across LLM, retrieval, speech, vision and agentic systems, sound judgement on hosting and model choices under sovereign-AI requirements, and the authority to approve or reject designs before build and at go-live.

  

**Educational Qualification**

  

* B.Tech./B.E., M.Tech./M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Information Technology, AI/ML, Electronics or a related discipline
* Advanced degree or published work on large-scale ML or distributed systems is highly desirable
* Certifications are not mandatory; architectures the candidate has designed, as listed under Minimum Evidence at Screening, shall carry greater weight
* Candidates from non-traditional backgrounds with strong verifiable work will be considered in lieu of formal qualification

  

**Experience**

  

* 10+ years in software engineering and architecture (12+ years preferred); **minimum 5 years designing AI/ML systems deployed in production**
* **Demonstrable experience as lead architect of at least one LLM, retrieval or agentic system serving end users**, with documented design decisions and production metrics
* Experience designing shared platforms or services reused by several products, business units or clients
* Experience with both self-hosted open-weight models on GPUs and managed cloud AI services, including cost and latency trade-offs between them
* Experience integrating AI services with identity, document and workflow systems at scale
* Experience in regulated sectors or with systems serving crores of users is a plus

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Reference Architecture & Design Authority**

  

* Define and maintain the programme's reference architecture, covering document intake, OCR and extraction, retrieval, speech, identity verification, agents, the AI gateway, evaluation and guardrails
* Review and approve solution designs from every in-house and agency team before build, and sign off architecture conformance at go-live
* Maintain architecture decision records and reference implementations that teams can adopt directly

  

**Model & Hosting Strategy**

  

* Set open-weight and Indian sovereign models hosted on IndiaAI GPU compute as the default, and define when approved third-party model APIs may be used
* Ensure every service reaches models through the AI gateway, so that providers can be switched by configuration without code change
* Size GPU, storage and API budgets for each service against latency, throughput and cost targets

  

**Integration with Government Systems**

  

* Design integration with Digital India platforms, government identity and single sign-on services, e-office and payment systems, and departmental databases
* Define standard API contracts, identity and access patterns, event flows and data-exchange formats for AI services

  

**Reuse & Portfolio Architecture**

  

* Maintain the register of reusable AI services, and decide which team builds a shared component when several projects need it
* Prevent duplicate builds across teams and agency contracts, and plan the migration of existing services onto shared components

  

**Security, Privacy & Responsible AI by Design**

  

* Embed DPDPA 2023, CERT-In directions, MeitY security guidelines, audit logging and data residency in every design
* Work with the AI Safety and Security teams on threat models, guardrails, retrieval provenance and agent permissions

  

**Technical Leadership & Procurement Support**

  

* Run architecture reviews, mentor pod leads and engineers, and resolve cross-team technical disputes
* Contribute architecture requirements to NeGD RFQs and RDRs, and evaluate agency proposals and deliverables for architectural soundness

  

**Technical Competencies**

  

* **AI Systems:** LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation with hybrid search and re-ranking, agents and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), speech and vision pipelines, document AI
* **Model Serving & Inference:** vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM or NVIDIA Triton Inference Server; NVIDIA Dynamo or llm-d for distributed inference; quantisation, continuous batching and prefix caching; GPU capacity planning
* **AI Gateways & Providers:** LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway or Envoy AI Gateway; OpenAI-compatible APIs; at least one of AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry or Google Vertex AI; Indian providers (Sarvam, Bhashini)
* **Architecture Patterns:** microservices, event-driven and domain-driven design, multi-tenancy, API management, caching and asynchronous processing
* **Platforms & Data:** Kubernetes and Helm, Terraform, Kafka or equivalent; PostgreSQL with pgvector, object storage, vector databases (Qdrant, Milvus or Weaviate)
* **Identity & Integration:** OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, Keycloak or equivalent; REST with OpenAPI, GraphQL, WebSockets and server-sent events
* **Evaluation & Observability:** release gates built on golden datasets; Langfuse or Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana
* **Security & Governance:** OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, zero-trust networking, secrets management, software supply-chain security (SBOMs, signed artefacts, pinned dependencies); DPDPA 2023, CERT-In directions, MeitY Responsible AI advisory, IndiaAI Safe & Trusted AI framework
* **Communication:** architecture documents and diagrams that engineers can build from and executives can decide on

e70a6131.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
e70a6131.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
  
  
**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
  
  
Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

A day in the life
  
  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

**About The Team**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. **Description**
**The Role:**
As a Solution Architect, you will lead the architecture and solution design of large-scale technology initiatives spanning multiple systems across the OTT platform ecosystem. You will be responsible for translating business and product requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable technical solutions that align with the organization's strategic objectives. Our culture is highly delivery-focused, and the role extends well beyond producing architecture diagrams and design documentation. You will work closely with product, engineering, program management, operations, and external partners throughout the delivery lifecycle, providing hands-on architectural guidance, resolving technical challenges, managing design trade-offs, and ensuring successful implementation of solutions through to production release.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture and solution design of strategic initiatives across the OTT platform ecosystem, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technology strategy.
* Drive architectural evolution by assessing existing systems, identifying improvement opportunities, and challenging established assumptions and technical constraints, including the pragmatic application of AI-enabled tools and capabilities where they deliver measurable value.
* Own solution delivery from concept through implementation, providing technical leadership, resolving complex challenges, and ensuring successful outcomes.
* Design scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable solutions, defining both functional and non-functional requirements and producing key architectural artifacts, including requirements for responsible AI use, data privacy, security, observability, and governance where AI capabilities are involved.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, delivery, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions adhere to architectural principles, standards, and best practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies, and gaps, and drive continuous quality improvement.
* Support engineering teams throughout delivery with architectural guidance, governance, and decision-making for complex technical issues; promote effective and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering and delivery practices.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends, and OTT best practices, and relevant AI capabilities to enhance platform capabilities, engineering efficiency, and long-term architectural sustainability.

**Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**
**You’ll be set up for success if you have:**

* 10+ years' experience as a Solution Architect or similar role, designing and delivering large-scale technology solutions in complex environments.
* Deep understanding of OTT platform architectures and domains, including subscriptions, monetisation, identity and access management (IAM), content and metadata management, and related platform services.
* Proven experience designing and delivering scalable, distributed systems using Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) principles.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures and services, preferably AWS.
* Strong solution design expertise, including integration and management of third-party vendor solutions and in-house platforms.
* **AI fluency:**
  Practical understanding of generative AI, machine learning and AI-enabled platform capabilities.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve architecture, analysis, documentation, engineering productivity, and problem solving, while validating outputs and retaining appropriate technical judgement.
* Ability to assess AI use cases, dependencies, risks and non-functional requirements.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, with hands-on experience in technologies such as Node.js, Java, Python, or Go, and strong knowledge of database technologies. Proven ability to solve complex business and technology challenges, navigate ambiguity, and drive effective technical outcomes.
* Experience analysing and optimising business processes, operating models, and technology landscapes.
* Strong documentation skills and experience applying industry-standard architecture and design methodologies.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

**Even better if you have:**

* Experience designing and implementing Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions.
* Experience integrating payment providers, subscription billing platforms, and related monetisation services. Experience working with external vendors and partners, including content security, authentication, authorisation, and platform protection.
* Experience designing event-driven integrations, data pipelines, and asynchronous workflows using messaging and streaming technologies.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments, including Scrum, backlog refinement, and technical planning.

d12a33cb.description:
**Delivery Lead – Revenue Growth Management (RGM) / Commercial Analytics**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **Role Overview**

The Delivery Lead – RGM / Commercial Analytics will own end-to-end delivery of Revenue Growth Management programs for global CPG and Retail clients. This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, advanced analytics, and execution excellence, with accountability for pricing, promotion, assortment, trade investment, and net revenue management use cases.

The individual will be responsible for translating ambiguous commercial questions into scalable RGM analytics solutions, ensuring high quality delivery, measurable business impact, and strong senior stakeholder confidence. The role is also expected to contribute to practice building, account growth, and capability maturation within RGM.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. RGM Program & Delivery Ownership**

Own end-to-end delivery of multi-workstream RGM and Commercial Analytics programs, spanning:

* Pricing & Price-Pack Architecture
* Promotion Effectiveness & Optimization
* Trade Spend & Investment Governance
* Assortment & Portfolio Optimization
* Net Revenue, Margin, and Mix Analytics

**Responsibilities:**

* Ensure delivery rigor across multiple clients, balancing priorities, timelines, and value realization.
* Partner closely with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Product teams to ensure RGM solutions are scalable, repeatable, and production ready.

### **2. Commercial Problem Translation & Solution Design**

* Translate ambiguous commercial and revenue challenges into structured RGM analytics problem statements.
* Design RGM analytics frameworks aligned to client decision cycles (who decides, when, and how).
* Ensure solutions are actionable, not just analytical, clearly linking insights to pricing actions, promo levers, and margin outcomes.
* Strong understanding of how pricing, promo, and assortment decisions are made in market.

### **3. Senior Stakeholder & Client Leadership**

Build credibility with senior commercial, finance, and category leaders through:

* Strong business context
* Clear storytelling of RGM insights
* Consistent delivery quality

**Responsibilities:**

* Act as a trusted RGM advisor, not just a delivery manager.
* Lead governance forums, value reviews, and roadmap discussions for RGM initiatives.

### **4. Team Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor, and grow RGM analytics teams (10–20 members) across analysts, consultants, and leads.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and capability uplift in RGM-specific skills.
* Embed best practices in RGM analytics delivery, documentation, and quality assurance.

### **5. Quality, Scale & Value Realization**

Ensure high quality, scalable deliverables aligned to commercial KPIs such as:

* Net Revenue Growth
* Price Realization
* Promo ROI
* Trade Efficiency
* Margin Improvement

**Responsibilities:**

* Track value realization, not just output delivery.
* Drive standardization and reusability of RGM assets, models, and dashboards.

### **6. Practice & Account Growth**

Support account expansion and conversion to sales through:

* Identifying new RGM opportunities
* Shaping solution approaches and proposals
* Contribute to RGM practice building frameworks, accelerators, POVs, and case studies

**Experience & Qualifications**
-------------------------------

### **Must-Have**

* 12 ± 1 years of overall experience, with 8+ years in analytics delivery.
* Strong experience delivering RGM / Commercial Analytics for CPG or Retail clients.
* Proven track record of managing multi-client, multi-workstream delivery programs.
* Ability to engage with business and technical stakeholders and connect analytics to commercial decisions.
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to derive insights that influence RGM outcomes.

**Technical & Analytics Skills**
--------------------------------

* Solid understanding of commercial data models (pricing, promo, trade, mix & assortment).
* Working knowledge of cloud and data platforms: Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS.
* Familiarity with data quality, governance, and access controls in enterprise RGM setups.
* Strong hands-on experience with BI & visualization tools: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik.

**Domain Expertise (Highly Preferred)**
---------------------------------------

Deep exposure to CPG / Retail commercial domains, including:

* Pricing & Promo Mechanics
* Trade Terms and Investment Structures
* Category and Channel Dynamics (Modern Trade, GT, eCommerce)

Additional Preference:

* Experience working with global or regional RGM teams is a strong plus.

**Success Metrics (KPIs)**
--------------------------

* Delivery Quality & Timeliness
* Business Impact & Value Realization (RGM Outcomes)
* Client Trust & Stakeholder Satisfaction
* Team Capability & Retention
* Contribution to Sales & Practice Growth

**Note:**

*By submitting your application, you consent to being contacted by our Talent Acquisition team via phone call, email, SMS, WhatsApp, or other communication channels regarding your application and relevant career opportunities.*

ef53e858.title: Security Architect
ef53e858.description:
**WirelessCar’s Journey**

WirelessCar drives the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and developing cutting-edge digital services. We help leading brands—like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover—innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!

**We are looking for** Security Architect with 15+ years’ experience to help us build secure, resilient and trusted connected services by making security an integral part of architecture and delivery.

As a Security Architect, you will help define, evolve and govern the security architecture of our digital services throughout their lifecycle - from early business and design decisions through implementation and continuous evolution.

You will work closely with development teams, solution architects, product stakeholders and cybersecurity colleagues to translate security requirements, risks and regulatory obligations into practical, scalable and cost-effective architectural decisions.

**Your Impact**

* Define and maintain security architecture for assigned systems, solutions and deliveries.
* Ensure security architecture aligns with WirelessCar security strategy, policies, standards, architectural principles and risk appetite.
* Translate security requirements, risks and relevant regulatory obligations into concrete architecture patterns, controls and design decisions. Communicate security decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Review and approve security-relevant architecture designs and changes within your assigned scope.
* Embed security-by-design and privacy-by-design throughout the system and solution lifecycle.
* Guide Solution Architects, Software Engineers, Product Owners and delivery stakeholders in secure architecture decisions.
* Lead or contribute to threat modelling, security risk assessments, architecture reviews and design validation activities.
* Identify, prioritize and escalate architecture risks and deviations, and coordinate practical remediation actions.
* Monitor emerging threats, technologies and architecture patterns relevant to WirelessCar products, platforms and the automotive industry.
* Initiate and lead proof-of-concepts and evaluations of new security technologies and architecture approaches.
* Contribute actively to a culture of continuous learning, shared standards and secure engineering.
* Work closely with customer stakeholders and manage their expectations and collaborate with solution architect, delivery manager in achieving the goals.

**We believe that you bring**  
You are a technically experienced and pragmatic security professional who can move comfortably between the bigger system perspective and important implementation details.

You enjoy solving complex problems together with others and can influence technical direction without relying on formal authority. You can balance risk, cost, complexity and delivery needs, explain why a security decision makes sense, listen to different perspectives and help teams reach a good solution.

You also enjoy coaching and supporting engineers and architects, and you see security architecture as something developed together with delivery teams - not something created separately and handed over for implementation.

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience in security architecture, system architecture or cybersecurity roles across cloud-based, distributed or platform-oriented environments.
* An understanding of security and compliance frameworks relevant to the role, such as UNECE R155 ISO/SAE27001; TISAX & ISO27001 etc.
* Experience communicating technical security concepts, decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working collaboratively across engineering, architecture, product, governance, risk, compliance and operations teams in complex development environments.
* Experience securing AWS and/or Azure cloud-native environments, including containers, Kubernetes, APIs, identity, network and data protection patterns.

  
**How You Work**

* You act with ownership, integrity and curiosity, balancing business enablement with robust security design.
* You take accountability for your architecture scope and make clear, risk-based decisions within established governance.

**Practical Information**

* Work Location: Bangalore,India.
* Standard working hours, with collaboration across globally distributed teams.
* Occasional travel may be required depending on delivery and customer needs.

At WirelessCar we believe in a Hybrid Remote work setup

**To join our journey**  
WirelessCar is always on the move, often into uncharted land. We are curious, believe in collaboration and are always open to new ideas on how we can make a difference. When you join our journey, you will be part of a great crew of highly competent and warm hearted people from all over the world.

* Our company language is English so please write your application in English.

87ffc366.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Engagement Manager to lead and deliver complex, multi-workstream cloud transformation programs for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India. In this role, you will own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of large and complex customer engagements, shaping cloud strategies, driving business outcomes, and acting as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders.
  
  
The ideal candidate is an experienced program leader with deep IT consulting expertise, a proven track record in delivering complex technical programs across enterprise customers, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with limited guidance. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on incredibly high standards, and are passionate about mentoring others and scaling delivery best practices across teams.
  
  
You will lead matrixed teams of AWS consultants, partners, and customer resources across multiple workstreams simultaneously. You are expected to drive delivery excellence, maximize engagement value, manage risks proactively, and serve as a force multiplier for your peers and the broader organization. You will actively contribute to pre-sales, build deep customer trust, and leverage AI/GenAI to drive delivery innovation.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Engagement Management Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-workstream cloud transformation programs, ensuring business outcomes are achieved within schedule, scope, and financial constraints.
* Shape and validate cloud delivery strategies for complex engagements, applying frameworks such as the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well-Architected Framework (WAF), and Engagement Delivery Framework (EDF).
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, driving alignment, and building deep trusted relationships.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance

5693740e.description:
**Description**
Sales, Marketing and Global Services (SMGS)
  
  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As a Customer Solution Manager you will work with the largest and most complex enterprises in the world, to enable their multi-year journey to the cloud. In this new, highly visible, role you will ensure that all AWS teams work together effectively and efficiently to deliver migration, modernization and GenAI outcomes for the customer in relation to Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be a trusted advisor to the customer. You will leverage your complex program management, technical, organizational, and transformation expertise to understand customer's business and strategic goals, translate them into an executable plan, and drive the implementation to success by working with the customer, AWS, and our partners. You will understand your customers' biggest IT challenges and provide prescriptive guidance, based on AWS best practices, to guide them through their migration and modernization journey to AWS at scale.
  
  
You will take end-to-end ownership of multiple migration, modernization and GenAI projects within a single enterprise or across several enterprises, utilizing your communication skills to interface with and influence a broad range of multi-disciplinary teams (Business development, solutions architecture, support, product, professional services, and partners). The Customer Solution Manager role is responsible for cloud migration and modernization programs (incl. technical, operational, organizational, and education) that span across traditional IT teams and business units.
  
  
Engaging from the inception stage onwards, you will have a deep understanding of your customer's business vision, culture, and processes, you will be your customer's voice within AWS, ensuring that their needs are accurately communicated to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams. Engaging during the latter stages of the business cycle you will be responsible for ensuring consistent best-practices are applied, including: (1) ensuring Migration Readiness Assessment (MRA) is conducted and bringing in SMEs to deliver the migration foundations (e.g. landing zone build, security controls, operating model, training etc.), (2) Migration kick off workshops are conducted (including stakeholder alignment), and (3) Executive Steering Committees and reporting are established, including customer, partner, and AWS Cloud exec sponsors and ensure mechanisms are in place to identify and mitigate any identified risks. You should be passionate about delivering a great customer experience by delivering successful IT transformation programs. You will ensure that the customer IT and business stakeholders are aligned, to ensure broad adoption of the migration and modernization across the customer organization. You will use AWS mechanisms to inform the customer migration journey. Where required, you will lead the interaction with specialist teams, ProServ and Partners for handoffs, especially with respect to migreation, modernization and GenAI implementation.
  
  
In addition to your customer facing responsibilities, you will help shape the rapidly growing Customer Solution Management function, where your passion to define and implement standard processes, methodologies, and tools will be highly valued. Principal Technical Program ManagerMastercard Networks Exchange is an intelligent and scalable offering that enables transaction originators and receivers to link to different

multiple networks. As a trusted connectivity partner, Mastercard Networks Exchange presents a unified approach to help customers achieve economics of scale.
  
NEX is on a transformational modernization journey, building a next-generation platform that is highly scalable, resilient, and configurable to meet the evolving needs of our growing customer base. This modern foundation will enable faster innovation, improved reliability, and greater operational efficiency as we continue to expand our capabilities.

Drives execution of an outcome from inception through successful delivery of the services or domains, or an outcome that spans multiple teams and integrations across the enterprise
  
  
Works with multiple scrum/delivery teams to build/improve ways of working and identify and mitigate risks or issues that may impact the plan

Clearly articulate scope, timelines, dependencies, owners, actions, risks, and mitigations. Report progress to teams and senior leadership in regular cadence, potentially representing segments of or the entire program

Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program, or domain with depth to be credible and influential with teams they work with  
  
  
  
All about you  
  
  
  
  
Experience operating autonomously across multiple teams, demonstrated critical thinking, and thought leadership
  
  
Experience in building large scale enterprise technical or engineering programs and products from inception to delivery and experience articulating the impact using metrics.
  
  
Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)

Expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, huge plus if you have expertise in CI/CD, SQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model are a plus
  
  
Technical program delivery experience
  
  
Self-motivated, intellectually curious, and ownership-driven leader who proactively identifies opportunities, challenges assumptions, and drives outcomes end-to-end. c09873a2.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all-remote R&D PMO team, you will own complex, end-to-end programs that are central to our AI-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment.
  
  
**Some Examples Of Our Projects**

* Leading the GitLab Duo Agent Platform from GA through enterprise adoption, including customer onboarding, support models, and billing integration for AI-driven capabilities
* Delivering data-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities
* Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base
* Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry-leading DevSecOps standards

**What You Will Do**

* Lead end-to-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs
* Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates
* Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact
* Partner with customer success and cross-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows
* Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation

**What You Will Bring**

* Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption
* Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity within extreme ambiguity
* Strong background in SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps technology companies, with ability to quickly master the GitLab platform and AI/ML initiatives
* Proven experience influencing and driving impact at a division and company-wide scale, affecting market position and revenue
* Excellence in cross-functional leadership, with experience partnering with engineering, product, security teams and engaging effectively with senior and C-level stakeholders
* Outstanding communication skills, including asynchronous collaboration, executive reporting, and the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business impact
* Track record of success in fast-paced, dynamic environments with evolving technical requirements and market opportunities
* Strong facilitation and influence skills, with ability to drive consensus across diverse stakeholder groups while building trust through transparency and delivery excellence
* Expertise in high-level stakeholder management, including masterful communication with Executive Boards and enterprise Customers
* Collaborative leadership style aligned with GitLab's values, including respect, openness to feedback, and commitment to team success
* Proven track record of redefining organizational operations and serving as an escalation point to resolve highly complex, enterprise-level challenges
* Welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds, including those with consulting, enterprise technology, or technical leadership experience who have owned outcomes and delivered transformational initiatives
* Ability to act as a visionary leader, shaping R&D direction and fostering technical excellence across the organization

**About the team:**
The Technical Program Management team sits within GitLab's R&D Program Management Office and drives product, engineering, data, and security initiatives across our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You will join our growing, distributed team of Technical Program Managers currently spanning North America and Europe. We own the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional programs including AI platform capabilities, enterprise customer initiatives, and strategic technology transformations. As an all-remote team, we excel at asynchronous communication to coordinate across time zones while partnering closely with executive leaders and stakeholders to deliver business-critical outcomes.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups

GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Content Commerce is a new and high-impact initiative at the intersection of content, advertising and commerce. The vision is to make content shoppable. Users should be able to discover products naturally while watching shows, movies, sports, or short-form content - and move from inspiration to purchase with minimal friction. This team will build the platform that powers commerce experiences across JioHotstar content surfaces. That includes product discovery, contextual recommendations, shoppable placements, brand integrations, storefront experiences, measurement, and partner integrations with commerce platforms.
  
  
****Key responsibilities****

* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and collaboration
* Lead large, complex technical programs from planning through delivery independently
* Influence roadmap priorities by aligning stakeholders on objectives and outcomes
* Coordinate across engineering, product, and business teams to manage dependencies and ensure timely execution
* Facilitate cross-pod collaboration and alignment to maintain delivery momentum
* Proactively plan for and mitigate risks, evaluating alternatives, quantifying trade-offs, and structuring communication plans
* Apply Agile methodologies for iterative delivery, adaptive planning, and continuous improvement
* Coach teams on Agile best practices and foster high Scrum maturity
* Maintain sprint cadence and rigor through reviews, retrospectives, and OKR alignment
* Drive pod-level accountability for JIRA hygiene, analytics reporting, and milestone tracking

* Act as a mentor for junior TPMs and team members to scale program management maturity

* Highly structured thinker with the ability to break down ambiguous goals into executable plans, identify blind spots, and push for clarity in both direction and detail
* Strong grasp of risk/reward tradeoffs, and comfort operating in fast-moving, high-stakes environments with shifting priorities and evolving context
* Exceptional communicator, skilled in managing stakeholder expectations and aligning diverse teams on shared timelines, goals, and impact

* Strong experience leading complex cross-functional programs involving AI/ML and GenAI systems at scale.

* A Bachelor's/Master’s degree with a minimum of 8-10 years of experience, including 3 to 4 years in a Program Management role within the consumer technology sector

Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. bba08e45.description:
**About Team**
US Omni Tech at Walmart Global Tech, Bengaluru, is focused on improving Walmart customer experience across both physical & digital and make Walmart the most exciting place to shop. With 4000+ brick and mortar stores and thousands of other suppliers fulfilling Walmart's online/in-store orders for over 1 billion customers - the challenge and complexity is pronounced! We work within the world’s largest retailer yet maintain a start up feel working in small agile teams to revolutionize the fulfilment landscape. As a leader in the supply chain group, you are accountable and responsible for number of critical products/platforms that helps serve our customers in the most cost-effective manner in multiple geographies and businesses.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Your main responsibilities will revolve around managing large software development projects.
  
  
You will work closely with architects and engineering leaders to ensure the successful completion of these projects. To do this, you will need to have a deep understanding of software architecture and contribute to architectural decision-making processes.
  
  
You will also need to build strong relationships with stakeholders across Walmart, ensuring alignment on roles, responsibilities, and project cadences.
  
  
Your role will involve defining goals, stage gates, critical delivery paths, and key deliverables for large-scale programs that incorporate multiple programs with dependencies across multiple areas of work, timelines, and resource constraints.
  
  
Efficient engineering resource utilization and delivery will be a priority, and you will need to simplify and clarify priorities and create plans with appropriate milestones for advance planning and executive buy-in.
  
  
You will also establish a resource capacity allocation process and tool to transform the planning process.
  
  
Your problem-solving and decision-making skills will be crucial in navigating any setbacks or obstacles that may arise.
  
  
Overall, as a seasoned professional, your expertise and passion for driving technical projects to success will be invaluable in this role at Walmart Global Tech.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
A bachelor’s degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent.
  
  
Overall around 18+years of technical experience with 10+ years of leadership experience as a Technical Program Manager in software delivery within a related industry managing aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
  
  
Strong leadership skills, with the ability to effectively manage and motivate a team of technical program managers and engineers.
  
  
Experience supporting and executing a large software portfolio, collaborating with multiple business stakeholders.
  
  
Experienced in system/platform design concepts, architecture, technical design, services, APIs, and technologies.
  
  
Build positive relationships and collaborate with product managers to understand target personas and business process needs, which you will then translate into features and user stories that engineers will leverage to iterate products quickly.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex problems.
  
  
Expertise in change & risk management methodologies, project management tools, techniques, project tracking tools, dashboards, and reports
  
  
Strong communicator in both verbal and written forms and are equally adept in communicating upwards, outwards, and downward.
  
  
Deep understanding of JIRA, JIRA Align, Big Picture, Airtable etc.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

b3e2945c.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Principal Technical Program Manager
  
  
Mastercard Networks Exchange is an intelligent and scalable offering that enables transaction originators and receivers to link to different
  
  
networks in the end-to-end transaction flow with just a single connection.
  
  
This one connection to global and regional payment rails reduces the cost and complications of managing individual connections to
  
  
multiple networks. As a trusted connectivity partner, Mastercard Networks Exchange presents a unified approach to help customers achieve economics of scale.
  
  
NEX is on a transformational modernization journey, building a next-generation platform that is highly scalable, resilient, and configurable to meet the evolving needs of our growing customer base. This modern foundation will enable faster innovation, improved reliability, and greater operational efficiency as we continue to expand our capabilities.
  
  
**About The Role**
Drives execution of an outcome from inception through successful delivery of the services or domains, or an outcome that spans multiple teams and integrations across the enterprise
  
  
Works with multiple scrum/delivery teams to build/improve ways of working and identify and mitigate risks or issues that may impact the plan
  
  
Conducts meaningful retrospectives, creates action plans to implement changes at the team level; coordinates with other TPMs in the program to align and plan potential actions to be implemented across the program
  
  
Looks across the program to identify potential system efficiencies or process improvements, and suggests proactive strategies for consideration by program leadership
  
  
Clearly articulate scope, timelines, dependencies, owners, actions, risks, and mitigations. Report progress to teams and senior leadership in regular cadence, potentially representing segments of or the entire program
  
  
Looked to as first point of contact for your teams or business line/service and the source of truth for status, providing the correct information and associated data about the state of the project to the right audience at the right time with the right focus
  
  
Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program, or domain with depth to be credible and influential with teams they work with
  
  
**All About You**

91cc1233.description:

Drive best practices, knowledge sharing and scalable delivery models across teams and accounts.

Support effective resource allocation and workforce demand planning while maintaining delivery quality and client satisfaction.

Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce operational risk and enhance overall delivery maturity.

12+ years of overall experience, with significant experience in Project/Program Management, Client Delivery, Managed Services, Application Support Operations or related roles.

Strong project and program management experience covering planning, execution, governance, risk, dependency and stakeholder management.

Strong client-facing, executive communication and presentation skills.

Experience managing SLA, KPI, quality, productivity and utilization metrics.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making and escalation management capabilities.

**Key Competencies**

Strong people and delivery leadership

Project and program management discipline

Senior stakeholder and client management

Ownership, accountability and results orientation

Strong communication, problem-solving and decision-making skills

**Global Working Requirements**

This role will work closely with stakeholders, teams and clients across multiple geographies.

Flexibility to work across different time zones and shift timings based on business and client requirements is essential.

f47f9579.title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead
f47f9579.description:
**Req ID:** 395525
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect / FICO Lead
  
**Senior Solution Architecture Role | Primary Skill:** Finance | Secondary Skill: Controlling
  
Job Summary
  
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance Solution Architect to serve as the senior subject matter expert and central solution authority for SAP Finance within NTT DATA. This role requires deep expertise in Financial Accounting, supported by strong working knowledge of Controlling, and will provide leadership across assessments, advisory engagements, implementations, conversions, and optimization programs.
  
The architect will work directly with CFOs, controllers, finance leaders, business process owners, enterprise architects, and SAP delivery teams. The individual will help clients understand finance processes and SAP capabilities, analyze complex requirements and pain points, answer solution questions, evaluate options, and define scalable SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions aligned with standard functionality and clean-core principles.
  
This is a client-facing and practice leadership role for a hands-on architect who can operate across business process advisory, solution design, delivery governance, presales support, and issue resolution. Manufacturing industry experience is required, together with experience in one or more additional industries.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
SAP Finance Solution Leadership
  

* Serve as the senior SAP Finance SME across SAP S/4HANA transformation, assessment, implementation, and advisory engagements.
* Own the Finance solution strategy and architecture across Greenfield, Brownfield, and Selective Data Transition programs.
* Lead end-to-end solution design for Record-to-Report, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Financial Close, Intercompany Accounting, and Financial Reporting.
* Provide architecture-level oversight for Controlling and management accounting, ensuring full integration with the Finance solution.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex Finance design, integration, data, reporting, and delivery issues.
* Establish reusable Finance architecture principles, design standards, and leading practices across client engagements.

Finance Solution Design and Architecture
  

* Lead solution architecture and detailed design for core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities, including:

o General Ledger, Universal Journal, parallel ledgers, currencies, and document splitting
  
o Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Business Partner, and payment processing
  
o Asset Accounting, bank accounting, tax, foreign currency valuation, and intercompany accounting
  
o Financial close, statutory and management reporting, embedded analytics, and SAP Fiori for Finance
  
o Credit, collections, dispute management, cash management, and Treasury integration
  

* Translate business, accounting, regulatory, and operational requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Evaluate solution alternatives, articulate trade-offs, and provide clear recommendations to business and project leadership.
* Ensure alignment with SAP standard capabilities, S/4HANA simplifications, clean-core principles, and future-state enterprise architecture.
* Review and approve functional designs, configurations, reports, workflows, interfaces, conversion designs, and integration specifications.

Client Advisory and Finance Transformation
  

* Engage with CFOs, controllers, finance directors, process owners, and business users to understand current processes, business challenges, controls, and strategic priorities.
* Lead finance assessments, discovery sessions, Fit-to-Standard workshops, and future-state process design sessions.
* Help clients understand SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities and explain complex solution concepts in clear business language.
* Analyze current-state processes and identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, stronger controls, and improved reporting.
* Develop finance transformation roadmaps, solution options, implementation strategies, business cases, and executive recommendations.
* Advise on finance operating models, shared services, close optimization, governance, chart of accounts harmonization, and organizational design.

S/4HANA Transformation and Delivery
  

* Assess the impact of S/4HANA simplifications on finance processes, configuration, reports, interfaces, controls, and custom developments.
* Guide decisions related to ledger and currency strategy, parallel accounting, document splitting, Business Partner, New Asset Accounting, and financial reporting.
* Lead or advise on Finance data migration for balances, open items, assets, bank and tax data, cost objects, and historical data.
* Assess RICEFW requirements and challenge unnecessary customization to support a clean-core solution.
* Provide solution oversight through design, build, testing, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
* Support test strategy, defect resolution, mock conversions, financial reconciliation, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.

Integration and Cross-Functional Coordination
  

* Coordinate closely with MM, SD, PP, QM, EWM, PM, PS, HCM, Treasury, Group Reporting, planning, data, security, and technical teams.
* Ensure accurate and complete financial integration across Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Plan-to-Produce, Project-to-Cash, Acquire-to-Retire, and Record-to-Report.
* Provide Finance leadership for account determination, valuation, settlement, allocations, intercompany processing, and reporting across integrated business processes.
* Collaborate with ABAP, integration, data, analytics, workflow, and Fiori teams on enhancements and interfaces.
* Ensure the Finance solution aligns with the broader SAP and non-SAP landscape and enterprise architecture.

Controlling and Manufacturing Finance Support
  

* Provide architecture-level guidance for Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Cost Object Controlling, Settlement, and Profitability Analysis.
* Ensure Controlling design is integrated with Financial Accounting and aligned with business reporting and performance management needs.
* Support manufacturing finance requirements such as inventory valuation, standard and actual costing, production variances, production order settlement, and profitability reporting.
* Partner with specialized Controlling consultants for detailed configuration or complex industry-specific scenarios.

Practice and Team Leadership
  

* Act as the central SAP Finance solution authority and trusted advisor within NTT DATA.
* Support client assessments, pre-sales activities, proposals, estimates, solution reviews, and executive presentations.
* Mentor Finance consultants, workstream leads, and architects and provide guidance on complex design and integration topics.
* Develop reusable assessment frameworks, solution standards, design principles, and leading-practice content.
* Work effectively within global onshore, nearshore, and offshore delivery models and manage multiple priorities across concurrent engagements.

Required Skills and Experience
  
**Primary Skill:** SAP Financial Accounting
  

* 20+ years of SAP experience with deep functional, advisory, and solution architecture expertise in SAP Finance.
* Strong hands-on and architecture experience in General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Financial Close, Intercompany Accounting, parallel ledgers and currencies, document splitting, tax, statutory reporting, and financial reporting.
* Deep understanding of S/4HANA Finance architecture, including Universal Journal, Business Partner, New Asset Accounting, embedded analytics, financial close, and SAP Fiori.
* At least 3-5 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA transformation or implementation programs in a Finance Solution Architect, Finance Lead, or equivalent senior role.
* Experience designing Finance solutions across multiple legal entities, currencies, countries, and accounting standards.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, compliance, statutory requirements, and management reporting.

**Secondary Skill:** SAP Controlling
  

* Strong working knowledge of SAP Controlling and its integration with Financial Accounting.
* Experience with Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Material Ledger, Cost Object Controlling, Settlement, and Profitability Analysis.
* Ability to provide architecture-level guidance for Controlling while partnering with specialized CO consultants for detailed design and configuration.
* Understanding of manufacturing cost flows, inventory valuation, production variances, actual costing, settlement, and profitability reporting.

Finance Transformation and Industry Knowledge
  

* Strong understanding of finance operating models, accounting processes, financial close, reporting, compliance, internal controls, and process governance.
* Significant industry experience in manufacturing, including discrete and/or process manufacturing environments.
* Experience in one or more industries such as Life Sciences, Automotive, Chemicals, Consumer Products, Retail, Utilities, Healthcare, or High Technology.
* Experience supporting global organizations with multiple legal entities, currencies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.
* Ability to understand industry-specific finance requirements and translate them into practical SAP solutions.

Architecture, Advisory, and Leadership Skills
  

* Proven ability to assess complex finance requirements and develop practical, scalable solution recommendations.
* Experience leading assessments, Fit-to-Standard workshops, process harmonization, and future-state solution design.
* Ability to communicate effectively with executive, business, functional, and technical audiences.
* Strong understanding of Finance integration, data migration, reporting, security, controls, and custom development considerations.
* Proven experience leading SAP Finance teams in large, complex transformation programs.
* Strong stakeholder management, executive presence, decision facilitation, and issue-resolution skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* SAP S/4HANA Finance certification and experience with SAP Activate methodology.
* Experience with SAP Central Finance is highly desirable.
* Experience to Group Reporting, Advanced Financial Closing, SAP Analytics Cloud, Treasury, FSCM, or Revenue Accounting and Reporting.
* Experience with RISE with SAP, SAP Signavio, SAP Cloud ALM, and clean-core governance.
* Experience supporting presales, solution architecture reviews, assessments, proposals, and estimates.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, CMA, CA, or equivalent is an advantage.

Soft Skills
  

* Strong analytical, advisory, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to effectively engage with CxOs
* Ability to translate complex finance requirements into scalable SAP solutions.
* Confidence working with senior finance leaders and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to operate as both a strategic architect and a hands-on solution advisor.
* Strong mentoring, coaching, collaboration, and client-service mindset.

Location and Work Model
  

* Location:
* Work model: Hybrid, onsite
* Travel may be required based on client and delivery needs.

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.
  
  
NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. **Qualifications**

* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred

* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus.

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
