What You'll Do
  
  

* Develop and refine technical sales approaches aligned to clearly defined customer and partner requirements.
* Build strong knowledge of Cisco's portfolio and progressively develop specialization within a technical domain.
* Own technical relationships with customers and partners, engaging with IT teams, business stakeholders, decision-makers, and implementers.
* Analyze customer environments, business requirements, market trends, and competitive positioning to identify and shape opportunities.
* Translate customer and partner business needs into technical requirements and recommend appropriate Cisco solutions.
* Contribute to customer account planning, solution design, demand generation, and enablement activities.
* Identify opportunities to expand Cisco's portfolio across areas such as networking, security, observability, and collaboration.
* Lead technical engagements, presentations, demonstrations, and solution discussions tailored to specific customer scenarios.
* Use market trends and competitive insights to effectively position Cisco solutions and support competitive displacement.
* Collaborate with account teams, business entities, sales teams, partners, and other internal resources to drive customer success.
* Manage and coordinate virtual technical support resources throughout the sales cycle.
* Provide feedback to business entities and relevant sales teams on strategic customer needs, market opportunities, and competitive trends.
* Share best practices and contribute to the development of technical and educational materials.
* Adapt workflows and approaches to effectively respond to changing customer and business requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree with 5+ years of related experience, or Master's degree with 3+ years of related experience.
* Experience in a technical sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales, or related customer-facing technical role.
* Experience understanding customer business and technical requirements and translating them into technology solutions.
* Experience delivering technical presentations, demonstrations, or solution discussions to customers or partners.
* Experience working collaboratively with sales, technical, and cross-functional teams throughout a sales cycle.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of enterprise technology solutions and experience developing expertise within a technical domain.
* Experience with Cisco technologies and/or enterprise networking, security, observability, or collaboration solutions.
* Understanding of competitive technology landscapes and experience positioning solutions against competitors.
* Strong customer engagement, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to navigate complex customer organizations and build relationships with technical and business decision-makers.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

**Role Summary**

A senior technical leader responsible for the overall Digital Workplace architecture strategy across one or more large client accounts. Owns solution design, transformation roadmaps, governance, and technical leadership across device management, virtual workspace, application/image management, and collaboration platforms. Serves as the primary technical point of contact for client CTO/IT leadership on Digital Workplace modernization initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the Digital Workplace architecture strategy and modernization roadmap (cloud-first, Zero Trust, Modern Management adoption).
* Lead large-scale transformation programs: legacy-to-cloud migrations (SCCM to Intune, on-prem Exchange to Exchange Online, physical desktop to VDI/Cloud PC).
* Provide architectural governance review and approve HLD/LLD across multiple workstreams and delivery pods.
* Act as trusted advisor to client stakeholders; participate in steering committee discussions and technology roadmap planning.
* Lead solutioning for large deals/RFPs — architecture, staffing pyramid, commercial inputs, and win strategy alongside pre-sales.
* Own vendor and OEM relationship management (Microsoft, Citrix, VMware, Ivanti, etc.) for licensing, roadmap alignment, and escalations.
* Establish and enforce security, compliance, and governance frameworks across the Digital Workplace estate.
* Drive innovation — AI-enabled IT support (Copilot, virtual agents), automation, self-healing endpoints, experience analytics (Nexthink, DEX tools).
* Own P&L/delivery metrics (SLA/KPI, CSAT) for the Digital Workplace tower within the account.
* Build and mentor a multi-level team of architects, leads, and engineers (30–100+ FTEs typically).

**Required Skillset**

*(In addition to all skills listed at the Manager level, at an architectural / strategic depth)*

***Device Management***

* Enterprise-scale UEM architecture and migration strategy (SCCM Intune, hybrid co-management at scale)
* Zero Trust endpoint security architecture, Conditional Access strategy design
* Digital Experience Management/Monitoring tools (Nexthink, Lakeside, ControlUp)

***Virtual Workspace***

* Multi-platform VDI/DaaS strategy (Citrix, AVD, Horizon, Windows 365) — sizing, cost modeling, and platform selection
* Hybrid cloud workspace architecture, capacity planning at scale

***App Packaging & Image Management***

* Enterprise application packaging factory setup and governance (packaging SLAs, testing frameworks)
* Standardized image strategy across global business units, image governance councils

***Collaboration Services***

* M365 architecture at enterprise scale: tenant-to-tenant migrations, hybrid Exchange architecture, complex mail flow/security design (Defender for Office 365, DLP, compliance)
* Teams architecture including Teams Phone System, Direct Routing, Teams Rooms strategy
* Collaboration governance frameworks (data residency, retention, eDiscovery)

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 15–20+ years of experience, with at least 5+ years in an architect/leadership role in Digital Workplace/EUC
* Proven experience leading large transformation programs ($5M+ scope) and managing multi-location teams
* Certifications preferred: Microsoft Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert, TOGAF (preferred), Citrix CCP-V, ITIL v4

**Leadership Expectations**

* Executive presence with client CXOs and Cognizant leadership
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills
* P&L ownership and delivery excellence accountability
* Talent development and career pathing for the practice

27b0f7d7.title: AES - DE - Generative AI Solution Architect
27b0f7d7.description:
**Engineering Foundation**
==========================

*Non-negotiable. This is what we screen on first, and there is no AI in it.*

* Data modelling across SQL and NoSQL, and a clear view of where each one breaks
* Event-driven architecture in production with Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent. Ordering, replay, idempotency, dead-letter handling
* Distributed systems failure modes: partial failure, retries, backpressure, timeouts, circuit breakers
* Caching strategy and invalidation, at a scale where getting it wrong hurt
* Observability. You have instrumented a system, not just read someone else's dashboard
* At least one cloud deeply. Not three superficially
* API and integration patterns against real enterprise surfaces such as ERPs, CRMs and data platforms
* CI/CD, containers, release engineering
* You have owned something in production. On-call, incidents, the whole thing

Agent systems are distributed systems with a non-deterministic component in the middle. If the fundamentals are not there, the AI layer does not survive contact with production.

**AI Engineering**
==================

*Two capabilities that do not come free with an engineering background. These are the ones we probe hardest.*

**Evaluation and Error Analysis**
---------------------------------

* You have built an eval set for a non-deterministic system and used it to make a decision
* You can decompose a failure: is this a model problem, a retrieval problem, a data problem or a product problem?
* You debug agent behaviour systematically, with traces and evidence, not by gut feel

**Context Engineering**
-----------------------

* Deliberate management of what enters the model on each turn, and why
* Memory strategy: what persists across steps, across sessions, and what should not
* Tool surface design: what the agent can reach, how it is scoped, what happens when a tool fails
* Cost and latency as first-class design constraints, not something discovered in the invoice

**Consulting and Client Leadership**
====================================

*Equal weight to the engineering. This is a client-facing role in a services business.*

* Carry a market point of view on models, tooling and delivery patterns, and translate it into what it means for a specific client, in their language
* Run discovery workshops, solution reviews and delivery cadences with client teams
* Advise clients on standing up their own AI capability: practice structure, operating model, skills, governance, build versus buy, and adoption across their engineering org
* Shape and defend technical proposals, PoC plans and roadmaps. Own the story end to end
* Translate business problems into architectures for CXO-level stakeholders without hiding behind jargon
* Say no when the answer is no. Tell a client when agents are the wrong tool, and be able to explain why

**Delivery and Architecture**
=============================

*The work itself.*

* Own end-to-end delivery of AI-native programs, from architecture through production
* Design multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent. Agent topology, tool routing, memory, state, fallback and recovery paths
* Integrate agent systems with enterprise systems of record, not toy datasets
* Build RAG where RAG is the right answer, from chunking through retrieval, re-ranking and evaluation
* Run agentic coding workflows with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or equivalent, and lead projects where AI writes significant portions of the codebase while you guide, review and ship it
* Work with MCP and shared-context tooling. Design what agents are permitted to reach and under what controls
* Bring governance into the design from day one: agent identity, privilege scoping, audit, human-in-the-loop, kill switches
* Contribute to reusable frameworks and accelerators the wider practice can use

**Team and Practice**
=====================

* Build AI engineering capability across the delivery organisation through mentoring, standards and review quality
* Evaluate new models, frameworks and tooling before the hype catches up, and kill the ones that do not earn their place
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases and practice assets

**What We Are Not Looking For**
===============================

* Someone who lists LLMs on a resume but has only called the API in a notebook
* People who explain everything in terms of frameworks they have never deployed
* Consultants who can only narrate what others have built
* Engineers who cannot hold a client conversation, and client-facing people who cannot build

**How We Will Evaluate You**
============================

**Stage 0, System design with no AI.** A distributed systems problem with no LLM in it. Event flow, data model, failure handling, scale. Twenty-five minutes.

**Stage 1, Technical screen.** Walk us through a system you built. Bring an artifact: an eval set, a trace from a run that failed, a postmortem, a cost-per-task number. Something real, not slides.

**Stage 2, Architecture discussion.** A business problem, live. Design the solution and defend the trade-offs, including the decision not to use agents.

**Stage 3, Client simulation.** Present your approach to a non-technical executive audience, then advise them on how to build the capability internally.

**Not a theory round.** Expect to walk through something you have actually built: the architecture decisions, what broke in production, what you would do differently. If you cannot do that with specifics, this role is not the right fit.

76e0bf2f.title: Network Solution Architect
76e0bf2f.description:
**Position:** Network Solution Architect  
**Experience:** 10+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

Fillip Technology is looking for an experienced Network Solution Architect to design, implement, and optimize secure, scalable, and high-performance network infrastructures. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in LAN/WAN architecture, data-centre networking, firewalls, routing, switching, and network security. The candidate will be responsible for developing network solutions, ensuring infrastructure reliability, resolving complex technical issues, and aligning network architecture with business and project requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop scalable, secure, and reliable network architecture for enterprise and data-centre environments.
* Plan, implement, and manage LAN/WAN infrastructure, including routing, switching, and network connectivity.
* Design and configure network security solutions, including firewalls, access controls, and security policies.
* Develop network architecture diagrams, technical specifications, implementation plans, and solution documentation.
* Manage and optimize DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, VLANs, VPNs, and other core network services.
* Evaluate network infrastructure requirements and recommend appropriate technologies, hardware, and solutions.
* Lead network deployment, migration, integration, and upgrade projects.
* Troubleshoot complex network performance, connectivity, routing, and security issues.
* Ensure network availability, scalability, performance, and compliance with applicable security standards.
* Collaborate with system administrators, cybersecurity teams, software developers, project managers, and other stakeholders.
* Conduct network assessments, capacity planning, risk analysis, and performance optimization.
* Establish network design standards, best practices, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Provide technical guidance to network engineers and support teams.
* Prepare technical proposals, cost estimates, and solution recommendations when required.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* BE/B.Tech/MCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in network engineering, network architecture, or enterprise networking.
* Strong knowledge of LAN/WAN architecture and data-centre networking.
* Expertise in routing and switching protocols, network segmentation, VLANs, and IP networking.
* Hands-on experience with firewalls, VPNs, network access control, and security configurations.
* Good understanding of DNS, DHCP, IP address management, and network services.
* Experience in network monitoring, performance optimization, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
* Ability to design highly available, scalable, and resilient network infrastructures.
* Familiarity with network security principles, access management, and infrastructure risk assessment.
* Experience with network architecture documentation, solution design, and technical presentations.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent networking/security certifications are preferred.
* Ability to lead technical discussions and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary package based on experience and expertise.
* Opportunity to work on challenging network architecture and infrastructure projects.
* Collaborative and technically driven work environment.
* Opportunities for professional development and technical leadership.
* Career growth in enterprise networking and infrastructure solutions.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

974229dc.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
  
  
**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
  
  
Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

A day in the life
  
  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures

**About The Team**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

604c94a1.description:
Relocation Assistance Offered Within Country
  
  
Job Number #173521 - Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
  
  
**Who We Are**
Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
  
  
Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
  
  
Role Overview The Planning Solution Architect is the technical and functional visionary for the global supply chain planning landscape. This role is responsible for designing a seamless, end-to-end planning architecture that integrates Demand, Supply, Inventory, and S&OP processes. You will lead the strategic transition from legacy SAP APO environments to modern platforms like Kinaxis Maestro, ensuring that the organization achieves "Concurrent Planning" capabilities and real-time visibility.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architectural Strategy: Design the target-state architecture for global planning, defining the co-existence or migration strategy between SAP APO, SAP IBP, and Kinaxis.
* End-to-End Planning Integration: Ensure seamless data and process flow between Demand Planning (DP), Supply Network Planning (SNP), and Production Planning/Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS) within the planning hub.
* Concurrent Planning Excellence: Configure Kinaxis to enable instant "what-if" scenario analysis, ensuring that a change in demand is immediately reflected across the entire supply network.
* Algorithm & Solver Optimization: Lead the selection and configuration of planning engines, including Heuristics, Optimizers (Linear Programming), and Statistical Forecasting models.
* S&OP Transformation: Architect the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process to align financial targets with operational capabilities, facilitating executive-level decision-making.
* Data Orchestration: Define the Master Data strategy (Material, Location, Resource, BOM, and Routing) required to sustain high-fidelity planning models across multiple tools.

Domain Expertise & Planning Principles
  
  

* Demand Management: Mastery of statistical forecasting, demand sensing, and collaborative forecasting.
* Supply & Capacity Planning: Deep understanding of Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP), constrained vs. unconstrained supply plans, and multi-level pegging.
* Inventory Optimization (IO): Experience in Multi-Echelon Inventory Optimization (MEIO) to balance service levels against working capital.
* Response & Resupply: Designing logic for prioritized demand fulfillment and automated supply re-balancing during disruptions.

Technical Proficiency
  
  

* Kinaxis Maestro (RapidResponse): Expert-level knowledge of Authoring (Resources, Attributes, Workbooks), Task Flows, and Integration .
* SAP IBP: Hands-on experience with IBP Demand, IBP Supply & Response, and IBP Inventory modules, including configuration of Planning Areas and Key Figures.
* SAP APO: Deep legacy knowledge of DP and SNP; ability to extract business logic from APO to migrate to modern cloud platforms.
* Integration Technologies: Proficiency in integrating planning hubs with ERP backbones (e.g., SAP S/4HANA or ECC) using SAP CPI-DS, SDI, or flat-file interfaces.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years in Supply Chain Planning IT, with at least 5 years as a Solution Architect.
* Implementation Track Record: Proven experience leading at least two global implementations involving the integration of Kinaxis or SAP IBP with a legacy SAP landscape.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, or Information Technology.
* Certifications: Kinaxis Certified Author/Architect and/or SAP IBP Professional Certification.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strategic Communication: Ability to translate complex algorithmic logic (like Optimizer costs or Kinaxis heuristics) into clear business outcomes for stakeholders.
* Analytical Problem Solving: A "systems-thinking" mindset to identify how a planning configuration in one node affects the global network.
* Change Leadership: Experience guiding planning teams through the mindset shift from "Batch Processing" (APO) to "Continuous/Concurrent Planning" (Kinaxis/IBP).

**Our Commitment to Inclusion**
Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Colgate is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status (United States positions), or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodation during the application process is available for persons with disabilities. Please complete this request form should you require accommodation.

* OCI networking, security, and database services
* Production support and cross platform migrations on Cloud

**Execute end to end database migrations, including:**

* Virtual network design
* Routing rules
* Security configuration
* Compute instance creation
* Database deployment and configuration
* Responsible for ensuring database configurations, operational guidelines, and technical documentation are maintained and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Support database upgrades, patching, maintenance, and performance tuning for Oracle databases (12c, 18c, 19c) running on on prem and OCI platforms.
* Work with additional database technologies such as MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
* Perform gap analysis against best practices and recommend improvements related to database performance, availability, security, and cloud architecture.
* Identify at risk environments or migration challenges and work with relevant teams to mitigate risks proactively.
* Perform technical reviews and identify corrective actions to improve database reliability and operational efficiency

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team-player and self-started attitude.
* Ability to create documentation for Technical Proof of concept (POC).
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 2-6 years of relevant experience in architecting, designing, implementing, and/or supporting highly distributed applications.
* Extensive experience working on at least one Public Cloud – Oracle/Azure/Google. Oracle Cloud is preferred .
* BTech / MTech / MCA / MBA
* Technical lead for engagements such as Proof of Concepts and Architectural Design Sessions to define and design a complete solution using best practices on Oracle Cloud
* System administration experience (Linux, Solaris)

**Additionally, Good To Have**

* Certificated in Public Cloud – Oracle/AWS/Azure/Google Cloud Certified Architect Professional
* Technical – Experience in Designing, Developing, Deploying and/or Migrating mission critical business applications to Cloud environments including re-platform of such systems
* Expertise in architecting best technical solutions based on customer requirement
* Experience giving presentations to executive audiences and explaining the benefits of the platform and service solution over competitors

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.
* Flexible to work either independently or work in tandem with Cloud Infrastructure team to identify and implement the most efficient cloud-based solutions for the company.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1000+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Oracle and Enterprise Applications practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

622b1e89.title: Enterprise Solutions Manager
622b1e89.description:
**The Role:**
11:11 Systems is looking for a dynamic and experienced Enterprise Solutions Manager (ESM) who will lead and manage technical service delivery on large & complex accounts. You will direct the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of 11:11 Systems’ solutions, leading a support team comprised of subject matter experts from multiple platforms, operating systems, storage and network technologies. As a trusted advisor, you will provide strategic business and technology support/counsel to your customer across both their production and recovery environments.
  
  
As ESM, you will be responsible for relationship development and management across key internal and customer stakeholders and executives to help translate their business needs into action.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Document and understand the customer’s current, future / desired state, business goals and challenges, capabilities, and IT investments.
* Based on this understanding provide technical and strategic direction from initial solution design to steady state, based on industry and 11:11 Systems best practices
* Serve as the single point of ownership for technology solutions and coordinate resources globally to optimize customer and 11:11 Systems value.
* Implement and manage effective governance practices and procedures across contracted scope of responsibilities (including change, incident, request, event, problem, and vendor management)
* Develop highly productive customer relationships and become a Trusted Advisor by providing thought leadership to help shape and grow our value to the customer
* Direct lifecycle management (LCM) activities to maintain up to date technical documentation, including production & recovery configurations, application dependency maps, run books and procedures, patching schedules, overall solution architecture document, recovery strategies / plans and contract changes
* Develop recovery strategies to meet customer RTO/RPO and conduct periodic testing to document recoverability
* Manage service / relationship risk areas and takes steps to mitigate.
* Contribute to securing renewals for expiring contracts by documenting and articulating our value to the customer.
* Participate in engineering efforts required to develop new capabilities to meet customer requirements, document results and sample deliverables.
* Identify sales opportunities and collaborate with Account Executives to grow revenue.
* Process customer self-service sales requests when needed.
* Meet/Exceed SLA targets by driving service management disciplines around incident, change, and problem management.
* Develop content and effectively lead Monthly Service Reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other strategic client meetings requested by the customer.
* Work supportively with colleagues, operating in a manner that is consistent with 11:11’s Code of Business Ethics and Company Values
* Responsibly receive, transmit, and handle company data and information per Company data handling agreements, work procedures and policies
* Review and follow company policies and guidelines, data privacy practices, including annual compliance training certification and policy acknowledgements
* Additional duties as assigned

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10+ years of professional IT experience with at least 3 years of demonstrated experience related to Enterprise focused TAM role, Solution Architecture and Customer facing Service delivery experience within complex environments.
* Technology certifications preferred, such as MCSE, CCIE, RHCE, VCP, CCDP, Cloud etc
* At least one professional certification (eg. ITILv3, TOGAF, PRINCE2 etc.), or equivalent demonstrable skills and experience
* Functional knowledge and experience on following:
* Windows Server
* Virtualization; including VMWare & Hyper-Vs
* Networking; including routing and switching, security, and firewalls
* Storage & backup services/administration
* Database; Understanding of data models and data flows in complex multitier database and application environments.
* Unix/Linux
* BCP & DR scenarios/solutions
* Knowledge of Multi-Tier Application architecture design
* Strong interpersonal skills, customer service skills and communication skills
* Problem-solving skills to be able to resolve technical issues.
* Ability to train customers to use systems and software.
* Must be legally eligible to work without visa sponsorship

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
:
  
  

* Healthcare Insurance Plan
* Life Insurance
* Paid Vacation & Holidays
* India Pension Scheme

04c26928.title: Enterprise Architect
04c26928.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**Why Join Us**

* A unique opportunity to shape the architecture of a newly formed global healthcare innovator.
* High visibility to senior executives.
* Modernization initiatives underway (SAP S/4, cloud migration, data platform modernization, AI transformation).
* Ability to influence enterprise operating models and standards across a global organization.
Chance to mature an EA practice from the ground up.  

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

The IT Enterprise Architect is a senior individual contributor role in the Global IT organization, based in India, with significant enterprise influence and visibility. This role serves as a visible change agent that drives business and technology innovation and alignment across Solventum’s global enterprise. The role is expected to operate as a strategic leader within the federated Enterprise Architecture team, drive technology asset management as a strategic imperative, own ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management processes and tooling, and help deliver a unified 3-year enterprise technology roadmap that reduces duplication, increases organizational transparency and agility, and accelerates business growth and transformation. Over time, this role may expand into formal people leadership as the Enterprise Architecture capability matures in India.

This role facilitates EA team activities including defining, documenting, and governing the enterprise IT architecture. The Enterprise Architect leads architecture consulting efforts to investigate and align technology solutions with business strategies, evaluates new and emerging technologies, creates architectural blueprints and target-state definitions, and assures technology solutions are scalable, secure, supportable, and aligned to long-term enterprise architecture direction. The Architect also leads through influence in Architecture Review Board activities that shape technology innovation, govern technology adoption globally, and drive consistent architecture definition across technology domains.

**Primary responsibilities include:**

* **Architecture Governance:** Coordinate, create, publish, and measure adoption of architectural artifacts, including standards, policies, principles, reference architectures, and target-state definitions across technology domains and technology asset classes.

* **Architecture Reviews:** Facilitate Architecture Review Board activities ensuring responsive processes, rightsizing architecture reviews, and strengthening engagement of technical teams, business leaders, and program/project managers.

* **Technology Asset Management Leadership:** Lead technology asset management as a strategic imperative by establishing governance, lifecycle standards, CMDB data quality, ownership models, and decision processes that improve visibility, reduce risk, and enable rationalization across Solventum’s technology portfolio.
* undefined
* **ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management Ownership:** Own and continuously improve ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management processes, data standards, workflows, reporting, and tooling adoption to ensure accurate application inventory, business capability alignment, lifecycle status, technology risk visibility, and actionable portfolio insights.
* undefined
* undefined
* **Technology Architecture Definition:** Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define current-state, target-state, and transition-state architectures for enterprise technology assets including applications, data and integrations, infrastructure, security systems, and shared platforms. Establish architecture patterns, principles, and roadmaps that align with enterprise strategy and create an integrated, scalable technology landscape.
* undefined
* **Technology Lifecycle Management:** Conduct research, assess and evangelize new technologies where appropriate, and drive lifecycle management for implemented technologies. Partner with business, product, platform, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations teams to guide modernization, standardization, consolidation, retirement, and investment decisions.
* undefined
* undefined
* **Delivery Leadership:** Lead architecture delivery through influence by coordinating architects, platform teams, and cross-functional stakeholders in the creation and publication of detailed architectural artifacts and technical solutions. As the capability matures, this role may expand to include formal people leadership responsibilities for architects or architecture delivery teams.

**Your Skills and Expertise:**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or higher AND ten (10) years of Enterprise Architect and/or Technical Architect experience in a private, public, government or military environment

OR

* High School Diploma/GED AND fourteen (14) years of Enterprise Architect and/or Technical Architect experience in a private, public, government or military environment

AND

In addition to the above requirements, the following skills and experiences are also required:

* Enterprise Architecture experience, which includes business, application, data, technology, and security architecture domains, with demonstrated ability to define architecture direction and translate strategy into actionable roadmaps.

* Architecture experience managing architecture review boards, conducting architecture reviews, administering technology governance and portfolio management practices, and driving technology innovation and emerging and AI technology adoption.

* Agile and/or waterfall project management experience

* Experience with one or more of the following technologies or platforms: ServiceNow CMDB and Application Portfolio Management, SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce.com, SAP BTP/Datasphere, MuleSoft, Snowflake, AWS and Azure Cloud, Zscaler, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and Copilot.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

* **Technology Governance Expertise:** Proven ability to design and govern end-to-end target states, roadmaps, and capability models that align strategy to execution.

* **Technology Architecture and Asset Management Expertise:** Expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman), modeling standards, and modern architecture practices including cloud-native, event-driven, microservices, API-first, agentic operating models, and data-centric architectures.
* undefined
* **ServiceNow APM Process Ownership:** Experience managing technology lifecycles and architecture portfolios using platforms such as ServiceNow CMDB, Application Portfolio Management (APM), and related governance and observability solutions.
* undefined
* **Global Collaboration from India:** Ability to lead globally distributed architecture, platform, and business stakeholders from India, including working effectively across time zones, influencing teams without direct authority, and building credibility as a senior individual contributor.

* Written and verbal communication skills and ability to evangelize and translate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

* Problem solving and analytical abilities to assess current IT landscape, identify gaps, and develop optimal solutions.

* Leadership skills to influence decision-making, guide architecture delivery, mentor others, and demonstrate readiness to expand into formal people leadership as the organization’s architecture capability grows.

* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Relevant certifications (e.g. TOGAF, AWS/Azure Architect, CISSP/CCSP, ITIL).  



**Work location:** Remote or Hybrid, aligned to Solventum India business needs

**Travel:** May include up to 15%

**Relocation Assistance:** May be authorized, based on Solventum India policy and business needs

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com** . Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly.**

**Solventum Global Terms of Use and Privacy Statement**

Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at Solventum are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.

Please access the linked document by clicking here . Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the
  
terms.

1e63db7b.title: Technical Delivery Manager
1e63db7b.description:
**"ABOUT US:**
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.
  
  
Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia PaDecific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
**OUR PEOPLE:**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.
  
  
We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and exciting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.
  
  
**PROGRAMME SUMMARY:**
LSEG are embarking on a large transformation programme to streamline and optimise our current capabilities, and to deliver next-generation, industry-standard Financial Crime (FC) processes, technologies and tools to support our Customer and Third-Party onboarding. While continuing to meet internal stringent policies and our external obligations, this programme shall introduce new ways of working and standards, drive efficiencies and transforme the way we deliver value towards customer journey lifecycle at LSEG.
  
  
**ROLE PROFILE:**
A fantastic opportunity for a proven and experienced Technical Delivery Manager with a background in Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Financial Crime (FC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring and Regulatory Transformation, to lead and support the delivery of key technology initiatives underpinning the FC Transformation programme.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of business, technology and programme delivery, driving requirements definition, collaborator alignment, execution governance and change implementation. This individual will act as a trusted partner to business leaders, technology teams, architects, vendors and programme leadership, ensuring the successful delivery of strategic and regulatory initiatives through the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Business and Technology Transformation**

* Partner with business, operations, risk and technology stakeholders to define strategic objectives, business requirements and delivery outcomes.
* Analyse business processes, operating models, systems and data flows to find opportunities for optimisation and transformation.
* Lead requirements definition activities including workshops, process mapping, user story development and acceptance criteria definition.
* Ensure business requirements are traceable through design, testing and implementation.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives from discovery through implementation.
* Develop delivery plans, manage dependencies and ensure alignment across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Identify and proactively manage risks, issues and delivery challenges.
* Monitor progress against achievements and ensure successful execution of programme commitments.
* Champion Agile delivery approaches, selecting the most appropriate methodology for each initiative.

**Build Strong Partnerships**

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment across teams with differing priorities and objectives.
* Provide clear communication and regular reporting to programme leadership and senior stakeholders.
* Influence decision-making through data-driven insights and thoughtful recommendations.

**Lead High-Performing Teams**

* Manage, coach and develop a team of Business Analysts and delivery professionals.
* Create an inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop and perform at their best.
* Support career development, succession planning and capability building across the team.
* Ensure resources are effectively allocated to meet programme and organisational priorities.

**Deliver Sustainable Technology Solutions**

* Collaborate with architecture, engineering and product teams to design and implement scalable solutions.
* Support delivery of Financial Crime technology capabilities including onboarding, KYC, CDD, screening, monitoring and reporting solutions.
* Ensure solutions align with governance, security, data and regulatory requirements.
* Promote continuous improvement and adoption of standard methodologies across delivery teams.

**Enable Data-Driven Decisions**

* Partner with data, reporting and engineering teams to define information requirements and reporting solutions.
* Support delivery of management information, operational insights and performance reporting.
* Ensure data quality, integrity and consistency across delivered solutions.

**Experience**
**What You'll Bring**

* Significant experience leading business analysis and technology delivery within Financial Services, Risk, Compliance or Financial Crime domains.
* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading and developing teams in a people management capacity.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders across business, operations and technology organisations.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes including KYC, Customer Due Diligence, Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring.
* Excellent business analysis, process improvement and requirements management capabilities.
* Strong project and delivery management experience, including planning, dependency management and governance.
* Ability to simplify complex problems and translate business needs into practical technology solutions.
* Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.
* Knowledge of enterprise technologies, data platforms, workflow solutions and system integrations.

**Preferred**

* Experience delivering Financial Crime technology platforms, in-house built solutions around customer
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Project Management or Product Management.
* Experience working across global teams and multiple time zones.

**Why Join Us?**
This is an opportunity to shape the future of Financial Crime technology at LSEG, leading critical transformation initiatives that improve customer experience, strengthen controls and support global regulatory obligations.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to lead talented teams, influence strategic decisions and drive delivery of solutions that create meaningful business impact across the organisation.
  
  
**We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25**
**Career Stage:**
Manager
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. 6759cc7e.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
6759cc7e.description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
* Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits)
* 5+ years of experience in technology transformation program management, with experience leading complex, multi-workstream delivery programs ($5M+/year in professional services revenue) end-to-end, including governance, program delivery quality and velocity, and financial health

**Preferred Qualifications**

3e2c0cf4.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, UnifiedAuth
3e2c0cf4.description:
**Description**
Unified Authorization is responsible for securing customer and corporate communication across all of Amazon. Whether it's the retail website, Alexa, or Kindle, we ensure actors are authenticated and authorized to take the requested action. Every aspect of Amazon's business interacts with our systems, including enabling the next generation of retail services on AWS infrastructure. As a global security provider, we're at the intersection of resiliency, availability, and the need to move at agile internet speed.
  
  
You are an experienced technical program manager who can work closely with product management and other business partners to define strategy and requirements, and help lead teams from concept through delivery and subsequent operation. You have regular communication with senior management on status, risks and product strategy. You have excellent listening, writing skills and very strong technical competency. You're a thought leader, but you don't just know how to solve the problem, you prove it by leading team to build the solution. Last but not the least; you have a high bar for quality and passion for design and architecture.
  
  
As the ideal candidate you will be experienced in working closely with a team of software development engineers and have a proven track record of working on complex software solutions using an agile methodology. You will have the ability to dive deep into the understanding of problems in order to help your team make the right decisions for the product and the business. You will have a proven track record of working across organizational lines. You will also be a strong communicator and will have proven abilities in managing through ambiguous situations.
  
  
**About The Team**
Unified Auth is responsible for securing every service transaction within Amazon SDO’s service-oriented architecture (SOA) by authenticating the services involved in the transaction, authorizing APIs access, and enforcing least-privilege access to Amazon’s business data such as Cart, Order, Customer Identity, Item, Employee Information and more. Unified Auth’s systems are classified as Maximally Secure Applications (MSA) by Amazon Security as they control access to all Amazon services. Amazon’s SOA is large, complex, and ever-growing. A single Amazon customer interaction such as adding an item into cart, proceeding to checkout, adding/changing payment methods, confirming purchase, etc. spans tens to hundreds of inter-service interactions that must be secured and observed using Unified Auth’s systems. Stores, Alexa, Ring, IMDB, Prime Video, Advertisement, Selling Partners, Pharmacy, Ordering and Payments, Fulfillment Centers, and Amazon’s internal systems such as PXT rely on Unified Auth solutions to meet rising access control security and privacy standards, such as Digital Markets Act (DMA) compliance, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type II certification.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
  
  
﻿The SmartReview team is at the forefront of protecting Google's billions of Workspace users. We play a pivotal role in developing, monitoring and upgrading the processes and human-in-the-loop flows to generate high quality data sets used to build Machine Learning models.
  
  
We are on a mission to build a scalable, auditable, and reliable process to ensure the quality of our content moderation and labelling operations.
  
  
Frequent/direct exposure: This role will be exposed to graphic, controversial, or upsetting content.
  
  
At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. **What You'll Do**

d91c75db.title: Solutions Architect
d91c75db.description:
MongoDB is seeking a Partner Solutions Architect to focus on our Large Deals exclusively on strategic, high-value pursuits with Global System Integrators (GSIs). This role will lead the technical strategy and execution of complex GSI-led bids, helping MongoDB and its GSI partners develop differentiated solutions and secure large, strategic opportunities.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate across MongoDB, GSI partners, customers, sales teams, delivery organizations, and executive stakeholders to develop compelling joint solutions, strengthen technical win strategies, and drive successful outcomes for large transformation programs.
  
  
We are looking for candidates who are based in Bengaluru/Gurugram/Delhi/Hyderabad/Chennai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the technical architecture and solution strategy for large, complex, and strategic bids
* Partner with sales, bid leadership, account teams, product specialists, services, legal, finance, and executive sponsors to deliver coordinated pursuits
* Develop joint value propositions, solution architectures, technical proposals, statements of work, and bid responses
* Engage partner architects and delivery teams to validate feasibility, implementation approach, scope, risks, and dependencies
* Facilitate technical discovery, architecture workshops, solution reviews, demonstrations, proof-of-value activities, and executive presentations
* Translate customer business outcomes into scalable MongoDB-based architectures and partner delivery models
* Shape partner-led modernization, migration, cloud, application development, data, analytics, and AI solutions
* Identify technical risks, competitive threats, delivery constraints, and commercial considerations early in the bid lifecycle
* Create reusable bid assets, reference architectures, technical content, and best practices for future pursuits
* Ensure proposed solutions align with MongoDB product capabilities, partner expertise, security requirements, and customer success criteria
* Support deal qualification, opportunity prioritization, account planning, and pipeline-generation activities
* Coordinate technical responses across multiple partners and ensure consistency in messaging, assumptions, and commitments
* Mentor field Solutions Architects and partner technical teams on large-bid strategy and execution
* Capture field feedback and communicate product, capability, and partner requirements to internal teams

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in a customer-facing Solutions Architect, Partner Solutions Architect, Presales Architect, Consulting Architect, or equivalent role
* Experience supporting complex enterprise bids, tenders, RFPs, or strategic pursuits
* Proven ability to design and communicate distributed, scalable, secure, and highly available architectures
* Experience working with Global System Integrators (GSIs), including GSI sales, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, modern application architectures, microservices, APIs, data platforms, and DevOps
* Experience developing technical proposals, solution designs, presentations, and executive-level bid content
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, work under tight deadlines, and drive outcomes in ambiguous situations
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to explain complex technical and business concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences
* Willingness to travel as required for customer and partner engagements
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with MongoDB, Atlas, relational database modernization, or NoSQL technologies
* MongoDB certification or certification with a major cloud provider
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
* Experience in large-scale transformation, legacy modernization, data modernization, AI/ML, or application development programs
* Familiarity with enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message
* Experience working with public-sector or regulated-industry procurement processes
* Experience developing joint go-to-market propositions and partner delivery models
* Experience leading technical workstreams in multi-year, multi-million-dollar pursuits

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
