**Job Summary:**

Responsible for defining, building and communicating a shared technical and architectural vision for a Product Team to help ensure the system or solution is fit for its intended purpose.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Defines, explores, and supports the implementation of enablers to evolve solution intent, working directly with Product teams to implement them; Guides enablers through planning and enablement, and work with customers and suppliers to help ensure fitness for purpose. Enables the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps - advocates for and steers the development and improvement of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, as well as helps architects to enable Release on Demand. Defines & implement subsystems and their interfaces, allocate responsibilities to subsystems, understands solution deployment, and communicates requirements for interactions with solution context, defines Nonfunctional Requirements (NFRs). Participates in planning, definition, and high-level design of the solution and explore solution alternatives. Works with Product Owners to determine the capacity allocation for enablement work; Participates in Planning, Pre- and Post-PI Planning, System and Solution Reviews, and Inspect and Adapt Events. Delivers solution adhering to standards and leveraging re-use of components; Provides oversight and fosters Built-In Quality and Team and Technical Agility; Adopts new mindsets and habits in how people approach their work while supporting decentralized decision making. Assists in technical analysis of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial-of-the-shelf products versus custom built solution. Proactively seeks opportunities to enhance efficiency in the build and deploy processes, promote reusability of component designs to reduce costs and shorten time to deliver solutions by leveraging automation where possible. Create high-level and detail design of infrastructure, interfaces, extensions, and workflows while meeting architecture, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.

**Competencies:**

Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Agile Architecture - Designs the fundamental organization of a system embodied by its components, their relationships to each other and to the environment to guide its emergent design and evolution.

Agile Systems Thinking - Embraces a holistic approach to analysis that focuses on the way that a system's constituent parts interrelate and how systems work over time and within the context of larger systems to ensure the economic success of the solution.

Business Architecture Design - Defines and creates business capability maps using standards, templates, tools and methodologies to provide a common understanding of key capabilities aligned to strategic objectives and tactical demands.

Continuous Delivery Pipeline - Implements the workflows, activities, and automation by providing the enterprise with the capability to shepherd a new piece of functionality all the way from ideation to an on-demand release of value to the end user.

Lean Agile and SAFe Mindset - Advocates for and leads others in the concepts of the Agile Manifesto and Lean thinking in support of adopting and applying the 9 SAFe principles and practices for the organization.

Regulatory Risk Compliance Management - Evaluates the design and effectiveness of controls against established industry frameworks and regulations to assess adherence with legal/regulatory requirements.

Release Planning - Plans and manages the release of capabilities, features or products using inputs from the prioritized roadmap, planning, available resources and skills to communicate expected availability and releases of capability.

System Solution Architecture - Creates solution designs and patterns using the Cummins Technical Reference Model (CTRM), CLEAN standards, and existing reference patterns to maintain alignment to Cummins standards.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

**Education, Licenses, Certifications:**

College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Business or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Google, AWS, Azure, Oracle, Docker, Kubernetes, Puppet, CompTIA, and other Cloud Development Certifications are preferred.

**Experience:**

5+ years of relevant experience required. Experience in IT utilizing a broad knowledge base in fundamental IT skills, modern development and deployment practices, DevSecOps tooling and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) knowledge preferred. Hands on experience as an IT Architect preferred.

**Qualifications**

**FinOps Platform Engineer** **Role Overview**

The FinOps Platform Engineer plays a critical role in driving cloud financial accountability, cost transparency, and operational efficiency across multi-cloud environments. With **5+ years of experience** in cloud financial operations, this role supports end-to-end FinOps delivery—spanning budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, optimization strategies, and data-driven decision support. The engineer partners closely with Finance, Cloud Platform, and Product teams to operationalize FinOps practices and enable sustainable, cost-efficient cloud growth.

**Key Responsibilities** **Cloud Financial Management & Analysis**

Analyze and interpret large, complex cloud cost datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities.

Conduct detailed variance analysis, usage reviews, and monthly financial deep dives.

Define and maintain **FinOps KPIs** , success metrics, dashboards, and scorecards.

**Budgeting, Forecasting & Reporting**

Assist in cloud budgeting and quarterly forecasting cycles across business units.

Monitor spend against budgets and provide regular, actionable reporting to engineering and leadership teams.

Partner with Finance on chargeback/showback processes, optimization accruals, and financial modeling.

**Cost Optimization & Governance**

Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities across AWS, Azure, and OCI—right sizing, purchasing commitments (SP/RIs), storage optimization, and workload efficiency.

Collaborate with engineering teams to apply cost allocation, tagging standards, and governance policies.

Drive adoption of optimization tools such as Turbonomic, ParkMyCloud, Cloudability, or native cloud cost platforms.

Work with product and platform teams to embed cost awareness into architectural and operational decision-making.

**FinOps Enablement & Stakeholder Collaboration**

Partner with Finance, Cloud Ops, and Product Owners to operationalize FinOps practices across business units.

Lead cross-functional discussions on cloud spend, architectural efficiency, and optimization recommendations.

Conduct training sessions and workshops to educate teams on cloud cost optimization best practices.

Document FinOps processes, playbooks, and financial operating procedures.

**Core Skills & Technical Expertise** **Financial & Data Analysis**

Strong analytical skills with expertise in interpreting cost/usage data.

Proficiency with Excel, SQL, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.

Experience modeling cost forecasts, budgets, and financial scenarios.

**Cloud Cost Management Tools**

Hands-on experience with tools such as:

**Cloudability, CloudHealth, ParkMyCloud, Turbonomic, ProsperOps, AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, OCI Cost Analysis.**

**Cloud Platforms & Architecture**

Solid understanding of AWS, Azure, and/or OCI services, pricing, and cost drivers.

Experience partnering with engineering teams to implement cost controls like tagging, resource hygiene, RI/SP strategies, and auto-scaling.

**Governance & Chargeback**

Familiarity with cloud tagging strategies, cost allocation models, and governance frameworks.

Experience collaborating with Finance on showback/chargeback mechanisms.

**Communication & Leadership**

Excellent communication skills for presenting financial insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to influence teams and advocate for cost-conscious engineering practices.

**Note : Although the role category is indicated as on site with Felxibility, the position is Hybrid in nature and requires 2–3 days of working from office each week.**

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform

* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy

**WirelessCar’s Journey**
WirelessCar drives the future of mobility by connecting vehicles and developing cutting-edge digital services. We help leading brands—like Volkswagen, Volvo, and Jaguar Land Rover—innovate, enhance mobility, and accelerate their digital transformation. Join us and shape the next era of automotive technology!

You will work closely with our development teams and other architects to turn business needs into secure, scalable and sustainable technical solutions.
  
  
Our environment is primarily built around AWS, but also Azure, using modern cloud-native technologies and engineering practices. This is a role for someone who wants to stay close to technology while helping teams make good architectural decisions. You won't be working in isolation. Architecture at WirelessCar is a collaborative effort, and an important part of your role will be creating alignment and helping teams make sound technical decisions.

:
  
  

* Design and evolve solution architectures for cloud-based digital services.
* Work closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, Solution Architects and Security Architects to turn requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Guide development teams in architectural decisions and help them evaluate technical alternatives and trade-offs.
* Ensure that architecture addresses important quality attributes such as security, scalability, performance, resilience and cost.
* Communicate architectural decisions and their implications clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Stay close to implementation and help teams turn architectural direction into working software.
* Contribute to the WirelessCar architecture community by sharing knowledge, developing best practices and learning from other architects.

**What We're Looking For**

* You are a technically experienced and pragmatic person who can move comfortably between the bigger system perspective and important implementation details.
* You enjoy solving complex problems together with others and can influence technical direction without relying on formal authority. You are comfortable explaining why a technical decision makes sense, listening to different perspectives and helping a team reach a good solution.
* You also enjoy coaching and supporting engineers and see architecture as something that is developed together with the teams — not something created separately and handed over for implementation.

**We believe you bring:**

* Experience designing and evolving cloud-native solutions, preferably using AWS and/or Azure.
* A strong background in software engineering and modern agile development practices.
* Experience designing distributed systems and working with areas such as APIs, integrations and service-oriented architectures.
* An understanding of non-functional requirements including security, scalability, availability, resilience, performance and cost.
* Programming experience in Java, Python or similar languages, allowing you to engage meaningfully with development teams and implementation decisions.
* Experience communicating technical concepts, decisions and trade-offs to different audiences.
* Experience working collaboratively across teams and disciplines in complex development environments. It would be a plus if you have
* Experience with Kubernetes, containerized platforms or similar cloud-native technologies.
* Experience with system or data migration initiatives.
* Interest in or experience with AI-enabled solutions, such as generative AI, intelligent automation, machine learning platforms or applying AI to improve engineering and product capabilities.
* Experience with data-driven, event-driven or analytics-oriented architectures.
* Experience with observability, DevSecOps, platform engineering or developer experience improvements.
* Experience with technical risk assessment and mitigation.
* Experience working with globally distributed development teams.
* Knowledge of the automotive industry, connected vehicles or large-scale IoT solutions.
* Relevant AWS, Azure or other cloud certifications.

WirelessCar is always on the move, often into uncharted land. We are curious, believe in collaboration and are always open to new ideas on how we can make a difference. When you join our journey, you will be part of a great crew of highly competent and warm hearted people from all over the world.

9aef6094.title: Talent Program Manager
9aef6094.description:
Join Aristocrat as our next Talent Program Manager and be part of a company that values collective brilliance and talent unleashed! At Aristocrat, we're committed to bringing happiness to life through our innovative gaming content and technology. As a key player in our People and Culture team, you will help drive our global talent programs, ensuring they are delivered seamlessly and consistently. This is an outstanding opportunity to work on an enterprise scale, supporting a diverse workforce with ambitious goals. If you're looking for a role where you can make a world-class impact, this is it!

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Manage the operational calendar and execution of performance cycle touch points, such as goal setting, check-ins, and mid-year and year-end reviews.
* Configure and launch forms, tasks, and workflows with the Workday team, monitoring completion to ensure accuracy.
* Develop and execute complex communication plans, ensuring consistent and timely delivery.

* Serve as the point of contact for performance cycle questions from HR partners and business leaders when a blocking issue arises.
* Develop resources to support and launch performance cycles and programs.
* Manage and support enterprise talent programs, including planning, logistics, participant coordination, communications, and reporting.
* Build and sustain repeatable processes, employee/manager guides, documentation, and playbooks for talent programs.

* Manage the annual compliance training cycle, including coordinating stakeholder groups, leading communications, collaborating with the Shared Services team, and ensuring there is clear reporting and actionable insights.
* Champion innovation by identifying and applying AI-enabled solutions to simplify processes, improve experiences, and scale talent programs.
* Support other Talent COE initiatives in collaboration with the larger Talent COE team.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 10+ years of strong collaborative program management experience within Human Resources, in an MNC. At least 5 years of hands-on experience running performance management systems, talent reviews and/or compliance training.
* Outstanding program and project management skills, including planning, dependency management, and delivery to deadlines across different time zones.
* Strong planning and organizational skills, with a demonstrable track record of managing recurring, fast-paced programs.
* Diligent with the ability to identify small errors that could result in significant downstream issues.
* Experience working in matrix structures or multinational corporations, navigating cross-geographies.
* Proficiency with Workday, particularly in Performance, Skills Cloud, LMS, and Talent modules.
* Digital literacy with advanced Excel skills, SharePoint, and basic data analysis capabilities. AI proficiency to automate and scale complex repeatable tasks.
* High emotional intelligence, handling sensitive situations with care and responsibility.
* Resilient under pressure, maintaining calm during deadlines and mid-cycle challenges.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with clarity and poise.

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

2a3517ab.title: Program Manager
2a3517ab.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**Program Manager**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Program Manager** , you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. You will operate at the intersection of **business strategy, technology, and execution** , partnering with senior leaders and diverse global teams to translate strategic objectives into executable plans, navigate complexity, and deliver meaningful business outcomes. Here, you will make an impact by:

* **Leading complex, global, cross-functional IT strategic programs from strategy through execution** by developing integrated project plans, linking execution activities to business objectives, and ensuring milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and outcomes are actively managed

* Applying broad IT delivery experience and structured problem-solving to **address non-routine and difficult program challenges** , assess options, interpret complex information, and drive practical solutions across multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups

* **Driving strategic alignment and execution across interconnected workstreams** , proactively managing cross-program dependencies, competing priorities, risks, resource constraints, and critical decisions to keep programs focused on intended business outcomes
* **Serving as a trusted thought partner and providing decision-ready recommendations to PMO and IT leadership** by synthesizing program health, trade-offs, risks, financial/resource impacts, stakeholder considerations, and escalation needs into clear executive-level communications

* **Influencing** **internal and external stakeholders** across IT functions, vendors, and business partners to align priorities, manage differing perspectives, remove barriers, and maintain execution momentum without direct people-management authority
* **Managing conversations with senior stakeholders** across IT and business, driving decision-making, and ensuring timely progress

* **Connecting business priorities with technology execution** by developing a strong understanding of the technology landscape, recognizing interdependencies across platforms and functions, and helping teams navigate the business and technical implications of blockers, scope decisions, and solution choices

* **Establishing strong program governance and execution discipline** , including stakeholder governance & cadence, charters, integrated plans & roadmaps, RAID and dependency management, decision tracking and financial oversight

* Foundational **understanding of IT financials** (costing, budgeting, actuals tracking)

Supporting US and EU stakeholder collaboration enabling effective program governance, leadership updates, and cross-time-zone execution  



**Your Skills and Expertise**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires at a minimum the following qualifications:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline and **9+ years of experience** in IT Consulting, IT project management, program management, technology delivery, PMO, IT transformation, business analysis, or related information technology roles.

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

* Demonstrated experience **leading complex, business critical IT projects or programs across multiple workstreams, functions, locations, vendors, or stakeholder groups** , with accountability for project plans, outcomes, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, and decision tracking.

* Proven **ability to translate strategic objectives into integrated project plans & roadmaps** that connect program activities to business objectives, stakeholder needs, delivery goals, and measurable outcomes.
* Strong **strategic thinking and structured problem-solving capabilities** , with the ability to navigate ambiguity, evaluate alternatives and trade-offs, anticipate downstream impacts, and develop practical recommendations for leadership
* Demonstrated ability to **engage and influence senior IT and business stakeholders** , facilitate difficult conversations, create alignment across competing priorities, and drive timely decisions without relying on direct authority

* Strong understanding of **program governance and delivery disciplines** , including integrated planning, roadmap management, RAID management, dependency management, resource planning, executive reporting, and decision governance

* Hands-on experience with program delivery, reporting, and collaboration tools such as **Smartsheet, Power BI, Microsoft Office Suite, and Jira**

Flexibility to collaborate with stakeholders across the US and EU and work effectively across time zones  



Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline

* PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, SAFe, ITIL, Lean Six Sigma, Smartsheet, Power BI, or related project/program management certification.

* Experience leading enterprise-scale transformation or strategic technology initiatives in a matrixed enterprise environment.

* Experience supporting strategic IT programs across more than one IT domain, such as applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, digital, ERP, M&A, separation, or business technology.

* Experience providing consulting assistance to senior management, preparing leadership-ready recommendations, and presenting program updates to department heads, functional leaders, or business stakeholders.

Skills include structured problem-solving, project leadership, executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, planning, negotiation, adaptability, ownership mindset, and disciplined execution.  



**Work location:**

* Hybrid Eligible

**Domestic Travel: May include up to 20%**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

(\*) We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, *sexual orientation* , age, civil status, disability, family status, or membership of the travelling community.Not on a global job description.

Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com** . Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly.**

**Solventum Global Terms of Use and Privacy Statement**

Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at Solventum are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.

Please access the linked document by clicking here . Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the
  
terms.

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. As a Staff Technical Program Manager at Teradata, you will drive delivery of significant, multi-team technical programs across Teradata's product portfolio, owning execution from kickoff through launch while building strong relationships with engineering, product, and business partners.

* Own planning, execution, and delivery tracking for complex technical programs spanning multiple engineering teams and product areas.
* Build and maintain detailed program plans, dependency maps, risk registers, and milestone tracking dashboards.
* Facilitate cross-team coordination and decision-making to keep programs on track — running standups, program syncs, and steering reviews.
* Translate technical program status into crisp stakeholder updates for product leadership and senior engineering audiences.
* Identify and escalate delivery risks early; lead focused retrospectives to drive continuous process improvement.
* Coordinate launch readiness activities across engineering, QA, documentation, support, and go-to-market teams.
* Support data-driven prioritization by maintaining program metrics and surfacing trade-off analysis to product and engineering leadership.
* Apply foundational AI skills to explore and implement ways AI can enhance productivity, innovation, and impact across our workforce.

You will work as an embedded delivery partner within Teradata's Product organization, collaborating daily with:

* Product Managers and Principal TPMs to align delivery timelines with roadmap commitments.
* Engineering managers, tech leads, and QA teams across Vantage platform, cloud services, and analytics product areas.
* Design, Technical Writing, Support, and Marketing teams to coordinate end-to-end feature delivery and launch readiness.

Collaborate with colleagues who share a commitment to leveraging AI responsibly, ensuring our people and customers benefit from the opportunities AI creates.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* 6+ years of technical program management experience, including at least 3 years in enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, or data analytics.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-team delivery programs involving engineering teams of 20 or more.
* Strong working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), data systems, or SaaS product delivery cycles.
* Hands-on experience with Agile delivery methodologies, sprint planning, and program-level tracking tools.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills — able to run effective meetings, surface issues clearly, and write crisp status reports.
* Foundational AI skills and the ability to understand how AI can be applied to improve outcomes in your area of expertise.

**What You'll Bring**

* Familiarity with data warehousing, SQL analytics, or cloud data infrastructure concepts.
* Experience coordinating programs that span US and international engineering teams (India experience a plus).
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar delivery management tools.
* Background in enterprise SaaS, B2B analytics, or open-source data ecosystem delivery preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail — you keep complex programs tidy and stakeholders informed.
* Ability to build trust quickly with engineers and product managers; seen as a reliable execution partner rather than a process overhead.
* A passion for how AI can unlock potential to help our teams, our customers, and our communities achieve great things.

11fbea39.description:
**Description**
READY TO DO SOMETHING BIG?
  
  
How would you build the next generation of mission critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?
  
  
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for world-wide sellers that offers access to Amazon’s vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, creating a seamless experience to leverage our world-class infrastructure. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our world-leading technology to grow and thrive on Amazon’s Marketplaces.
  
  
In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. FBA team members wake up every day thinking about how to enable our sellers to be successful by building highly scalable and highly reliable platforms. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers.
  
  
What is Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA)?
  
  
\_https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAi4fPb\_kp4&t=2s\_ (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAi4fPb\_kp4&t=2s)
  
  
The Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team
  
  
\_https://vimeo.com/80948105\_ (https://vimeo.com/80948105)

You will work backwards from the Customers/Sellers, collaborate with technical teams across Retail and FBA to implement solutions, and deeply analyze the results. You will deal with some of the toughest and most inspiring challenges of your career as you invent new big data paradigms and scale for extreme growth.

Backed by passionate leaders and a strong team culture, we’ll make tough decisions, understand why and change the world together. Come, join us and build the future!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* You will provide technical leadership to our engineering team and work closely with engineering and product leaders to deliver the best-in-class solutions to our customers
* You will solve ambiguous business problems and map them to elegant technical solutions working with some of the most talented engineering teams across Amazon
* You will use object-oriented concepts, algorithms and data structures to help build systems at Amazon scale
* You will aid in the design, launch, and re-architecture of multi-tier distributed systems with large amounts of data

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. 3760fd00.description:
**"ABOUT US:**
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.
  
  
Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia PaDecific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
**OUR PEOPLE:**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.
  
  
We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and exciting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.
  
  
**PROGRAMME SUMMARY:**
LSEG are embarking on a large transformation programme to streamline and optimise our current capabilities, and to deliver next-generation, industry-standard Financial Crime (FC) processes, technologies and tools to support our Customer and Third-Party onboarding. While continuing to meet internal stringent policies and our external obligations, this programme shall introduce new ways of working and standards, drive efficiencies and transforme the way we deliver value towards customer journey lifecycle at LSEG.
  
  
**ROLE PROFILE:**
A fantastic opportunity for a proven and experienced Technical Delivery Manager with a background in Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Financial Crime (FC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring and Regulatory Transformation, to lead and support the delivery of key technology initiatives underpinning the FC Transformation programme.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of business, technology and programme delivery, driving requirements definition, collaborator alignment, execution governance and change implementation. This individual will act as a trusted partner to business leaders, technology teams, architects, vendors and programme leadership, ensuring the successful delivery of strategic and regulatory initiatives through the full delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Business and Technology Transformation**

* Partner with business, operations, risk and technology stakeholders to define strategic objectives, business requirements and delivery outcomes.
* Analyse business processes, operating models, systems and data flows to find opportunities for optimisation and transformation.
* Lead requirements definition activities including workshops, process mapping, user story development and acceptance criteria definition.
* Ensure business requirements are traceable through design, testing and implementation.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives from discovery through implementation.
* Develop delivery plans, manage dependencies and ensure alignment across multiple teams and workstreams.
* Identify and proactively manage risks, issues and delivery challenges.
* Monitor progress against achievements and ensure successful execution of programme commitments.
* Champion Agile delivery approaches, selecting the most appropriate methodology for each initiative.

**Build Strong Partnerships**

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment across teams with differing priorities and objectives.
* Provide clear communication and regular reporting to programme leadership and senior stakeholders.
* Influence decision-making through data-driven insights and thoughtful recommendations.

**Lead High-Performing Teams**

* Manage, coach and develop a team of Business Analysts and delivery professionals.
* Create an inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop and perform at their best.
* Support career development, succession planning and capability building across the team.
* Ensure resources are effectively allocated to meet programme and organisational priorities.

**Deliver Sustainable Technology Solutions**

* Collaborate with architecture, engineering and product teams to design and implement scalable solutions.
* Support delivery of Financial Crime technology capabilities including onboarding, KYC, CDD, screening, monitoring and reporting solutions.
* Ensure solutions align with governance, security, data and regulatory requirements.
* Promote continuous improvement and adoption of standard methodologies across delivery teams.

**Enable Data-Driven Decisions**

* Partner with data, reporting and engineering teams to define information requirements and reporting solutions.
* Support delivery of management information, operational insights and performance reporting.
* Ensure data quality, integrity and consistency across delivered solutions.

**Experience**
**What You'll Bring**

* Significant experience leading business analysis and technology delivery within Financial Services, Risk, Compliance or Financial Crime domains.
* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience leading and developing teams in a people management capacity.
* Experience working with senior stakeholders across business, operations and technology organisations.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes including KYC, Customer Due Diligence, Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring.
* Excellent business analysis, process improvement and requirements management capabilities.
* Strong project and delivery management experience, including planning, dependency management and governance.
* Ability to simplify complex problems and translate business needs into practical technology solutions.
* Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.
* Knowledge of enterprise technologies, data platforms, workflow solutions and system integrations.

**Preferred**

* Experience delivering Financial Crime technology platforms, in-house built solutions around customer
* Professional certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Project Management or Product Management.
* Experience working across global teams and multiple time zones.

**Why Join Us?**
This is an opportunity to shape the future of Financial Crime technology at LSEG, leading critical transformation initiatives that improve customer experience, strengthen controls and support global regulatory obligations.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to lead talented teams, influence strategic decisions and drive delivery of solutions that create meaningful business impact across the organisation.
  
  
**We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25**

Manager

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

a4207bbe.title: Associate (AI) Solution Consultant
a4207bbe.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**Role Description**
As an Associate Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.
  
  
**Launch Your Enterprise Software Career**
Your journey will start with onboarding & enablement to develop your business and Celonis skills through a combination of hands-on experience in customer engagements and different pieces of training which cover amongst others the Celonis Process Intelligence, domain knowledge, presentation & demo skills, discovery & objection handling as well as value selling.
  
  
Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program.
  
  
During the program, you will be joining the Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring.
  
  
This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.
  
  
Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:
  
  

* Discovery & AI Solutioning
* Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python)
* Scoping business and technical requirements
* Effectively handling objections
* Developing industry domain knowledge
* Delivering impactful presentations and demos
* Understanding value selling and realization
* Managing customer accounts

**What You'll Do:**

* AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
* Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
* Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
* Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy.
* Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries
* Business Impact Presentations: Articulate and quantify strategic business value for customers, delivering impactful presentations to senior executives to ensure successful value realization for customers.
* Ensure Successful Project Outcome: Applied AI Value Engineers stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached
* Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools.

**What You Need:**

* Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics/Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.
* Excellent communication skills in English
* Extensive internship experience or 1-2 years of full-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology.
* Excellent academic performance
* Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt/context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.
* Good knowledge of Python and common ML libraries (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies.
* Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply technology to business challenges.
* A customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value.
* Confidence in presenting to diverse audiences.
* A proactive approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to learn from mistakes.
* Curiosity, self-motivation, a commitment to continuous learning, and the desire to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute on deadlines.
* Foundational business acumen and domain understanding, e.g. in areas such as Supply Chain.

**Bonus Points:**

* Degrees combining technical (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science) and business (e.g., Economics, Marketing) skills.
* Customer-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience.
* Hands-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects
* Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering
* Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
* Supply Chain process experience (Procurement, Order Management, Inventory Management, Production).
* Experience modeling ROI and TCO for business case justification.
* Experience with ERPs such as SAP and/or Oracle

This a full time, unlimited position in our Bangalore office.
  
  
**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

9f5a3640.title: Data Developer â€“ Oracle / COTS Solutions
9f5a3640.description:
Varmoda is seeking an experienced Data Developer – Oracle / COTS Solutions with 8+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications and working within Oracle database environments.  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and optimizing database structures, Oracle PL/SQL code, data integrations, ETL processes, and data migration solutions. This role will support both project implementations and ongoing application maintenance while ensuring secure, efficient, accurate, and reliable data flow across enterprise systems.  
The Data Developer will collaborate with Data Architects, Database Administrators (DBAs), application support teams, and external solution vendors to design, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and optimize database solutions and integrations. The role requires strong technical expertise, analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently on complex data development initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain Oracle database objects, including tables, views, indexes, triggers, and constraints.
* Develop and optimize PL/SQL packages, procedures, and functions supporting application business logic, data services, integrations, and ETL processes.
* Support logical and physical data modeling, database design, and normalization activities.
* Lead and execute data migration and data conversion activities for system implementations, upgrades, and integrations.
* Develop and consume SOAP and REST web services for integrations between enterprise applications and vendor-hosted/COTS solutions.
* Design and maintain data integrations that facilitate reliable and accurate information exchange between systems.
* Perform data and metadata analysis to help maintain data quality, accuracy, and integrity.
* Partner with Data Architects and DBAs on database performance tuning, code reviews, and database development best practices.
* Troubleshoot database and data integration issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement appropriate corrective solutions.
* Participate in technical design sessions and contribute to solution planning, estimation, and documentation.
* Support both new development projects and ongoing application maintenance initiatives.
* Collaborate with application support teams and solution vendors to test, deploy, and optimize data structures and processes.
* Provide technical leadership for database development, ETL, data migration, modeling, and integration activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of hands-on experience developing Oracle PL/SQL, including packages, procedures, and functions.
* 8+ years of experience using Oracle development tools such as Toad or Oracle SQL Developer.
* 8+ years of experience designing, creating, and maintaining Oracle database objects.
* 8+ years of experience with logical and physical data modeling and database normalization.
* 8+ years of experience with data analysis, data quality, and metadata management.
* 8+ years of experience developing and integrating SOAP and/or REST web services.
* 8+ years of database programming experience supporting data migrations and data conversions.
* Experience supporting or integrating vendor-hosted and/or Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS) solutions.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle relational database concepts and database development practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to independently handle complex database development and integration assignments.
* Strong collaboration skills with Data Architects, DBAs, application teams, and external solution vendors.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise application environments.
* Experience developing and supporting ETL and system-to-system data integrations.
* Experience with database performance tuning and optimization.
* Experience participating in application upgrades, implementations, and modernization initiatives.
* Experience working in environments involving a combination of custom applications and vendor-hosted/COTS platforms.

**Certifications & Clearance**

* Relevant Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, or data management certifications would be beneficial but are not listed as mandatory requirements.

**About Varmoda**

Varmoda is a federal IT solutions provider founded in 2020 and headquartered in McLean, Virginia, delivering citizen-centric public services across Financial Assistance, Public Benefits, and Security & Defense domains. Our five-layer architecture — Salesforce (Engagement), Databricks (Data), ServiceNow (Orchestration), Pega (Decisioning), and Oracle HR (Capacity) — puts data at the common thread of every solution we build for federal agencies and the citizens they serve. Varmoda holds CMMI Maturity Level 3, ISO 9001, ISO 20000, and ISO 27001 certifications, and is recognized as a V3 veteran-friendly employer.

**Why Varmoda**

* Direct impact on citizen-facing federal programs
* Competitive benefits including 401k, health insurance, Paid Time Off, Life Insurance and others — customize per role/location (https://www.varmoda.com/benefits.html)

We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com.

**Job Description**

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager with 8–12 years of experience in delivering Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Business Intelligence programs. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing end-to-end delivery for multiple data-driven projects while partnering closely with internal client stakeholders and senior technical leaders.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring successful project execution, resource optimization, and stakeholder satisfaction. You will act as a bridge between business and technical teams, ensuring smooth delivery, proactive risk management, and efficient utilization of internal talent across engagements.

Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end delivery of Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering, and BI projects across multiple client engagements.

• Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and quality expectations.

• Partner closely with internal client partners, senior technical managers, and engineering leads to ensure seamless execution.

• Manage delivery governance including project planning, tracking, reporting, and escalation management.

• Identify project risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks early and drive mitigation plans proactively.

• Oversee and optimize resource allocation by identifying internal talent based on project demand and skill requirements.

• Ensure effective utilization of delivery teams while balancing multiple priorities and changing requirements.

• Facilitate cross-functional collaboration between data scientists, data engineers, BI developers, and platform teams.

• Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes, best practices, and operational efficiency.

• Act as a point of contact for delivery-related communication with stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment.

• Support pre-sales or transition activities by providing delivery inputs, estimates, and execution plans when required.

**Qualifications**

Delivery & Leadership

* 15+ years of delivery, program, or project management experience (consulting, tech, or product scale preferred).
* Proven track record managing multi-million-dollar projects and complex stakeholder landscapes.
* Deep expertise in financial management: budget tracking, variance analysis, forecasting, and cost control.
* Fluency with Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheets, or equivalent planning and tracking tools.

Technical Acumen (Data, AI, & Cloud)

* Data Engineering Fundamentals: Understand Python, SQL, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data architecture patterns.

* Ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and validate feasibility with engineering teams.

Leadership & Collaboration

* Executive Presence: Comfortable presenting to C-suite and managing high-stakes conversations.

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client business, security, infrastructure, application, data, and operations leaders to convert technical constraints into clear business impacts and decisions

* Champion adoption of cloud governance and FinOps practices, encompassing policy, tagging, cost allocation, budget controls, rightsizing, and optimization backlogs

* Apply approved enterprise GenAI tools responsibly to enhance planning, reporting, risk analysis, knowledge management, and stakeholder communication while safeguarding data and intellectual property

**Requirements**

* Holding a recognized Google Cloud credential such as Digital Leader or Professional Cloud Architect, or a comparable industry-accepted certification
* Possession of programme-management credentials like PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, ITIL, or similar recognized qualifications

1e7afec8.title: Senior Manager - IGA Architect, Cyber Technology Consulting
1e7afec8.description:
The Senior Manager, IGA is a senior technical and client-facing leadership role focused on driving Identity Governance and Administration engagements from strategy through execution, with SailPoint and Saviynt as core platforms of expertise. This role requires the ability to lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients – translating complex governance, compliance, and identity lifecycle requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures. While IGA is the primary focus, the ideal candidate also brings working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains, including Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Access Management (SSO/MFA), to design cohesive, end-to-end identity solutions. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, architect enterprise-grade IGA solutions, and lead cross-functional delivery teams, while also contributing to business development, proposal development, and practice growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients, translating business, security, and compliance requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures.
* Architect and oversee end-to-end implementation of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions using SailPoint and Saviynt as primary platforms.
* Design and lead delivery of core IGA capabilities, including identity lifecycle management (Joiner/Mover/Leaver), access certification/attestation campaigns, role-based access control (RBAC) and role mining, Segregation of Duties (SoD) policy design, entitlement management, and access request/approval workflows.
* Lead application onboarding strategy for IGA platforms, including source/target connector design, birthright and non-birthright provisioning, and integration with authoritative HR sources
* Define and implement IGA governance frameworks, including policy design, audit and compliance reporting, and global configuration/data segmentation best practices.
* Working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains – Privileged Access Management (PAM, e.g., CyberArk, Delinea) and Access Management (SSO/MFA via Entra ID, Okta, Ping) – to ensure IGA architectures integrate cleanly across the broader identity ecosystem.
* Own end-to-end delivery for engagements, managing scope, timelines, technical quality, and client satisfaction.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, running architecture workshops, discovery sessions, and executive-level readouts.
* Develop maturity assessments, governance roadmaps, and target operating models tailored to client environments and industry (e.g., healthcare, higher education, financial services).
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and career development to IAM engineers, architects, and consultants on the delivery team.
* Partner with sales and account teams on business development activities, including solution scoping, proposal/SOW development, and technical presentations for prospective clients.
* Advise clients on regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR) as they relate to identity governance controls, certifications, and audits.
* Monitor emerging IGA trends and best practices (including AI-driven governance) and champion their adoption across client engagements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
* 10+ years of hands-on IAM experience with a strong concentration in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), including consulting or client-facing delivery, and at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or architecture role.
* Deep, hands-on expertise architecting and implementing SailPoint and Saviynt, including certification campaigns, RBAC/SoD design, connector configuration, and workflow customization.
* Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, entitlement governance, access certification processes, and provisioning/de-provisioning across enterprise applications.
* Working knowledge of PAM concepts and platforms (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust) and Access Management/SSO technologies (e.g., Entra ID, Okta, Ping) sufficient to architect integrated IAM solutions.
* Proven ability to lead technical architecture discussions and design sessions directly with client stakeholders, including CISOs and IT leadership.
* Solid understanding of identity protocols and standards, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and LDAP.
* Experience managing project resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple concurrent engagements.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing technical teams, with strong people leadership skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.
* Relevant certifications strongly preferred (e.g., CISSP, CISM, SailPoint Certified, Saviynt Certified Professional).

0c764f44.description:
**Position:**
Technical Customer Success Manager – SaaS Integrations
  
  
**Experience:**
4–7 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai (Work from Office)
  
  
**Shift Timing:**
2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Department:**
Integrations / Customer Success
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Technical Customer Success Manager with 4+ years of experience in SaaS integrations, technical project management, API integrations, and customer-facing technical operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess a strong technical understanding of SaaS platforms, REST APIs, integration workflows, and automation technologies, along with excellent customer communication and project management skills.
  
  
This role will primarily focus on
**post-implementation customer success**
, ensuring seamless transitions from project delivery to ongoing operational support, maintaining integration stability, resolving technical challenges, and driving continuous improvements.
  
  
The candidate will act as the primary technical point of contact for assigned customers after their integration projects go live, collaborating with engineering, implementation, and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* SaaS Integration Management
* Understand and manage integrations between SaaS applications and third-party platforms.
* Troubleshoot API failures, authentication issues, data synchronization errors, and integration disruptions.
* Analyze integration workflows, field mappings, data transformations, and dependencies.
* Coordinate with engineering teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Support integrations built using REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and integration automation platforms.
* Identify integration performance bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
* Ensure integrations continue functioning reliably when SaaS platforms or APIs change.
* Technical Project Management
* Independently manage multiple customer integration accounts and post-go-live activities.
* Plan and coordinate bug fixes, enhancements, integration changes, and technical improvements.
* Track customer requests, issues, priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* Manage technical dependencies and communicate risks proactively.
* Coordinate with developers, QA engineers, and Technical Leads for issue resolution.
* Provide clear and timely status updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure proper documentation and adherence to internal delivery processes.
* Post-Go-Live Customer Success
* Take ownership of integration projects after successful production deployment.
* Manage the transition from implementation teams to customer success operations.
* Ensure integration stability, reliability, and successful ongoing operations.
* Conduct periodic customer check-ins and technical health reviews.
* Proactively identify integration risks, failures, and customer concerns.
* Maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication and technical guidance.
* Drive issue resolution and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Incident Management & Technical Support
* Take ownership of customer-reported integration incidents.
* Perform initial technical investigation and root cause analysis.
* Coordinate incident resolution with the appropriate technical teams.
* Manage issue severity, priority, escalation, and communication.
* Ensure critical customer issues receive appropriate attention.
* Document incident findings, resolutions, and preventive actions.
* Work toward reducing recurring production issues.
* Integration Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
* Monitor integration health, API failures, scheduled jobs, and data synchronization processes.
* Identify recurring issues and opportunities for automation.
* Recommend improvements to integration architecture and operational workflows.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance and integration upgrades.
* Improve monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, and support processes.

dee94a3f.title: Security Program Manager
dee94a3f.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Security Program Manager based in India.**
We are seeking an experienced cybersecurity professional to lead strategic security programs and initiatives that protect critical information assets and strengthen organizational resilience. In this role, you will oversee the planning, execution, and continuous improvement of security projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. You will collaborate with IT, engineering, and business teams to identify risks, implement effective controls, and integrate security into operational processes and the software development lifecycle. Your responsibilities will span vulnerability management, incident response, security audits, compliance, and employee awareness. Through data-driven reporting and stakeholder engagement, you will communicate program progress, highlight emerging risks, and drive informed decision-making. This remote opportunity offers the chance to influence enterprise security strategy while working with diverse teams in a dynamic, technology-driven environment.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Develop and implement comprehensive security programs, strategies, and roadmaps aligned with organizational objectives, recognized security frameworks, and industry best practices.
* Manage the complete lifecycle of security projects, including planning, resource coordination, execution, monitoring, risk management, and reporting, ensuring delivery within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Lead cross-functional teams in identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and mitigating security risks across systems, applications, networks, and infrastructure.
* Establish, maintain, and improve security policies, standards, procedures, and controls in alignment with frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, and applicable regulatory requirements, including GDPR.
* Oversee vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security audit activities, coordinating remediation efforts and tracking progress through to resolution.
* Collaborate with IT, engineering, and business stakeholders to embed security requirements into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and broader operational processes.
* Develop and deliver security awareness and education programs that promote secure practices and strengthen employee understanding of cybersecurity responsibilities.
* Maintain and improve security incident response plans, procedures, and exercises to support effective detection, response, recovery, and incident resolution.
* Evaluate emerging security technologies and solutions, recommending improvements that enhance organizational security capabilities and operational effectiveness.
* Prepare and present security metrics, program updates, risk assessments, and performance reports to senior management and relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging cyber threats, security technologies, regulatory changes, and industry developments to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Coordinate program priorities and manage dependencies across multiple initiatives while maintaining clear communication, accountability, and alignment with business goals.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field; a master’s degree is preferred.
* At least 7 years of progressively responsible experience in information security, including a minimum of 3 years in security program management.
* Proven experience managing complex cybersecurity programs and projects using established project management methodologies, such as Agile or Waterfall.
* Strong understanding of information security principles, governance frameworks, controls, and industry best practices, including NIST, ISO 27001, and COBIT.
* Broad technical knowledge across application security, network security, cloud security, data protection, and identity and access management.
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements, including GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, and SOX.
* Experience overseeing security risk assessments, vulnerability remediation, penetration testing, security audits, and incident response initiatives.
* Relevant professional certifications, such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Information Privacy Professional/United States (CIPP/US), or equivalent credentials, are highly desirable.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and sound judgment when assessing risks and prioritizing security initiatives.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects and competing priorities, and adapt to changing requirements in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational and reporting skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, program performance, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.

**Benefits**

* Employment type: Full-time position.
* Location: Remote, India.
* Flexible working arrangements: Flexible work options designed to support work-life balance, subject to role and location requirements.
* Health and well-being: Access to benefits, support, and services intended to promote overall employee health and well-being.
* Professional development: Opportunities to expand cybersecurity expertise and contribute to enterprise-wide security initiatives.
* Meaningful impact: Opportunity to influence security strategy, improve organizational resilience, and strengthen risk management practices.
* Collaborative environment: Work alongside global teams and professionals across technology, engineering, and business functions.
* Autonomy and ownership: Scope to lead programs, drive improvements, and contribute to strategic decisions.
* Inclusive culture: A workplace that values diversity, mutual respect, equal opportunity, and merit-based development.
* Salary and additional benefits: Specific compensation figures, healthcare plan details, paid leave entitlements, and other benefits were not specified in the available job description.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements.
