The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
  
  
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

95e209f5.title: Program Manager ( FM/MM)
95e209f5.description:
**Program Manager - First Mile / Middle Mile**
**About Blitz**
Blitz enables Same-Day Delivery for eCommerce brands to provide the best on-time delivery experiences to their customers. Blitz aims to simplify scalability & unlock the growth of new-age eCommerce brands by making Same-Day delivery more convenient, reliable & affordable. Same-Day Delivery helps brands with converting their browsers into buyers, serving as a competitive advantage and reducing working capital challenges. Blitz currently engages with enterprise brands with category focus into Fashion, Beauty & Personal Care and Healthcare; helping them with 30% - 40% increase in their website conversions & increasing retention by 2x by providing best in class experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Program Manager to drive initiatives across our first-mile and mid-mile network, covering the movement of goods from vendors to mother hubs and warehouses, and onward to dark stores. You will own programs that improve speed, cost, reliability, and scalability of inbound and line-haul operations, so that stores stay replenished on time in a high-velocity business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Ownership**

* Plan and run first-mile and mid-mile programs end to end, from scoping and milestones to delivery and post-launch review.
* Maintain roadmaps, risk logs, and dependency trackers across Procurement, Warehousing, Transport, Finance, Tech, and Store Operations.
* Run weekly and monthly business reviews and give leadership clear updates on progress, risks, and blockers.

**First Mile Programs**

* Drive vendor pickup and inbound scheduling programs, including appointment booking, slot management, and dock-to-stock TAT improvement.
* Improve farm-to-hub and vendor-to-warehouse flows for fresh and perishable categories, with a focus on quality, wastage, and cold chain.
* Work with procurement on vendor delivery compliance, ASN accuracy, and inbound OTIF.

**Mid Mile Programs**

* Optimize line-haul and hub-to-dark-store movement through route planning, trip consolidation, and fleet utilization.
* Run transporter onboarding, rate contracts, and performance management programs (vehicle fill, TAT, damage, delivery adherence).
* Improve replenishment cycle times and cut-off adherence so stores receive stock before peak demand windows.

**Cost & Network Optimization**

* Reduce cost per kg / cost per case / cost per trip through route optimization, load planning, and vendor mix changes.
* Support network design decisions such as hub placement, cross-docking, and milk-run models.
* Build business cases and size savings for new initiatives.

**Process, Tech & Automation**

* Define requirements and work with product and tech teams on TMS, route optimization, vehicle tracking (GPS/telematics), and inbound/outbound visibility tools.
* Standardize SOPs for loading, unloading, seal and handover, GRN, and shortage/damage claims.
* Reduce manual effort and turnaround time through process redesign and automation.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Build dashboards and track KPIs: inbound TAT, trip utilization, cost per trip, on-time dispatch and delivery, shortage and damage rates.
* Use data to find bottlenecks, run root-cause analyses, and drive corrective actions.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to transport, safety, and statutory requirements (E-way bill, vehicle documentation, driver compliance, FSSAI for food movement).
* Manage transporter SLAs, penalties, claims, and dispute resolution.

**Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, transport operations, or program management, ideally in e-commerce, quick commerce, retail, FMCG, or 3PL.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent from a reputed institute preferred.
* Proven record of delivering cross-functional programs with measurable cost, speed, or reliability impact.

As the technical owner of the customer relationship, you'll partner cross-collaboratively to ensure successful delivery. Your role spans from understanding domain-specific customer needs to architecting scalable, agent-based AI solutions using DevRev's platform\*\*, with direct involvement in implementing key technical components and debugging complex integration challenges.

This position requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture expertise, AI solution design, hands-on development skills, customer empathy, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll act as the connective tissue between pre-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams, bringing our AI capabilities to life for real-world business impact.

* Design & Deploy AI Agents: Build, configure, and launch intelligent agents using the DevRev platform to solve real customer problems.

3abf43b9.description:
**About Gruve**
Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Pre-Sales Consultant (Cybersecurity) is a strategic, customer-facing role responsible for driving solution design and technical sales across enterprise security engagements. This role requires a strong blend of cybersecurity expertise, presales experience, and consultative problem-solving to translate complex customer requirements into scalable, multi-layered security architectures. You will work closely with sales, OEMs, and delivery teams to enable deal success, influence customer decisions, and drive revenue growth. The ideal candidate is hands-on, business-aware, and capable of engaging stakeholders across technical and leadership levels.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead technical discovery and customer engagements to understand security challenges and requirements
* Design and present end-to-end cybersecurity solutions across SIEM, SOAR, XDR, NDR, SSE, NAC, WAF, and SOC services
* Deliver technical demos, workshops, and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to validate solutions and drive deal progression
* Develop technical proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), HLDs/LLDs, and solution documentation
* Support SOC and managed security services pre-sales including use-case design, onboarding models, and SLA definition
* Collaborate with sales, OEM partners, and delivery teams to align solutions with customer needs and business goals
* Drive RFP/RFI responses, competitive positioning, and solution differentiation in complex deals
* Act as a trusted advisor to customers by recommending best practices and guiding security transformation initiatives

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Networking, or related field
* 6–13 years of experience in cybersecurity pre-sales, solution architecture, or security consulting roles
* Strong experience across SIEM, SOAR, XDR, NDR, NAC, WAF, SSE, SOC operations, and managed security services
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and SD-WAN
* Proven experience in designing security architectures, delivering PoCs, and conducting customer workshops
* Experience in handling RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, and end-to-end presales lifecycle
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills across technical and business audiences

08a91a9d.title: Lead Solutions Consultant
08a91a9d.description:
NORTH AMERICA experience mandatory

*Confidential search: our company name is shared with candidates during the interview process.*

**The Opportunity**

Every enterprise deal we win starts with someone who truly understands the buyer's problem and shows them a better way. As our Lead Solutions Consultant, you'll be that person, and you'll work hand in hand with Product to make sure we're selling the things that matter most to our customers. You'll have a direct line to our sales leaders, our roadmap, and the C-suite conversations that shape big deals.

**What You'll Drive**

* Lead discovery with enterprise buyers, uncover the business pain behind the ask, and shape a solution that makes us the obvious choice.
* Deliver demos, in person and virtual, tailored to each persona's role, challenges, and desired outcomes.
* Partner with Product to turn customer signal into roadmap input, so we sell our strongest capabilities and build what buyers need next.
* Scope and run Proof of Concept engagements that show measurable results.
* Build "art of possible" storylines and business cases for CROs, CIOs, CISOs, and CHROs, and present them with confidence.
* Own the demo toolkit, including scripts, scenarios, environments, battle cards, and RFI/RFP responses.
* Co-lead Analyst Relations evaluations with purpose-built demos and technical narratives that influence industry reports.
* Mentor teammates across the organization and raise the bar for how we sell.

**✦ How You'll Work with AI**

AI is a collaborator here, not just a tool. We expect every team member to actively use AI to move faster and think bigger.

* Use AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini to research accounts, prep discovery questions, and draft demo scripts and battle cards.
* Run agentic workflows to produce first drafts of RFP responses, then refine them with your judgment.
* Demo our own AI features, including AI role plays and conversation intelligence, and explain how they work to non-technical leaders in plain language.
* Prompt-engineer and iterate on the workflows that shrink your prep time, and share what works with the team.

**What You Bring**

* Run complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise B2B SaaS sales cycles (6–9+ months, $250K+ deals) as a trusted advisor to sales.
* Translate business needs into clear, practical solutions, and back them with a compelling story.
* Explain AI concepts like LLMs, agentic workflows, and machine learning so CROs and CMOs feel confident buying.
* Command a room of senior executives and handle high-stakes technical and commercial objections with ease.
* Take ownership, move with urgency, and shift between big-picture strategy and hands-on execution in a small, fast-moving team.
* Communicate with clarity, whether you're presenting, writing, or listening.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Revenue Productivity or Sales Enablement would give you a head start.
* Background scoping POCs or supporting analyst evaluations is a plus.
* Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements that enterprise buyers care about is helpful.

**What We Offer**

* Flexible hybrid work - we care about output
* Unlimited paid time off, plus company holidays and all statutory leave entitlements
* Comprehensive health coverage for you and your family
* Wellness support - physical and mental health programmes
* Learning & development access, including our own platform.
* Equity participation [include if applicable]

**Our Culture & Values**

We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values aren't wall decor. They're how decisions get made here.

Growth here looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.

Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.

*We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. You can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.*

We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Your Right to Work: In compliance with applicable laws, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the respective work locations and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

90c290ed.title: Senior Program Manager
90c290ed.description:
**Role purpose:-**

  

The Senior Programme Manager Finance Systems will provide permanent, enterprise-level leadership for the Finance Systems & Transformation portfolio. The role combines programme delivery leadership with hands-on portfolio management, governance and PMO discipline, ensuring that strategic initiatives move from concept and approval through controlled execution, adoption and benefits realisation.

The role will maintain an integrated view across Finance transformation initiatives, including finance systems, planning and forecasting, reporting and analytics, controls improvement, process transformation and operating-model change. It will give Finance leadership clear visibility of priorities, delivery status, risks, dependencies, resources, costs and decisions, while holding workstream owners and delivery partners accountable for outcomes.

  

**Key responsibilities:-**

  

* **Programme leadership and execution:** Translate the Finance Transformation strategy and roadmap into executable programmes, workstreams, milestones and outcomes. Drive delivery across multiple initiatives and intervene early where progress, ownership or quality is at risk.
* **Integrated portfolio planning:** Own the consolidated transformation roadmap, integrated plan, critical path and cross-workstream dependencies. Maintain a clear view of sequencing, capacity, funding and business availability.
* **Governance and decision support:** Operate the programme governance rhythm, including Steering Committee preparation, decision papers, status reporting, action tracking and follow-through. Ensure forums focus on decisions, outcomes and value rather than activity reporting.
* **PMO and delivery discipline:** Establish and maintain consistent planning, RAID, dependency, decision, change-control, financial tracking and document-management standards across the portfolio.
* **Risk, issue and escalation management:** Maintain an enterprise view of delivery risks and issues, ensure mitigations have accountable owners and dates, and escalate material matters with clear options and recommendations.
* **Workstream assurance:** Challenge plans, assumptions, RAG status, estimates and recovery actions. Confirm that scope, requirements, testing, readiness, controls, documentation and handover are adequate before stage-gate decisions.
* **Stakeholder alignment:** Build strong relationships across Finance, Finance Systems, Technology, Operations, Risk, Internal Audit and regional teams. Translate complex delivery information into concise, decision-ready messages for senior leaders.
* **Supplier and resource coordination:** Coordinate internal teams, contractors and delivery partners; monitor commitments, deliverables, costs and knowledge transfer; support mobilisation, onboarding and transition to permanent capability.
* **Change, readiness and adoption:** Ensure each initiative has a proportionate change approach covering communications, training, business readiness, operating procedures, ownership and transition into BAU.
* **Benefits and continuous improvement:** Define measurable outcomes and benefits, track realisation after implementation and ensure lessons learned are reflected in future delivery standards.

  

**Key working relationships**

Finance Transformation sponsors and Steering Committee; Head of Finance Systems; Global and Regional Finance leadership; Finance process owners; Technology and data teams; Risk, Controls, Internal Audit and external audit stakeholders; programme and project managers; business analysts; implementation partners and specialist suppliers.

**Key deliverables**

* Integrated Finance Systems Transformation roadmap and portfolio plan with milestones, dependencies, resources and critical path.
* Clear executive reporting, programme dashboards, decision papers and Steering Committee materials.
* Current RAID, decision, action, dependency, change and benefits registers with accountable ownership.
* Consistent delivery methodology, templates, stage gates and evidence standards across workstreams.
* Recovery plans for red or amber initiatives, with measurable actions and dates.
* Controlled programme financial and resource view covering budgets, forecasts, supplier costs and capacity.
* Business readiness, transition and BAU handover plans for each material initiative.
* Portfolio-level benefits tracking and post-implementation review.

Skills and experience

**Essential**

* Significant experience leading complex, multi-workstream Finance Systems or enterprise transformation programmes.
* Strong programme and portfolio management capability, including integrated planning, governance, RAID, dependencies, change control and benefits realisation.
* Experience preparing executive and Steering Committee reporting and converting complex information into clear decisions and recommendations.
* Proven ability to coordinate Finance, Technology, Operations and external delivery partners in a matrix environment.
* Experience challenging delivery plans, driving recovery activity and holding senior workstream owners accountable.
* Understanding of Finance processes, systems implementation, controls, testing, readiness and BAU transition.
* Commercial and financial discipline covering budgets, forecasts, resource plans and supplier commitments.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate hands-on, manage competing priorities and deliver through ambiguity.

  

**Preferred**

* Experience in Financial Services or another regulated, control-focused environment.
* Experience with Finance ERP, EPM, reporting, data, controls or operating-model transformation.
* Exposure to platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Anaplan, Power BI, Qlik or Azure DevOps.
* Experience establishing or maturing a transformation office, portfolio office or enterprise PMO.
* Experience working across global teams and delivery partners, including India-based delivery models.
* Recognised programme or project management qualification, such as MSP, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent.
* Finance, accounting, technology or transformation-related professional qualification.

  

**Personal attributes**

* Outcome-oriented, structured and able to combine strategic perspective with hands-on delivery.
* Calm and credible with senior stakeholders, while willing to challenge constructively.
* Highly organised, analytical and rigorous about ownership, evidence and follow-through.
* Commercially aware, pragmatic and comfortable making recommendations with incomplete information.
* Collaborative across cultures, functions and locations, with a strong commitment to building internal capability.

  

**Success measures**

* Transformation initiatives delivered to agreed outcomes, quality, cost and key milestones.
* Leadership has a reliable, single view of programme status, decisions, risks, resources and dependencies.
* Material risks and slippage are identified early, with timely recovery action and escalation.
* Governance forums result in clear decisions, accountable actions and measurable follow-through.
* Improved consistency and maturity of programme planning, reporting and delivery controls.
* Successful business adoption, BAU transition and measurable benefits realisation.
* Reduced reliance on external programme leadership through sustainable permanent capability in India.

  

**Role positioning**

This is not a reporting-only PMO role. It is a senior, hands-on programme leadership position accountable for joining up the Finance Transformation portfolio, driving execution and maintaining the governance discipline required to deliver sustainable business outcomes. Individual workstream leads remain accountable for their solutions and deliverables; this role provides the integration, challenge, visibility and leadership that connect them into one controlled programme.

db00353e.title: Solutions Architect (PST/EST Customer Hours)
db00353e.description:
**About Glean:**

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

**About the Role:**

Glean is seeking a talented Solutions Architect (SA) to join our rapidly expanding, venture-backed startup. Glean is the Work AI platform — powering intelligent search, AI assistants, and scalable AI agents for the world's largest enterprises. Join our hard-working team and elevate your career. We are professional, creative, passionate, and, most importantly — customer-obsessed.

This is not a traditional SA role where you build slide decks. You will write code, build working prototypes, and ship real integrations alongside the customers who use them. If you love toggling between building something technical and advising a customer on how to deploy it, this role is for you.

You will be the primary technical advisor to our customers post-sale, focusing on our Enterprise and Strategic segment, where the architecture and integration demands are high. You will guide customers through their architecture, design, and implementation of Glean within their enterprise environment — and you will build alongside them, not just advise.

**You will:**

* Establish and maintain your role as the customer's primary technical advisor. Think of yourself as the CTO of the customer relationship.
* Build working prototypes, tools, and integrations using Glean APIs (Indexing, Search, Chat), RAG workflows, MCP tools, and agent frameworks — directly with and for customers.
* Onboard new data sources and implement custom integrations of Glean into customer work environments and business application architectures.
* Identify and drive expansion opportunities — including AI assistants, agents, and API-driven applications — within each customer's architecture.
* Provide training and guidance to customer technical resources to enable them to manage, support, and extend Glean in their environment.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues for your assigned customers, from log analysis to end-to-end transaction tracing.
* Work with Product Management and Engineering to drive product improvements based on patterns you observe across customer engagements.

**About you:**

6 to 10 years of experience in Solutions Architect, or related roles.

*Interpersonal skills:*

* Communication: professional presentation and interaction skills with both customers and internal teams. Able to explain complex AI and integration concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Project planning: plan and execute the implementation of customer projects.
* Self-motivated: a proactive approach to delivering service to customers.
* Detail-oriented: highly organized and methodical, ensuring all issues are managed to completion.
* Data-driven: utilize metrics and objective measurements to assess success and improvement opportunities for customers.
* Pre or Post-sales Solution Architect experience in a product-led company is a huge plus.

*Technical skills:*

* Software development experience in at least two of the following: Python, Java, Go. You write code regularly — not just in the past.
* Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications: RAG pipelines, chatbots, AI assistants, or agentic workflows using LLMs.
* API and custom data integration experience in a Hybrid or SaaS environment. Experience with Indexing, Search, or Chat APIs is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI developer tooling such as LangChain, vector databases, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Technical debugging: log analysis, code analysis, end-to-end transaction tracing.
* Networking expertise: a deep understanding of networking, including cloud and on-premise networking.
* Experience in at least two of the following disciplines: Software Engineering, Pre-Sales Engineering, Post-Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Developer Relations, Forward Deployed Engineering, or Technical Customer Delivery.
* Hands-on experience with Cloud technologies in at least one of the following: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure.
* Security and audit experience: able to fully understand the technical and audit framework of the product and represent it with customer security and audit stakeholders.

*AI fluency:*

* You use AI tools (such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) as part of how you work — not just what you build.
* You can demonstrate something you have personally built using AI, explain how it works, debug it live, and defend your technical choices.
* You are comfortable building and demoing working prototypes under time constraints.

**Location:**

* This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bangalore office)

36f45bcc.description:
Job Description

Role Name: Junior Cloud Solution Architect / Cloud Presales Engineer

Experience: 0–2 Years

Department: Cloud Solutions / Presales

Role Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

We are looking for a motivated and technically curious Junior Cloud Solution Architect / Cloud Presales Engineer to support customer-facing cloud solution design, workload assessment, technical proposals, and hybrid cloud opportunities.

The ideal candidate should have a foundational understanding of Public Cloud, Private Cloud, enterprise infrastructure, networking, and virtualization, along with an interest in understanding customer workloads and recommending suitable technology solutions.

The role will provide exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, Private Cloud, Hybrid Cloud, and Tech9IQ solutions. The candidate will work closely with senior architects, sales teams, OEMs, and delivery teams to understand customer requirements and develop technically and commercially suitable cloud solutions.

We are looking for someone who understands that the right cloud solution starts with understanding the workload, not simply choosing a cloud platform.

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Discovery and Requirement Gathering

* Assist senior architects in conducting customer discovery sessions and technical workshops.
* Gather information about existing IT infrastructure, applications, databases, virtual machines, storage, networking, and security requirements.
* Document customer business objectives, technical challenges, and infrastructure requirements.
* Prepare workload discovery questionnaires and assessment documents.

2. Cloud and Infrastructure Assessment

* Support Cloud Readiness Assessments and infrastructure evaluations.
* Collect information about CPU, RAM, storage, utilization, application dependencies, performance, and availability requirements.
* Help classify workloads based on their suitability for Public Cloud, Private Cloud, Hybrid Cloud, or on-premises infrastructure.
* Identify basic migration considerations, technical dependencies, and potential risks under senior architect guidance.

3. Cloud and Hybrid Solution Architecture

* Develop foundational knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, Private Cloud, and Hybrid Cloud architectures.
* Assist in designing solutions involving compute, storage, networking, IAM, backup, disaster recovery, security, and monitoring.
* Support the preparation of High-Level Designs (HLDs), architecture diagrams, infrastructure sizing, and bills of materials.
* Understand virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architecture at a foundational level.
* Learn how to evaluate workload placement based on technical requirements, performance, security, and cost.

4. Tech9IQ Solution Positioning

* Learn and support the positioning of Tech9IQ solutions for Private Cloud, IaaS, Application Hosting, Managed Infrastructure, Backup, Disaster Recovery, Cloud Migration, Data Centre Exit, Workload Repatriation, and Hybrid Cloud.
* Assist in comparing Tech9IQ, hyperscaler, and hybrid solutions based on customer requirements.
* Understand the technical and commercial advantages of different deployment models.
* Help identify workloads that may be better suited to Private Cloud or Hybrid Cloud rather than Public Cloud.

5. Cloud Economics and Cost Estimation

* Assist in preparing cloud consumption estimates, infrastructure sizing, and cost comparisons.
* Develop an understanding of Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), cloud economics, and FinOps principles.
* Help compare Public Cloud and Private Cloud costs, including infrastructure, licensing, storage, networking, backup, support, and operational expenses.
* Learn to identify potential cost optimization opportunities without compromising performance, security, or availability.

6. Presales Documentation and Technical Proposals

* Assist in preparing technical proposals, RFP/RFQ responses, solution presentations, and architecture documents.
* Support the preparation of scope of work, assumptions, dependencies, and technical compliance matrices.
* Coordinate with sales, delivery, infrastructure, and cloud teams to gather technical inputs.
* Participate in proof-of-concept (POC) planning, technical discussions, and customer presentations under senior team guidance.

7. Migration Planning and Delivery Handover

* Learn the fundamentals of cloud migration strategies, workload prioritization, migration dependencies, and cutover planning.
* Assist in documenting migration prerequisites, risks, rollback considerations, and validation requirements.
* Support technical handover documentation for delivery teams.
* Understand the end-to-end system integration presales lifecycle, from discovery and assessment through technical closure and delivery handover.

Technical Skills and Qualifications

* 0–2 years of experience in Cloud Computing, IT Infrastructure, Technical Presales, Solution Architecture, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
* Foundational understanding of at least one Public Cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, or IBM Cloud.
* Basic understanding of virtualization, servers, storage, networking, operating systems, and data centre infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Private Cloud, Hybrid Cloud, and on-premises infrastructure concepts.
* Basic knowledge of compute, storage, networking, IAM, backup, disaster recovery, security, and monitoring.
* Awareness of containers, Kubernetes, databases, and modern application architectures.
* Basic understanding of cloud pricing, infrastructure sizing, and cost estimation.
* Familiarity with architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and presentation tools.
* Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
* Willingness to learn customer-facing presales processes and enterprise solution design.

Preferred: Entry-level certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), or Google Cloud Digital Leader. Equivalent practical knowledge and project experience are also welcome.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a candidate who:

* Is curious about how enterprise IT workloads operate and where they should run.
* Understands the fundamentals of infrastructure rather than focusing exclusively on cloud product features.
* Can ask structured questions, analyze requirements, and document technical findings.
* Is interested in comparing Public Cloud, Private Cloud, Hybrid Cloud, and on-premises solutions.
* Can learn to balance technical suitability, cost, security, performance, and operational requirements.
* Is comfortable working with senior architects, sales teams, customers, and technical delivery teams.
* Demonstrates a consulting mindset, ownership, and a willingness to develop into an independent Cloud Solution Architect.

Learning and Development Expectations

The selected candidate will progressively learn to execute the following presales lifecycle:

Discovery → Assessment → Workload Classification → Architecture Support → Sizing → Platform Comparison → TCO Estimation → Proposal Development → POC Support → Technical Closure → Migration Planning → Delivery Handover

The initial focus will be on supporting senior architects and building strong fundamentals, with increasing responsibility for workload assessments, solution design, customer discussions, and technical proposals as experience develops.

For a 0–2-year candidate, the expectation is not to independently deliver a complete enterprise architecture, but to demonstrate structured thinking, sound technical fundamentals, an understanding of workload suitability, and the ability to recognize when guidance from a senior architect is required.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

Experience:

* Cloud Solution Architect / Cloud Presales Engineer: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:

* Okhla, Delhi, Delhi (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

8ad8e925.title: SAP BW4HANA Solution Architect
8ad8e925.description:

Integrated reporting BI Delivery Lead

**Solution Architect – SAP BW/4HANA** is responsible for designing and governing end-to-end SAP BW/4HANA-based data warehousing, reporting, and planning solutions that support enterprise financial reporting, planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes. This role owns the overall data and analytics architecture, ensuring scalable data models, efficient data flows, high system performance, and strong governance aligned with business and IT standards.

The architect partners closely with Finance (FP&A) and business stakeholders to translate functional reporting and planning requirements into optimized BW/4HANA data models, data flows, and analytics solutions, while providing technical leadership across data modeling, integration, performance optimization, and security. The role also drives architectural consistency, best practices, and adoption of modern SAP data and analytics capabilities across the landscape.

The Solution Architect ensures that BW/4HANA solutions are technically robust, business-aligned, future-ready, and seamlessly integrated with S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and other enterprise systems, while maintaining data integrity, compliance, and performance at scale.

You will be mainly accountable for:

* Own the **BW/4HANA data modeling strategy**, ensuring optimal layered architecture (LSA++), efficient data granularity, hierarchy design, and consistent master and transactional data across the landscape.Establish and enforce **enterprise data governance frameworks** within BW/4HANA, including data ownership, lifecycle management, auditability, and alignment with organizational standards.

* Define and implement robust **security and authorization concepts in BW/4HANA**, including analysis authorizations, role-based access, and data-level restrictions to meet compliance and segregation of duties requirements.Collaborate closely with **Finance, FP&A, and business stakeholders** to understand reporting and planning requirements, translating them into scalable BW/4HANA models and integrated SAC reporting/planning solutions.
* Provide **technical leadership and governance** to development teams, ensuring adherence to BW/4HANA architecture principles, modeling standards, naming conventions, and transport management processes. Review and guide solution designs to ensure **consistency, reusability, scalability, and alignment** with enterprise data and analytics architecture. Stay current with **SAP BW/4HANA, S/4HANA, and SAC innovations**, evaluating and adopting new capabilities to enhance performance, scalability, and overall business value.

**Qualifications for the role**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. SAP Analytics Cloud Planning and BW/4HANA certifications are preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in SAC Planning architecture and development. Proven track record of implementing large-scale planning models handling complex financial planning scenarios.
* In-depth knowledge of SAP BW/4HANA data modeling and integration techniques. Advanced skills in SAC Data Actions, Advanced Formulas, API-based data integrations, and predictive planning scenarios. Experience in financial planning processes (Budgeting, Forecasting, Rolling Forecasts) and a solid understanding of key financial metrics.
* Experience working on finance transformation programs involving SAC and enterprise-level ERP solutions.

**More about us:**

By joining ABB as a SAP Analytics Cloud Architect, you will be instrumental in developing and maintaining a robust Planning platform that enhances financial transparency, and supports strategic decision-making across the organization.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

4ad9974f.title: Technical Project Lead Solution Architect -Digital Lending, Fintech
4ad9974f.description:
**Experience:** 814 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Industry:** Fintech, Digital Lending, NBFC, AI/ML and Enterprise Software

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Technical Project Lead / Solution Architect to lead the design, development and launch of an AI-enabled digital lending and loan marketplace platform.

The platform will combine three core business capabilities:

1. **In-house lending:** Digital loan origination, underwriting, sanction, disbursement, loan servicing and collections.
2. **Lead generation:** Digital customer acquisition, lead management, campaign attribution, customer engagement and conversion analytics.
3. **NBFC marketplace:** Integration with multiple banks and NBFCs, loan-product discovery, eligibility assessment, lender matching and application routing.

The candidate will own the end-to-end technical delivery, from architecture and product requirements through development, integrations, testing, deployment and production operations. The role also involves integrating Agentic AI and voice-based AI solutions to automate customer acquisition, loan qualification, verification workflows and customer support.

Key Responsibilities

1. Architecture and Product Engineering

* Design a scalable, secure, API-first architecture for a multi-product digital lending platform.
* Define the architecture for mobile applications, web portals, backend services, databases, integrations and cloud infrastructure.
* Develop technical roadmaps, solution architecture diagrams, API specifications and data models.
* Decide appropriate architecture patterns, including modular monoliths and microservices where justified.
* Lead engineering teams across frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps and AI/ML.

2. Digital Lending and Loan Management

* Build or integrate a Loan Origination System (LOS) and Loan Management System (LMS).
* Implement digital onboarding, KYC workflows, credit bureau integrations, income verification and underwriting rules.
* Develop loan application, credit assessment, approval, sanction letter, e-signing, disbursement and repayment workflows.
* Integrate bank-account verification, payment gateways, e-NACH/UPI mandates and collection systems where applicable.
* Build dashboards for loan book performance, overdue accounts, collections, delinquency and portfolio analytics.
* Ensure the lending architecture supports configurable credit policies and multiple loan products.

3. NBFC Marketplace and Partner Integrations

* Design a lender integration framework using REST APIs, webhooks and secure data exchange.
* Build lender onboarding, product configuration, eligibility rules, application routing and offer comparison.
* Implement application status tracking, partner reconciliation, conversion reporting and commission calculations.
* Support integration with multiple NBFCs and banks without hard-coding lender-specific business logic into the entire application.
* Build monitoring and retry mechanisms for failed or delayed partner API transactions.

4. Agentic AI and Voice AI

* Design and deploy AI voice agents for inbound and outbound customer interactions.
* Build AI workflows for lead qualification, document collection, application assistance, reminders and customer support.
* Integrate speech-to-text, text-to-speech, LLMs, telephony platforms and CRM systems.
* Develop AI agents using tool calling, workflow orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and appropriate guardrails.
* Use AI for document extraction, application data validation, customer-query resolution and operational automation.
* Implement human escalation, conversation audit trails, consent controls, evaluation frameworks and monitoring.
* Ensure AI-generated recommendations do not bypass approved credit policies or required human approvals.

5. Lead Generation and Marketing Technology

* Build lead ingestion APIs, campaign tracking, referral workflows and lead-distribution engines.
* Integrate Google Ads, Meta Ads, app attribution platforms, CRM systems, call-centre software and marketing automation tools.
* Develop lead scoring, deduplication, routing, funnel analytics and source-level ROI dashboards.
* Automate follow-ups through approved communication channels.
* Track acquisition cost, qualified leads, application completion, sanction rate and disbursal conversion.

6. Technology Stack and Cloud Engineering

**Backend**

* Strong expertise in Java/Spring Boot or Node.js/NestJS.
* REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous processing, authentication and integration design.
* Python/FastAPI experience for AI services is highly desirable.

**Frontend and Mobile**

* React.js / Next.js for web applications.
* Flutter, React Native or native Android/iOS development.
* Responsive customer journeys and internal operations dashboards.

**Databases and Messaging**

* PostgreSQL or another enterprise relational database.
* Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ or cloud-managed messaging services.
* Data modelling, transaction management, caching and reliable event processing.

**AI/ML**

* LLM APIs, prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG and AI workflow orchestration.
* Voice AI, speech processing and telephony integrations.
* Python, model evaluation, monitoring and responsible AI practices.

**Cloud and DevOps**

* AWS or Azure.
* Docker, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and production observability.
* Automated testing, logging, incident management, security controls and disaster recovery.

The candidate is not expected to be an expert in every technology listed. Strong architectural depth, delivery ownership and the ability to lead specialists are essential.

7. Security and Regulatory Readiness

* Build security and privacy requirements into the application architecture.
* Implement role-based access control, encryption, audit trails, secrets management and secure API access.
* Support consent-based data collection, data-retention controls and borrower-data access restrictions.
* Work with compliance and lending partners to address applicable RBI digital lending requirements, KYC/AML obligations, borrower disclosures and grievance workflows.
* Ensure production systems support traceability of credit decisions, loan transactions and customer communications.

8. Project and Team Leadership

* Translate business requirements into technical specifications, development plans and release milestones.
* Manage sprint planning, dependencies, technical risks, delivery quality and release readiness.
* Review architecture, code quality, testing coverage, API design and security.
* Coordinate product managers, business stakeholders, NBFC partners, vendors and engineering teams.
* Establish engineering KPIs, production SLAs, incident response procedures and continuous improvement practices.

Mandatory Qualifications

* 8–14 years of overall experience in software engineering, solution architecture or technical project delivery.
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in fintech, digital lending, loan marketplaces, banking technology or financial-services platforms.
* Demonstrated experience building and launching a production-grade lending application, financial marketplace or comparable transaction-heavy platform.
* Strong understanding of LOS/LMS workflows, API integrations, databases, cloud infrastructure and secure application design.
* Experience leading cross-functional engineering teams and delivering complex products end to end.
* Practical experience integrating external financial services, identity verification, payment systems or enterprise APIs.
* Strong stakeholder communication, problem-solving and technical decision-making skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience building an NBFC marketplace or a multi-lender loan aggregation platform.
* Exposure to personal loans, consumer lending, business loans or unsecured credit products.
* Hands-on experience building Agentic AI applications, conversational AI or voice-based AI agents.
* Experience with credit bureau integrations, digital KYC, e-signature and payment mandate workflows.
* Experience with cloud-native architecture, event-driven systems, high-volume lead generation and customer acquisition platforms.
* Exposure to credit risk models, fraud detection, document intelligence and lending analytics.

Success Metrics

The candidate will be measured on:

* Delivery of the platform against agreed scope and milestones.
* Reliability and performance of lender and financial-services integrations.
* Reduction in application processing time and manual operational effort.
* Improvement in lead-to-application and application-to-disbursal conversion.
* Quality, security, auditability and maintainability of the platform.
* Successful deployment of production-ready AI and voice automation workflows.
* Engineering productivity, incident resolution and operating cost efficiency.

Interview Evaluation

Candidates should be able to demonstrate a system they personally helped architect or deliver. They should explain the architecture, technology choices, integrations, scale, security considerations, challenges and measurable outcomes.

**Candidates with only project coordination experience, without substantial ownership of architecture or production software delivery, should not be shortlisted.**

4a576a7b.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transforming mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping help make a significant impact on our clients' success achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Level:**
**AI and Data Solutions Engineer**
As an AI and Data Solutions Engineer at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
Lead discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on business architecture. Prepare technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create and enforce technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, manage deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional teams. Design templates or scripts to automate routine development or operational tasks.
  
  
**The team:**
AI & Data offers a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offering helps clients innovate, and enhance their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.
  
  
AI & Data professionals will work with our clients to:
  
  

* Design and modernize large-scale data and analytics platforms including data management, governance and the integration of structured and unstructured data to generate insights leveraging cloud, edge and AI/ML technologies, platforms and methodologies for storage, processing
* Leverage automation, cognitive and AI based solutions to manage data, predict scenarios and prescribe actions
* Drive operational efficiency by managing and upgrading their data ecosystems and application platforms, utilizing analytics expertise and providing As-a-Service models to ensure continuous insights and enhancements.

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 6-9 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
* Proficiency in cloud architecture design in any of the given areas – AWS/Azure/GCP Architecture.

**AWS Architect**

* Experience in provisioning and spinning up AWS EC2 instances - on-Demand, Spot, dedicated instances, and cost calculation.
* Experience with server less architecture (Lambda), API gateway and RESTful services/JSON etc.
* Experience with one or more relational databases on AWS RDS – Oracle/ SQL Server/ MySQL and/or cloud data warehouse databases such as AWS Redshift
* Exposure to Data migration facilities such as DMS, S3 COPY, streaming, Kinesis, Batch
* Experience in developing applications on AWS Cloud infrastructure.
* Exposure to DevOps tools, deployment and orchestration technologies such as AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, AWS CodePipeline etc.
* Experience with monitoring resources and applications using CloudWatch metrics, alarms and logs and tracking user activity, API usage using CloudTrail
* Experience with cloud assessment and migration on-premise workloads onto AWS.
* Expertise in AWS Architecture, Automation Tools and understanding of the agile development process.
* Experience in Migration from on-prem to Cloud using AWS migration tools
* Experience with VPN connectivity between regions and subnets
* Experience with Business Continuity and Disaster Recover design, planning and implementation for cloud infrastructures
* Exposure to one or more - Python, Perl, Ruby or UNIX shell scripting.
* Experience working with AWS Command line utility (CLI) and SDKs.
* Exposure to EMR, Elasticsearch, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Athena, WAF, CloudHMS, Direct Connect, Glue, Load balancer
* Expertise in SPARK programming using Scala or Pyspark or Java
* Experience with cloud security architectures – Encryption (Rest & Motion)

**Azure Architect**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and a strong understanding of Azure capabilities and limitations with demonstrated experience in end-to-end deployment of MS Azure BI solution(s)
* Experience in migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.
* Experience in defining highly available, DR solutions in Azure
* Experience in assessing applications for cloud adoption and define Cloud strategy for enterprise
* Experience in using agile methodologies in implementing Azure solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Tools for system management, monitoring, automation, and agile development
* Design and develop robust, scalable solutions for collecting, analyzing large data sets, creating, and maintaining data pipelines, data structures and/or support of highly distributed applications
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure data platform, including Azure Data Factory (ADF),Azure Databricks, Azure Data Flow, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics / erstwhile Azure Data Warehouse (SQLDW), Event Hubs, Stream Analytics, Data Lake Store, Data Lake Analytics, U-SQL, HDInsight, Azure Analysis Services, Azure Purview, Power Apps, Power BI and PowerShell Scripting
* Configure large database solutions in Azure using SQL Server / Azure SQL DWH / Synapse and optimize the existing or new solutions as and when needed for optimum performance.
* Build data lake from multiple data sources with ingestion, data governance and auditing capabilities
* Experience in any of Programming/Scripting languages - Bash, PySpark, Scala, Python, PowerShell, Ruby – would be preferred
* Experience in defining cloud strategy for enterprise for but not limited to migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.

**GCP Architect**

* Experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, and technical consulting with expertise in architecting and rolling out new technology and solution initiatives.
* Experience working with recommendation engines, data pipelines, or distributed machine learning and experience with data analytics and data visualization techniques and software.
* Experience in GCP Dataflow, BigQuery, Dataproc, Datalab, Dataprep, Pub/Sub and Genomics
* Experience with core Data Science techniques such as regression, classification or clustering, and experience with deep learning frameworks (such as TensorFlow, Torch, Caffe, Theano, etc).
* Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to-be solutions in alignment with business outcomes
* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem
* Enable delivery teams and act as mentor by providing optimal delivery solutions with automations and frameworks for improved productivity
* Implement proof of concepts to validate cloud concepts, architecture and requirements and environments (such as Apache Beam, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, MapReduce, Flume).
* Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to-be solutions in alignment with business outcomes
* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem
* Enable delivery teams and act as mentor by providing optimal delivery solutions with automations and frameworks for improved productivity
* Implement proof of concepts to validate cloud concepts, architecture and requirements.
* Knowledge of cloud computing includes virtualization, hosted services, multi-tenant cloud infrastructures, storage systems and content delivery networks.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in Cloud Computing (Public/Private/Hybrid) specifically on Cloud first application development
* Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Experience maintaining internet facing production-grade applications in virtualized environments in AWS Cloud Platform.
* Experience writing scripts in one or more languages such as Python, UNIX Scripting and/or similar.
* AWS/Azure/GCP Certified Associate or Professional

**Education**
:
  
  

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc degree or equivalent from accredited university

b564c41f.title: Application Consultant-AWS Cloud
b564c41f.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Application Consultant for AWS Cloud, you will lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement and utilize your strong understanding of software architecture fundamentals to drive project success. You will collaborate with clients to deliver successful projects, leveraging your proficiency in cloud implementation methodologies like the garage method.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Implement Cloud Architecture: Lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement, utilizing your knowledge of software architecture fundamentals and cloud native development principles to ensure successful project delivery.
* Collaborate with Clients: Work closely with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions, leveraging your strong communication and leadership skills to ensure effective collaboration and project success.
* Map Components to AWS Services: Utilize your experience with AWS to map existing components and functionalities to AWS-specific services, ensuring seamless integration and optimal system performance.
* Develop Cloud Solutions: Apply your proficiency in technologies like Node.js, Spring Boot, or Netflix OSS to develop cloud solutions that meet client needs and adhere to cloud native development principles.
* Provide Technical Guidance: Offer technical guidance and support to clients, leveraging your knowledge of cloud computing fundamentals, containers, and serverless computing to help them make informed decisions about their cloud architecture.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Software Architecture Fundamentals: Exposure to software architecture fundamentals, including design patterns and principles, to lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement.
* Cloud Implementation Methodologies: Proficiency in using the garage method for cloud implementation, with experience working with cloud native development principles, containers, and serverless computing fundamentals.
* API and Microservices Architecture: Experience working with API and Microservices-based architecture implementation, with proficiency in at least one of the following technologies: Node.js, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or Netflix OSS.
* AWS Services Mapping: Experience with AWS, including the ability to map existing components/functionalities to AWS-specific services, with a solid understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services.
* Cloud Development Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript, CSS, and familiarity with Angular.js, with the ability to apply this knowledge to develop cloud solutions.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Familiarity with Scripting Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript and CSS is beneficial for developing cloud solutions. Knowledge of these technologies can be applied to create tailored solutions for clients.
* Knowledge of Angular.js: Familiarity with Angular.js is advantageous for developing cloud solutions, allowing for more versatile and effective solutions to be delivered to clients.

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Salesforce Industries is looking to expand our Professional Services Global Delivery Center team by hiring talented and enthusiastic Industry Solution Architects.
  
  
Salesforce Industries’ goal is to deliver rapid, value-driven customer solutions for complex business problems. Our Industry Solution Architects play a key role in determining the optimal use of the Vlocity product in the customer environment.
  
  
We are looking for industry experts who are passionate about the digital transformation of Health Domain and customer experience. Your responsibility is to understand the customer’s business requirements, design, and configure the desired solution.
  
  
This is a focused team of industry experts whose mission is to work with our largest and most important customers and implementation partners to deliver solutions that delight the customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Effective in working with customers, including business executives, business analysts, and IT development staff
* Effective in understanding business needs and distilling the information into business and technical requirements
* Comfortable working with complex business requirements and translating into the design of solutions, including insurance product configuration, rate models, user stories, business rules, etc.
* Speed is paramount. This team is nimble and is the fulcrum to accelerate the delivery of the solution for customers.
* A collaborative and empathetic relationship with the business stakeholders will be central to your role. Your commitment to their success should never be in doubt.
* You’ll be a key channel back to the Salesforce Industries product management team as they look to drive innovation and improvements into future releases of Industry Cloud products.
* If you enjoy working with customers to help them succeed and thrive on working with leading-edge technologies, this is the role for you.
* This role will require travel to customer locations.

**Experience**

* At least 8+ years of Healthcare Industry Experience
* Involved in the Implementation of healthcare solutions at operators
* Demonstrated Ability in Healthcare domain or Health Cloud
* Engage business users to understand requirements and create solution designs
* Help in mapping business requirements to Salesforce Industry(SFI) Vlocity product functionality
* Identifies ‘What to implement’ in Vlocity CRM and ‘Solution’ level designs
* Able to evaluate the long-term impact of implementing a capability - Any conflict or limitations, impact on operations, roadmaps, or upgrades
* Knowledge of Salesforce Platform
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Collaborate with internal team members (sales/pre-sales, engineering, other services teams, etc.) to help customers increase the value of their Salesforce Industry products and services (Health Cloud)
* You will have a proven track record of successful delivery of customer projects, preferably enterprise CRM implementations for Telecom clients
* You will have direct experience in working with Salesforce (at an Admin level, minimum)
* You’ll be a self-starter, adept at picking up new skills and technologies, and eager to break new ground
* You’ll have excellent communication skills to communicate with customers, partners, and internal team members
* You’ll have the vision to help us take our company to the next level

**Technical Skills**

* Ability to technically lead complex projects throughout the complete IT lifecycle (Analysis, Architecture, Design, Build, Test & Production)
* Hands-On experience of
* Process modeling tools and best practices
* Project management tools and best practices
* Data modeling
* Systems analysis and design

**Desired Certifications/Qualification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business or a related field
* Salesforce Sales/Service Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Administrator
* Salesforce Developer
* Certified Scrum Master / Certified Product Owner

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

0bc12412.title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L3)
0bc12412.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L3) at NTT DATA, your primary role will be to provide exceptional service to our clients by proactively identifying and resolving technical incidents. You will ensure that client infrastructure is configured, tested, and operational, leveraging your deep technical expertise to solve complex problems and enhance our service quality.
  
  
Part of your Responsibilities will entail pre-emptive service incident resolution, product reviews, and operational improvements. You will manage high-complexity tickets, perform advanced tasks, and provide diverse solutions while ensuring zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions. Your role will also involve mentoring junior team members and working across various technology domains such as Cloud, Security, Networking, and Applications.
  
  
You will conduct necessary checks, apply monitoring tools, and respond to alerts, identifying issues before they become problems. Logging incidents with the required level of detail, you will analyse, assign, and escalate support calls. Additionally, you will proactively identify opportunities for optimization and automation, ensuring continuous feedback to clients and affected parties.
  
  
Important responsibility is to create knowledge articles for frequent tasks/issues and train junior team members in executing those tasks. Provide inputs to automation teams to reduce manual efforts.
  
  
You will engage with third-party vendors when necessary and keep systems and portals updated as prescribed. As a senior engineer, you will coach L2 teams on advanced troubleshooting techniques and support the implementation and delivery of projects, disaster recovery functions, and more, ensuring all actions adhere to client requirements and timelines.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Extensive Managed Services experience handling complex cross-technology infrastructure.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes.
* Proven experience working with vendors and/or third parties.
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Effective planning skills, even in changing circumstances.
* Positive outlook and ability to work well under pressure.
* Active listening skills and adaptability to changing client needs.
* Client-focused approach to create positive client experiences throughout their journey.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
