cf9a2769.title: Data Platform Architect
cf9a2769.description:
**Data Platform Architect**

**Location:** India, (Remote)

**Type of Role:** Fulltime/ Contract

**Time Zone / Shift:** Must be able to work UK shift hours and maintain meaningful overlap with UK business hours. Flexibility to support Eastern Time (EST) working hours may also be required based on business and team needs.

**Overview:** An organization is seeking a Data Platform Architect to define, design, and govern its enterprise data platform architecture supporting analytics, operational reporting, and emerging AI/ML use cases. This role establishes architectural direction across cloud data platforms, data warehousing, and ETL/ELT integration capabilities, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, cost-efficient, reliable, and aligned with enterprise standards and business priorities.

The Data Platform Architect will work closely with Data Platform Product Management, Data Engineering, Analytics, Cloud Engineering, Security, and Enterprise Architecture teams to translate business and data requirements into implementable technical architectures. The role provides hands-on architectural leadership, establishes reference architectures and design patterns, guides technology selection, and ensures that security, compliance, governance, reliability, and financial efficiency are built into platform design and operations.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, technically strong leader who takes initiative, drives architectural decisions, advises engineering teams, and translates high-level architecture into practical implementation guidance. Deep expertise in Snowflake, data lakes, cloud data platforms, and enterprise data architecture is essential. The candidate should be comfortable taking ownership, influencing technical direction, resolving complex data architecture challenges, and guiding distributed engineering teams.

Offshore and nearshore candidates are welcome, provided they can work UK shift hours and maintain the required overlap with UK business hours. Flexibility to collaborate with teams operating in Eastern Time (EST) may also be required. Healthcare domain experience is preferred but not mandatory and will be considered a bonus.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve the enterprise data platform architecture strategy, including architecture standards, reference architectures, and design patterns aligned with business priorities, analytics requirements, and AI/ML enablement.
* Design and govern enterprise data platforms across cloud environments, including data warehousing, data lakes, data integration, and analytics platforms.
* Evaluate, recommend, and govern data platforms and ETL/ELT technologies, balancing scalability, performance, security, cost, and operational maturity while minimizing unnecessary platform complexity.
* Establish and maintain enterprise architecture documentation, including current-state and target-state designs, architecture diagrams, technical standards, and architecture decision records.
* Review and guide data platform and pipeline designs to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, scalability requirements, and technical best practices.
* Define and standardize ETL/ELT and data integration patterns, including batch processing, streaming, and event-driven integration, to support analytics, operational reporting, and downstream data consumption.
* Provide technical leadership to Data Engineering, Analytics, Cloud Engineering, and platform teams, translating architecture standards into implementable solutions and guiding technical decisions.
* Take initiative in identifying architectural gaps, recommending improvements, resolving technical challenges, and driving platform design decisions with minimal supervision.
* Advise and mentor engineering teams on data architecture, platform implementation, design patterns, technology selection, and engineering best practices.
* Design layered data architectures covering ingestion, transformation, data repositories, and consumption to deliver analytics-ready datasets for reporting, operational analytics, and AI/ML workloads.
* Establish architectural standards for platform reliability, high availability, disaster recovery, observability, deployment automation, environment management, and lifecycle management.
* Embed security, privacy, and regulatory compliance requirements into platform architecture, including access controls, encryption, data lineage, retention, and secure data ingestion.
* Partner with Security, Risk, Compliance, and Enterprise Architecture teams to support architecture governance and ensure alignment with enterprise policies and regulatory requirements.
* Guide cost-efficient platform architecture through workload optimization, resource right-sizing, platform lifecycle management, and collaboration with FinOps and Cloud Engineering teams.
* Evaluate emerging data platform technologies, architecture patterns, and AI-powered data engineering capabilities, recommending adoption based on business value, technical maturity, and risk.
* Support automation and engineering efficiency through infrastructure-as-code concepts, CI/CD practices, and AI-enabled data engineering workflows.
* Lead technical design discussions and architecture reviews, communicate trade-offs, and ensure engineering teams can translate architectural decisions into scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Establish and communicate clear architectural direction across data warehousing, data lakes, cloud storage, data integration, and downstream data consumption.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 7+ years of experience in database engineering, including 3+ years in database architecture design and support.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise data platforms across cloud environments, particularly Azure and Google Cloud.
* Deep knowledge of Snowflake as an enterprise data warehouse platform, including its architecture, data modeling, performance optimization, scalability, and governance.
* Deep expertise in data lakes, enterprise data architecture, data storage, and modern cloud-based data platform design.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern data platforms and services, including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle.
* Strong understanding of Azure cloud storage and data services, including the design and integration of scalable storage solutions for enterprise data workloads.
* Hands-on experience with Matillion for ETL/ELT orchestration, data integration, and data pipeline development, including designing, implementing, monitoring, and optimizing data workflows for enterprise data platforms.
* Strong technical proficiency in SQL and Python, with the ability to prototype solutions, review and optimize data pipelines, and guide engineering implementation.
* Experience designing enterprise data architectures, including layered data processing patterns, data modeling, analytics platforms, and governed data repositories.
* Strong understanding of data integration patterns and the secure integration of internal and external data sources.
* Experience designing scalable, analytics-ready datasets that support enterprise reporting, operational analytics, and AI/ML use cases.
* Knowledge of data governance, metadata, data lineage, privacy, security controls, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience defining architecture standards for reliability, performance, high availability, disaster recovery, observability, and operational readiness.
* Ability to translate business and data requirements into practical architecture designs, technical standards, and implementation guidance for engineering teams.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts through clear architecture diagrams and documentation.
* Ability to evaluate technology options, communicate architectural trade-offs, and influence technical decisions across multiple teams.
* Demonstrated initiative, ownership, and leadership in driving architecture decisions, proactively identifying problems, and recommending effective solutions.
* Ability to advise engineering teams, provide hands-on technical guidance, and lead architecture discussions across cross-functional and distributed teams.
* Comfortable working in Agile or Waterfall delivery environments.
* Ability to collaborate with distributed teams and work UK shift hours, with flexibility to support Eastern Time (EST) working hours when required.

**Nice to Have**

* Master’s degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Experience with healthcare payer data domains, including claims, eligibility, provider, member, care management, utilization management, or regulatory reporting. Healthcare experience is preferred but not mandatory.
* Experience designing API-based data integrations using Apigee.
* Experience integrating enterprise systems such as Salesforce, FACETS, and ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, deployment automation, and CI/CD practices for data platforms.
* Experience enabling AI/ML workloads through scalable, secure, and well-governed data architectures.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, FinOps practices, platform right-sizing, and technology lifecycle management.
* Experience participating in enterprise architecture review boards, governance forums, or technical design reviews.
* Familiarity with emerging data engineering technologies and AI-powered automation for data platform development and operations.

Pay: ₹4,000,000.00 - ₹5,000,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

23f48a6b.title: AI Principle Architect
23f48a6b.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

AI Principle ArchitectMastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

All About You  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
* The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

dcfb2cc0.description:
Overview of 66degrees
  
  
66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.
  
  
At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
  
  
**Overview Of 66degrees**
66degrees is a leading consulting and professional services company specializing in developing AI-focused, data-led solutions leveraging the latest advancements in cloud technology. With our unmatched engineering capabilities and vast industry experience, we help the world's leading brands transform their business challenges into opportunities and shape the future of work.
  
  
At 66degrees, we believe in embracing the challenge and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
  
  
**Overview Of Role**
66degrees is looking for creative, dedicated, and personable technology business professionals for a Cloud Architect position. We are looking for someone with a broad range of technical and consulting skills and aptitude. Our ideal candidate will display relentless curiosity and drive around how we organize ourselves and deploy/use technology to ensure our clients GCP environments are reliable and secure. We are looking for the right fit with our growing organization and we will invest in training.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build a trusted advisory relationship with strategic accounts and engage with management.
* Identify customer priorities, technical objections, and design strategies encompassing the Google ecosystem to deliver business growth and resolve blockers.
* Lead requirements gathering and project scoping.
* Solution design, problem-solving, and architecture diagramming.
* Provide domain expertise around public cloud and enterprise technology, and effectively promote Google Cloud with clients, at conferences, and online.
* Provide recommendations on integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure needed to implement a complete solution for clients.
* Lead planning, status, and standup meetings.
* Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of GCP experience is a must. Experience in other clouds is beneficial.
* GCP Architect Certification required, other certifications for Google, Kubernetes, or Terraform a plus.
* Must have played 2+ years as a GCP Architect.
* Experience in building, architecting, designing, and implementing distributed global cloud-based systems.
* Extensive experience with security (zero trust) and networking in cloud environments
* Capable of advising and implementing CI/CD practices to clients using tools such as GitHub, GitLab, Cloud Build, and Cloud Deploy and concepts such as GitOps and GitFlow.
* Experience in containerising workloads using Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and Artifact Registry.
* Experience with structured Cloud Architecture practices, hybrid cloud deployments, and on-premises-to-cloud migration deployments and roadmaps.
* Knowledge of technology solutions and ability to learn emerging technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the Cloud/IT technology space.
* Ability to work cross-functionally, engage and influence audiences.
* Excellent organisational skills and customer-facing communication.
* Proficiency in documentation and knowledge transfer using remote meetings, written documents, and technical diagrams slide decks.
* Experience in implementing hybrid connectivity using VPN or Cloud Interconnect is a plus.

*66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*
***Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.***

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*

As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools—including LinkedIn Recruiter’s Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies—to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights.
  
  
These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

ccfd45c1.title: Solutions Acceleration Architect, Data
ccfd45c1.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with Big Data technologies or concepts, such as analytics warehousing, data processing, data transformation, data governance, data migrations, extract, transform, load (ETL), extract, load, transform (ELT), SQL, NoSQL, performance or scalability optimizations, or batch versus streaming.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 10 years of experience in cloud computing, with a focus on data architecture, data analytics, and data engineering, in a customer-facing or consulting role.
* Experience in architecting and developing software or infrastructure for scalable, distributed systems.
* Experience understanding customer requirements, breaking them down into actionable components, and designing technical architectures to meet those needs.
* Experience managing stakeholder expectations and building consensus around complex technical projects.
* Experience with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL), streaming data (e.g., Kafka), big data and data warehousing solutions.

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
The Google Forge Team partners with customers to bring their goals to life. We collaborate closely to understand their tests and ideas, then design and build practical working solutions using data, analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and software engineering. Our goal is to demonstrate how these technologies can work together to achieve impactful business results.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the design and development of prototypes, demonstrating the transformative power of data, analytics, AI, and software engineering to solve complex business challenges for our customers. You will play a key role in mentoring team members and contributing to the strategic direction of our solution-building efforts.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, and iterative refinement of data-centric and AI-powered solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), showcasing the potential of data and AI to address specific business needs.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their business challenges, technical requirements, and strategic objectives.
* Mentor and guide team members, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning.
* Establish and promote innovative best practices and methodologies for data-motivated solutions, actively contributing to industry thought leadership through publications, presentations, and community engagement.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with customers and stakeholders.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

9d1b7030.title: SAP Business Data Cloud Consultant
9d1b7030.description:
**Job Description**

You design and deliver SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) solutions for our clients. You know Datasphere and SAC well, and you can do real data science on top of them. What sets you apart is how you think about data and people. You ask what a user needs to decide, test whether the numbers hold up, and understand why people trust one dashboard and ignore another.

**What you will do**

* Model data in SAP Datasphere: spaces, views, analytic models, semantic layers
* Build stories and planning models in SAP Analytics Cloud
* Work with SAP data products and help clients move from BW to BDC
* Build or extend models in SAP Databricks: forecasting, segmentation, anomaly detection
* Run discovery sessions with finance, supply chain and operations users
* Define KPIs with the business and check that each one measures what it claims
* Study how users actually work: interviews, short surveys, usage data. Use what you learn to shape design and training.

**What you bring**

* 2+ years hands-on with SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud or BW/4HANA
* Working data science skills: Python or R, statistics, and at least one model you built that someone used
* Working knowledge of S/4HANA data in at least one area: finance, supply chain or sales
* Solid SQL and data modeling
* Client-facing experience, ideally with US clients. You can run a session and write a clear status update.
* Some overlap with US working hours
* A habit of checking data quality before you build on it

**What sets you apart**

* A degree or coursework in psychology, behavioral science or cognitive science
* Experience with user research, survey design or experiment design
* An understanding of how people judge numbers: trust, bias, information overload
* Databricks or MLflow experience
* Change management or end-user training experience
* SAP certification in Datasphere or SAC

**What we give you**

* BDC projects across the full stack, from data products to AI use cases
* Work with SAP AppHaus design methods on real client problems
* Paid certification and time to learn new BDC features as they ship
* A path to BDC Lead or Solution Architect

6823d113.title: AMS Cloud EPM ARCS Consultant
6823d113.description:
Overview:
  
At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
  
Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
  
What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
  
This role requires a balance of client relationship management, operational oversight, and strategic thinking to ensure services are delivered efficiently and aligned with evolving client business needs.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
This role requires candidates to work in IST hours from 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM and have a minimum of 6+ years of relevant professional experience.
  
While this is a remote opportunity open to candidates across India, applicants based in Hyderabad or Bangalore will be preferred, as these are our primary hiring locations.
  
  
The consultant will work as part of the Application Managed Services (AMS) / Support team, providing ongoing functional and technical support for Oracle ARCS (Account Reconciliation Cloud Service) and related EPM Cloud applications. The role focuses on ensuring smooth reconciliation processes, resolving production issues, and supporting business users in financial close activities.
  
  
- Provide L2/L3 support for Oracle ARCS including Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching modules
  
- Monitor and support month-end and period-end reconciliation processes to ensure timely completion
  
- Resolve issues related to reconciliations, matching rules, data loads, profiles, and automated business rules
  
- Troubleshoot and fix issues in ARCS configurations, security, reports, and workflow processes
  
- Support data integration activities between ERP/source systems and ARCS, including validation and reconciliation
  
- Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and provide permanent fixes or workarounds
  
- Assist in data validation, tie-outs, and discrepancy resolution between source systems and ARCS
  
- Handle incident tickets, service requests, and minor enhancement requests within SLA timelines
  
- Support user access, security roles, and application maintenance activities
  
- Coordinate with technical teams for system issues, enhancements, and integration fixes
  
- Maintain support documentation, knowledge base articles, and issue resolution logs
  
- Ensure adherence to ITIL processes (incident, problem, and change management)
  
- Support business users during financial close cycles and audit-related activities
  
- Participate in shift-based support as required for global clients
  
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience
  
- 6–10 years of experience in Oracle ARCS / FCCS implementation or support (AMS preferred)
  
- Hands-on experience in Oracle EPM Cloud support or post-go-live environments
  
- Exposure to FDM / FDMEE / Data Management tools
  
- Understanding of reconciliation processes, financial close cycle, and reporting
  
- Knowledge of GAAP, IFRS, SOX compliance, and financial controls
  
- Experience with ERP systems (Oracle, SAP, PeopleSoft, etc.)
  
- Strong skills in data reconciliation, issue troubleshooting, and analysis
  
- Exposure to intercompany eliminations, currency translation, and financial reporting concepts
  
- Familiarity with Smart View and Financial Reporting tools
  
- Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  
- Ability to work in a client-facing AMS/support environment
  
- Alignment with delivery values: ownership, teamwork, can-do attitude, and client focus
  
  
Compensation:
  
Peloton provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including
  
- Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus
  
  
- Vacation, Leave, and Holiday pay
  
  
- Annual Health Wallet
  
  
- Group Medical Insurance
  
  
- Group Term Accident & Life Insurance
  
  
- Paid holidays and PTO
  
  
Peloton Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

b54f5583.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
b54f5583.description:
**Job Description**
Works with management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain. Establishes scope and milestones for each aspect of a technical program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals. Manages technical programs and complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business. Manages highly complex issues, bottlenecks and/or risks, escalating issues when appropriate. Leads technical program improvement, implementing best practices and driving cross-team process optimizations to improve processes. Leads efforts to integrate continuous improvement within technical programs, driving insights across many workstreams to generate recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies. Facilitates collaboration across multiple teams, driving technical discussions that align priorities and program goals. Provides technical expertise, direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams. Creates and automates reporting, partnering with development teams to continue improving reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models to help manage technical program execution. Acts as a technical liaison with or between stakeholder teams, driving effective collaboration for customer success within Oracle commitments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:**
– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.
  
  
– Ensures that product or service delivery meets the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.
  
  
– Drives rapid response to security escalations, coordinating across teams and communicating to executives to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and align and execute optimal proposed path to resolution.
  
  
– Forecasts program demands and resourcing to identify risks and ensure that goals are achievable.
  
  
– Leads the development and implementation of evolving processes to ensure that organizational SLAs are met.
  
  
**Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:**
– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify, track, and manage program dependencies and risks.
  
  
– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.
  
  
– Supports planning by identifying dependencies and risks.
  
  
– Develops delivery standards and guidelines in alignment with Oracle best practices.
  
  
– Identifies and quantifies opportunities for process automations and advocates for prioritization.
  
  
– Contributes to incident management efforts and identifies opportunities to improve processes, as applicable.
  
  
**Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:**
– Aligns priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to senior leadership.
  
  
– Establishes scope and milestones for each program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals.
  
  
– Assists in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for program performance against established goals (e.g., scope, timelines, deliverable quality).
  
  
– Builds, maintains, and executes a clear communication strategy of objectives to partners and customers, influencing decision-making regarding best practices for Oracle systems.
  
  
**Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:**
– Manages both technical and non-technical programs and complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.
  
  
– Guides the work of program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success) while providing technical support and direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.
  
  
– Maintains comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and documents risks and issues.
  
  
– Ensures attention to detail in program management from planning to execution and reporting.
  
  
– Leads regular program status meetings and keeps teams and leadership informed.
  
  
– Leads initiatives within the team to improve operational efficiency and enhance adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity targets.
  
  
– Ensures ownership and accountability for forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.
  
  
– Guides the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, or requirement changes.
  
  
**Program Oversight - Risk Management:**
– Manages highly complex issues, bottlenecks and/or risks, escalating issues when appropriate.
  
  
– Conducts comprehensive assessments of costs, benefits, and return on investment (ROI) to inform decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.
  
  
– Manages critical issues while making trade-offs between business needs and technical constraints.
  
  
– Removes blockers for the program and identifies new technical and resource options to efficiently deliver solutions and drive adoption.
  
  
**Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:**
– Leads program improvement, implementing best practices and driving cross-team process optimizations to improve processes.
  
  
– Organizes and develops program objectives and workflows, while testing and deploying cross-functional solutions to address critical business problems.
  
  
– Collaborates with management to initiate and maintain processes and procedures that guide and assist teams in reaching their goals.
  
  
**Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:**
– Leads efforts to integrate continuous improvement within programs, driving insights across many workstreams to generate recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies.
  
  
– Develops and standardizes data-driven decision-making frameworks, ensuring insights drive efficiencies.
  
  
– Identifies and addresses gaps to facilitate business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.
  
  
– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.
  
  
– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.
  
  
**Collaboration and Program Leadership - Cross Functional Collaboration:**
– Facilitates collaboration across multiple teams, driving discussions that align priorities and program goals.
  
  
– Leads medium-scale efforts to optimize processes, identifying and implementing solutions that enhance team efficiency.
  
  
– Delivers program updates, risks, and opportunities to managers and leadership, influencing decision-making.
  
  
– Develops relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring their perspectives are integrated into program planning and execution.
  
  
**Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:**
– Leads programs to continuously improve organizational efficiency.
  
  
– Provides technical direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams.
  
  
– Influences and guides change at all levels of the group from initiation through delivery.
  
  
– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.
  
  
**Data and Analysis:**
– Creates and automates reporting, partnering with development teams to continue improving reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models to help manage program execution.
  
  
– Utilizes data to solve moderately complex problems impacting the success of the program(s), including adherence to SLAs.
  
  
– Conducts analysis on a small number of data sources with moderate complexity, which may include competitive analysis, trend analysis, and KPI analysis, to drive data-informed decisions to support the program goals, presenting findings with immediate teams stakeholders.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement:**
– Acts as a liaison with or between stakeholder teams, driving effective collaboration for customer success within Oracle commitments.
  
  
– Manages relationships with internal and external stakeholders to align program priorities and commitments.
  
  
– Identifies and documents stakeholder needs and works cross-functionally to implement solutions that enhance satisfaction.
  
  
– Identifies risks to customer satisfaction and advocates for improvements or mitigation.
  
  
– Assesses risks to customer satisfaction and evaluates mitigation efforts, providing solutions to the immediate team and related teams to ensure alignment on resolving these risks.
  
  
– Helps balance team priorities and Oracle commitments to ensure optimal coverage and response to key customer needs, minimizing risks to the program.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**
– Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
**Collaboration & Partnership:**
– Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
**Problem Solving:**
– Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
**Continuous Learning:**
– Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
– Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
**Performance and Development:**
– Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. 0703566e.title: Technical Program Manager II - AI Platforms
0703566e.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
  
  
As the Technical Program Manager for AI Platform, you’ll turn our internal AI components and platform foundations into golden paths for the Product & Tech teams shipping AI experiences to customers. You’ll align roadmaps on shared components, establish clear owners, and make platform leverage visible through metrics and reporting.
  
  
**You Will**

* Own the shared-foundations program. Maintain the view of components that multiple feature teams need (agent handoff, identity, context, memory, governance, and more). Drive a single accountable owner, clear roles, and decision dates for each, overlaying team roadmaps without replacing them.
* Drive cross-team decisions to closure. Frame the decisions that unblock architecture, sequence product, UX, and engineering inputs, and run working sessions with named owners and dated action items.
* Scale an innersource model. Partner with engineering to establish a contribution-based approach for shared AI components: versioned templates, reference implementations, and docs that anyone can improve through review, with clear guidelines, release processes, and safe staged rollout.
* Report on platform scorecard. Define metrics that capture ecosystem leverage, adoption, quality, and team velocity. Set baselines and targets, secure instrumentation, and bring the results into leadership and stakeholder reporting.
* Reduce duplication. Identify capabilities built in multiple places and drive consolidation/unification, tracking those migration plans across teams.
* Partner on governance. Work with security, identity, audit, and legal teams to continually iterate and track responsible AI requirements within the platform.
* Communicate clearly. Write decision-first updates tailored to leaders and project stakeholders.

**You Have**

* 2-4 years of technical program management on platform, infrastructure, or developer-experience programs spanning many teams and timezones.
* Fluency in LLM & agent systems: orchestration, tool use, MCP, memory, context, evals.
* Experience defining platform or developer metrics: baselines, targets, instrumentation, and adoption measures. You’ve made invisible infrastructure work visible to leadership.
* Experience enabling shared components through SDK-style or innersource models, including versioning and release management.
* Proven ability to lead without authority across engineering, product, UX, and security.
* Strong planning discipline: dependency mapping, risk tracking, capacity awareness.
* Excellent written communication, especially decision memos and executive reporting.
* Legally eligible and available to work a hybrid schedule in BLR office.
* Fluency in English is required.

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with agent interoperability protocols and data platform governance tooling.
* Experience consolidating internal systems and managing build/buy/adopt decisions.
* Familiarity with AI governance, agent identity, auditing, and compliance.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, GitLab, and work-management tools at scale.

**Get To Know Us**
At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

6e1ee42f.title: Program Manager (Heat Forecast)
6e1ee42f.description:
Title: Program Manager (Heat Forecast)
  
  
Location and Work Authorization: New Delhi, India preferred. Candidates must have existing authorization to work in India; PxD is unable to sponsor visas for this role.
  
  
Position: Full-time
  
  
Compensation: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.
  
  
Application Deadline: 10 November 2026, 6 PM IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
  
  
**About The Role**
Precision Development (PxD) is seeking a Program Manager to lead the delivery and scale-up of PxD's heat initiative in India — bringing AI-based heat forecasts and actionable heat advisories to agriculture and livestock farmers, with a particular focus on government partnerships and coordination across delivery channels.
  
  
You will build and maintain strong relationships with relevant government institutions — including agriculture, animal husbandry, meteorological, dairy cooperatives and disaster management agencies — and coordinate closely with PxD's research, technology, program, and country teams. You will play a central role in moving the heat use case from formative research and pilot to delivery at scale, aligning partners, content, timelines, and channels so that farmers receive timely, consistent heat guidance.
  
  
This is a chance to help farmers protect their crops, animals, and livelihoods from increasingly frequent and severe heatwaves, at a moment when advances in AI forecasting make earlier and more localized heat warnings possible.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are below.
  
  
Government Relations & Partnerships
  
  

* Build and maintain strong working relationships with central and state government institutions involved in heat early warning, weather and climate services, agriculture extension, and animal husbandry, serving as a key point of contact for PxD's heat initiative
* Coordinate with government stakeholders to secure approvals and support for the implementation, alignment, and scale-up of heat advisory activities, and identify opportunities to integrate heat advisories into government systems such as heat action plans, extension platforms, and existing advisory services
* Engage with forecasting and technical partners to align on the use of AI-based heat forecast products
* Represent PxD in government meetings, technical working groups, workshops, conferences, and other external forums

Use Case, Pilot & Channel Coordination
  
  

* Work with the research team to translate formative research findings into a heat advisory use case for crop and livestock farmers, and support the planning and execution of pilots
* Coordinate across the channels used to deliver heat forecasts and advisories (e.g. voice calls, IVR, SMS, WhatsApp, extension workers), working closely with program, research, technology, and content teams on channel-specific activities and deliverables
* Support the development, testing, and rollout of heat advisory content with agronomists and livestock experts, ensuring advisories are timely, actionable, and suited to local contexts
* Maintain clear implementation plans, timelines, and responsibilities, plan around the seasonal heatwave window, monitor progress, and proactively address challenges and risks

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication
  
  

* Coordinate meetings, workshops, trainings, demonstrations, and other stakeholder engagement activities with government and implementation partners
* Prepare briefing materials, presentations, updates, and reports for government and external stakeholders, and support knowledge-sharing between the India and global PxD teams
* Work closely with PxD’s senior leadership and relevant colleagues to ensure government engagement aligns with country priorities and organizational objectives

Program Learning, Monitoring & Adaptation
  
  

* Support strategies to increase the reach, use, and effectiveness of heat advisory services, incorporating farmer feedback, evidence, and pilot learning into program improvements
* Track program and channel performance indicators, support teams in using data to inform implementation decisions, and document stakeholder engagement, decisions, and lessons learned

Reporting & Organizational Contribution
  
  

* Contribute to project reports, donor updates, funding proposals, and other documentation
* Support other program activities related to PxD's weather and climate portfolio as required

What You'll Bring
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

* A Master's degree in development studies, economics, agricultural economics, public policy, environmental or climate science, communications, or a related field
* Significant professional experience in program management, government relations, or stakeholder/partnership management, including demonstrated experience working directly with central and/or state government institutions in India
* Strong understanding of government structures, processes, and stakeholder engagement in India; familiarity with heat action plans, disaster management, agriculture extension, or animal husbandry systems is an advantage
* Experience coordinating programs involving multiple stakeholders, partners, and delivery channels; experience in agriculture, livestock, weather, climate, or digital development is an advantage
* Interest in how AI and new forecasting technologies can be applied to climate adaptation for farmers
* Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to work effectively with government officials and institutional partners
* Strong project coordination skills, including work planning, tracking deliverables, and managing timelines across multiple workstreams
* Ability to communicate complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, in both English and Hindi (fluency in Hindi required; another Indian language is a plus)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary, international teams
* Ability and willingness to travel within India as required, including to project sites during the summer months

How To Apply
  
  
To apply, please visit the PxD website and complete the online application form, including your CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 6 pm IST.
  
  
In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

ffe5586e.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
ffe5586e.description:
**About GitHub**
GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.
  
  
**Locations**
In this role you can work from Remote, India
  
  
**Overview**
GitHub is growing its Customer Engineering team and we're seeking experienced professionals to elevate our technical customer engagement efforts. As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will serve as a trusted advisor to GitHub customers across the SAARC region, helping them understand and maximize the value of the GitHub platform to achieve their business objectives through deep technical expertise. Leveraging your strong technical background and understanding of cloud technologies, modern development practices, and agentic software engineering workflows, you will guide customers across the entire SDLC, enabling them to modernize their software development processes and improve engineering efficiency.
  
  
The ideal candidate will act as a strategic partner to the Account team, including Account Executives and Customer Success teams, owning technical evaluations such as POCs, workshops, demos and design reviews to help shape customer architecture, foster strong customer relationships, and drive long-term success.
  
  
Your focus will be on accelerating platform adoption, driving AI-powered and agentic software engineering workflows, ensuring customers realize business value, and supporting them in building scalable, secure, and modern development practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Engage in pre-sales activities with large Enterprise customers to align and influence business partners and customer stakeholders, aiming for a technical win and driving solution selection.
* Develop and maintain external relationships within the customer organization to support strategic alignment and solution adoption.
* Lead technical discovery, demos, and validation to demonstrate how GitHub’s AI-powered platform addresses customers’ technical and business needs across the full software development lifecycle, including GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS), GitHub Copilot, and agentic software engineering workflows.
* Work closely with customers to understand their existing processes, development workflows, and technical challenges, acting as a trusted advisor to identify gaps and opportunities where GitHub solutions can drive meaningful business outcomes.
* Deliver tailored product demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and proofs of concept aligned to customer use cases, validating technical fit, solving complex challenges, and helping customers modernize their SDLC.
* Partner with Account Executives (AE’s), Sales Leaders, Customer Success teams, and other key stakeholders across the SAARC region to drive customer acquisition, expansion, and long-term success.
* Build deep expertise across the GitHub platform, including GitHub Enterprise (GHE), GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS), GitHub Copilot, and agentic software engineering workflows, supporting the full software development lifecycle.

+ Understand and articulate GitHub Copilot capabilities and GitHub’s approach to AI-driven software development.
+ Understand and articulate GitHub Advanced Security capabilities and GitHub’s approach to application security, acting as a trusted advisor in security program development.

* Assist in building and delivering content for marketing events, acting as a liaison to enhance customer engagement and showcase GitHub's value proposition.
* Synthesize and communicate business and industry insights to identify growth opportunities and align product features with customer digital transformation initiatives.
* Design and develop innovative solutions that leverage GitHub's platform capabilities to address complex customer challenges, ensuring alignment with their strategic goals.
* Collaborate with sales and account management teams and partners to develop strategic account plans that drive long-term customer success and growth.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* 8+ years' experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience,

+ OR bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 4+ years’ experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience,
+ OR master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 2+ years’ experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical/sales/industry experience,
+ OR doctorate in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field,
+ OR equivalent experience.

* Ability to travel up to 40% throughout SAARC and the wider APAC region to meet with customers, with occasional travel beyond this (e.g. USA) for company events.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience in technical consulting, technical consultative selling, or related technical, sales, or industry roles.
* 3+ years of software development experience focused on digital transformation and software modernization, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable strategies that drive measurable customer outcomes.
* 5+ years of experience in business consulting and customer-facing engagements, including orchestrating technical, support, and partner teams to deliver successful customer solutions.
* 2+ years of hands-on software engineering experience building and shipping production-ready enterprise and customer-facing applications, with strong knowledge of SDLC, DevSecOps, CI/CD, application security, platform engineering, GitHub/DevOps platforms, and AI-powered developer workflows.
* Proven ability to build trusted customer relationships, translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable strategies, and identify and resolve blockers to solution implementation to drive successful technology deployments and high customer satisfaction.
* Experience in identifying and resolving blockers to solution implementation, with a focus on enhancing customer satisfaction and driving successful technology deployments.

**GitHub values**

* Customer-obsessed
* Ship to learn
* Growth mindset
* Own the outcome
* Better together
* Diverse and inclusive

**Manager fundamentals**

* Model
* Coach
* Care

**Leadership principles**

* Create clarity
* Generate energy
* Deliver success

**Who We Are**
GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
  
  
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
  
  
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

3641307f.description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are looking for an execution-focused, highly technical **Technical Account Manager (TAM)** specializing in enterprise identity, including Okta’s Workforce Identity Cloud (WIC) and Customer Identity Solutions (CIS).

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to mid-market and enterprise customer portfolios. You will cut through complexity, proactively optimize configurations, and guide customers on architectural best practices across hybrid SaaS, on-premise, and custom application environments.

As a TAM at Okta, you embody a bias for action: you dig into technical details, eliminate architectural friction, and turn post-sales guidance into measurable customer traction.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Manage risks and issues through appropriate channels / tools with focus on setting and tracking actions, ownership, and comprehensive risk management.
