36fcf11f.description:
**Interior Designer – Pre-Sales / Furniture Sales**

**Location:**
Alankaram Showroom, Hyderabad

**Experience:**
3–7 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for an
**Interior Designer with strong client-facing skills**
to join the Pre-Sales team at our Hyderabad showroom.

This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys understanding spaces, interacting with clients, recommending furniture and material solutions, and converting design conversations into successful orders.

Unlike a conventional retail-sales role, this position requires a strong understanding of
**interior design, furniture proportions, materials, finishes, space planning and aesthetics**
. You will work closely with homeowners, architects and interior designers to help them select and customise furniture suited to their spaces.

The role offers an opportunity to combine
**design knowledge with commercial and client-management skills**
, with a clear career path towards
**Senior Pre-Sales Designer, Sales Manager, Showroom Manager, Zonal Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager**
.

Key Responsibilities

* Attend to clients visiting the Bengaluru showroom and understand their requirements, lifestyle, space, budget and aesthetic preferences.
* Recommend appropriate furniture, materials, finishes, fabrics, colours and configurations.
* Help clients visualise how furniture will work within their interiors in terms of
  **scale, proportion, circulation and overall design language**
  .
* Understand architectural drawings, floor plans, mood boards and interior-design presentations shared by clients or architects.
* Prepare furniture selections and preliminary proposals for complete rooms or residences.
* Coordinate with the internal design and technical teams for
  **customisation, dimensions, materials, finishes and feasibility**
  .
* Prepare and explain quotations clearly to clients.
* Follow up professionally with clients after showroom visits and quotations.
* Build long-term relationships rather than focusing only on immediate transactions.
* Coordinate with architects and interior designers who visit or refer clients to the showroom.
* Maintain complete and accurate client information, requirements, follow-ups and quotation status in the CRM.
* Participate in periodic reviews of open enquiries and quotations.
* Assist clients through the complete pre-sales journey until order confirmation and handover to the execution/back-office team.
* Keep yourself updated about Alankaram products, construction methods, solid woods, upholstery, finishes, hardware and customisation possibilities.
* Maintain a high standard of product presentation and client experience within the showroom.
* Support showroom events, architect interactions, product launches and design presentations whenever required.

What We Are Looking For

**Education**

Bachelor's / Diploma in:

* Interior Design
* Architecture
* Furniture Design
* Spatial Design
* or a related design discipline.

**Experience**

Ideally
**3–7 years of experience**
in one or more of the following:

* Interior design
* Premium furniture
* Luxury home interiors
* Modular/interior solutions
* Kitchens or wardrobes
* Home décor
* Architectural products
* Premium building materials

Previous sales experience is useful but
**not mandatory if the candidate has excellent client-facing ability and commercial orientation**
.

Essential Skills

The candidate should have:

* Strong understanding of
  **interior design and furniture**
* Good aesthetic sense
* Ability to understand floor plans and dimensions
* Strong verbal communication
* Confidence while interacting with premium clients
* Good listening skills
* Ability to understand an unstated client requirement
* Commercial awareness
* Strong follow-up discipline
* Attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple clients simultaneously
* Comfort with numbers, quotations and pricing
* Ability to explain design recommendations logically rather than merely expressing personal preferences

Particularly Important for This Role

We are looking for someone who can move naturally from:

**“What kind of home are you creating?”**

to

**“These are the furniture pieces, dimensions, finishes and combinations that will work best for your space.”**

and eventually to:

**“Let me prepare the complete proposal and help you take this forward.”**

The candidate therefore needs to be
**a designer first, but commercially minded**
.

Performance Indicators

* Qualified clients handled
* Showroom walk-in to quotation %
* Quotation value generated
* Quotation-to-order conversion %
* Follow-up compliance
* Average response time
* Sales value
* Gross margin / discount discipline
* Average order value
* Architect/interior-designer relationships developed
* CRM discipline
* Client feedback
* Repeat/referral business

Career Growth

A strong candidate should be able to progress through:

**Interior Designer – Pre-Sales**

→
**Senior Pre-Sales Designer**

→
**Assistant Sales Manager**

→
**Sales Manager / Showroom Manager**

→
**Zonal Sales Manager**

→
**Regional Sales Manager**

**You should have:**

* Degree/Diploma in Interior Design or Architecture
* 3+ years relevant experience
* Strong design and aesthetic understanding
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Confidence dealing with premium clients
* Ability to understand drawings and space plans
* Strong ownership and follow-up skills
* A commercial mindset and willingness to work towards sales goals

**Why join Alankaram?**

Build expertise in premium furniture and client advisory while developing a career beyond conventional interior-design roles.

Strong performers can grow into
**Senior Pre-Sales, Sales Manager, Showroom Manager, Zonal Sales Manager and Regional Sales Manager roles**
.

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role:**
Full-time, showroom-based

57f93a6e.title: Oracle EPM Specialist - IT Architect
57f93a6e.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  
  
DESCRIPTION:  
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as an IT Architect III and be part of our mission to enable customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. In this role, you'll design and implement effective cloud solutions, focusing on EPM architecture and automation. You'll contribute to technology advancement, transforming on-premise applications into cloud-centric solutions while ensuring reliability and disaster recovery. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams, propose innovative approaches, and advance cloud technology. You'll support and guide application owners while maintaining expertise in emerging technologies and industry best practices. Your work will directly impact operations through the implementation of sophisticated machine learning solutions, cloud infrastructure optimization, and the development of scalable IT architectures.  
  
We are seeking an Oracle EPM Consultant with strong expertise in Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (EPBCS) to support, develop, and optimize enterprise planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting solutions.

The consultant will serve as the primary functional and technical resource for EPBCS, ensuring application stability, data accuracy, security, and performance during planning and financial close cycles. This role involves translating business requirements into scalable solutions, managing integrations, troubleshooting issues, and delivering application enhancements.

Working closely with Finance, IT, implementation partners, and Financial Systems leadership, the consultant will take ownership of knowledge transfer and support the execution of the EPM roadmap. Exposure to PCMCS and EDMCS is desirable, with these applications representing a secondary area of responsibility.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**EPBCS Solution Design & Development**

* Gather business requirements and translate them into functional designs, technical specifications, and EPBCS solutions.
* Configure and maintain planning applications, dimensions, hierarchies, forms, dashboards, navigation flows, task lists, and approval workflows.
* Develop and optimize business rules, calculation scripts, member formulas, and allocation logic using Calculation Manager and, where applicable, Groovy.
* Support planning models across scenarios, versions, entities, currencies, and business units.
* Enhance budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and management reporting processes.
* Configure and support relevant EPBCS frameworks, such as Financials, Workforce based on business requirements.

**Data Integration & Management**

* Configure, administer, and monitor Data Integration/Data Exchange processes, data mappings, pipelines, and import/export definitions.
* Manage actuals, budget, forecast, and metadata integrations between EPBCS and source systems.
* Validate and reconcile financial data to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream system owners to assess dependencies and resolve integration issues.
* Automate routine data loads, metadata updates, and application processes using EPM Automate, REST APIs, or scripting.

**Application Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide functional and technical support during budgeting, forecasting, financial close, and reporting cycles.
* Investigate and resolve data load failures, mapping errors, calculation issues, validation failures, and performance problems.
* Support users with forms, dashboards, approvals, reporting, and Smart View queries.
* Perform root cause analysis, implement preventive fixes, and manage Oracle Service Requests through resolution.
* Monitor scheduled jobs, business rules, integrations, and application performance.

**Security, Maintenance & Release Management**

* Administer user access, predefined roles, application permissions, and dimension-level security.
* Review monthly Oracle EPM release notes, assess impacts, and coordinate regression testing.
* Manage controlled migration of application changes across development, test, and production environments.
* Maintain application backups, configuration documentation, support runbooks, and operating procedures.
* Follow change management processes and support audit and internal control requirements.

**Business Partnership & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Finance and IT teams to improve planning processes, application usability, and operational efficiency.
* Assess the downstream impact of application and integration changes.
* Lead knowledge transfer from implementation partners and establish sustainable application support practices.
* Work with Financial Systems leadership to prioritize enhancements and deliver EPM roadmap initiatives.

**Secondary Support – PCMCS & EDMCS**

* Provide limited support for PCMCS allocation models and profitability processes, as required.
* Assist with EDMCS metadata updates, hierarchy maintenance, and subscriptions.
* Coordinate with application specialists for complex PCMCS and EDMCS requirements.

### **Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience implementing, developing, or supporting Oracle EPBCS/EPM Planning applications.
* Understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and financial close dependencies.
* Experience with dimensions, forms, dashboards, approval workflows, business rules, calculation scripts, and Smart View.
* Strong knowledge of Essbase concepts, multidimensional modeling, and calculation performance optimization.
* Experience with Data Integration/Data Exchange, data mappings, metadata management, and financial data reconciliation.
* Experience managing application security, migrations, monthly update testing, and production support.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to translate Finance requirements into practical, maintainable technical solutions.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Groovy, EPM Automate, REST APIs, and scripting.
* Experience with EPBCS Financials, Workforce.
* Exposure to Oracle ERP or other financial source-system integrations.
* Familiarity with PCMCS and EDMCS.

b80b5f8f.title: FinOps Engineer
b80b5f8f.description:
**FinOps Engineer**

**Company:** Blessing Softtech Pvt. Ltd.  
**Product:** Fonazo – AI-Powered Voice Agent & Subscription Platform  
**Job Title:** FinOps Engineer  
**Experience:** 4+ Years  
**Qualification:** Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Finance, FinTech, Commerce, Accounting, or a related field  
**Location:** Pune  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Joining:** Immediate joiners preferred  
**Salary:** As per experience and industry standards

**Job Summary**

Blessing Softtech Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced **FinOps Engineer with a strong background in Finance, FinTech, subscription billing, and payment gateway management** to manage the financial operations of our clients using **Fonazo, our AI-powered voice agent and subscription platform**.

The ideal candidate will have at least 4 years of hands-on experience managing subscription-based revenue models, recurring billing, payment processing, financial reconciliation, transaction settlements, refunds, chargebacks, and payment gateway integrations. The candidate should be familiar with payment service providers such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay, 2Checkout (Verifone), Square, Payoneer, Amazon Pay, and similar platforms.

The role involves overseeing end-to-end financial operations for multiple clients, ensuring accurate subscription revenue tracking, monitoring payment performance, resolving billing discrepancies, and maintaining financial transparency across the Fonazo platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Subscription Billing & Revenue Management**

* Manage end-to-end subscription billing operations for Fonazo clients, including recurring payments, subscription plans, renewals, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and plan changes.
* Monitor subscription revenue, billing cycles, failed payments, pending invoices, and outstanding receivables to ensure accurate and timely revenue collection.
* Establish and maintain processes for tracking Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), customer lifetime value (CLV), churn, and subscription growth.
* Ensure accurate calculation of subscription charges, prorated billing, discounts, promotional offers, taxes, and other applicable fees.
* Identify billing discrepancies and revenue leakage, investigate root causes, and implement corrective measures.
* Coordinate with the product and development teams to improve billing workflows and automate subscription-related financial processes.

**2. Payment Gateway Management & Integration**

* Manage financial operations across payment gateways and subscription payment platforms, including Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay (FIS Global), 2Checkout (Verifone), Square, Payoneer, Amazon Pay, and other relevant providers.
* Configure and monitor payment gateway settings, transaction workflows, settlement schedules, payment methods, and recurring billing arrangements.
* Track payment success rates, declined transactions, gateway fees, transaction costs, refunds, and settlement discrepancies across providers.
* Coordinate with technical teams to troubleshoot payment gateway integration issues, API-related billing errors, webhook failures, and transaction status mismatches.
* Evaluate payment gateway performance, pricing structures, supported currencies, geographical coverage, and settlement timelines to recommend suitable solutions for clients.
* Ensure proper reconciliation between gateway transaction records, Fonazo subscription records, invoices, and bank settlements.

**3. Financial Reconciliation & Settlement Management**

* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation of payment gateway transactions, subscription invoices, customer payments, refunds, and bank settlements.
* Verify gross transaction values, processing fees, commissions, taxes, net settlements, and pending or disputed transactions.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies between payment gateways, internal billing systems, accounting records, and bank statements.
* Monitor settlement delays, failed payouts, duplicate transactions, payment reversals, and unaccounted financial entries.
* Maintain accurate financial ledgers, transaction registers, settlement reports, and supporting documentation for audit and accounting purposes.
* Coordinate with the Accounts and Finance team to ensure proper recording of revenue, receivables, gateway charges, and settlement entries.

**4. Client Financial Operations & Account Management**

* Manage subscription-related financial operations for multiple Fonazo clients, ensuring accurate billing, payment collection, revenue reporting, and account-level financial records.
* Monitor each client's subscription plans, active subscriptions, transaction history, invoices, outstanding balances, refunds, and payment status.
* Prepare client-wise financial statements and reports covering subscription revenue, collections, failed payments, refunds, gateway charges, and net settlements.
* Coordinate with clients to resolve billing disputes, payment failures, invoice discrepancies, refund requests, and settlement-related queries.
* Maintain clear records of client transactions, payment histories, subscription changes, and financial adjustments.
* Ensure timely communication with clients regarding failed payments, pending dues, billing changes, and other subscription-related financial matters.

**5. Refunds, Chargebacks & Dispute Management**

* Manage refund requests, chargebacks, payment reversals, and disputed transactions in accordance with company policies and payment gateway requirements.
* Investigate transaction disputes, collect supporting evidence, and coordinate with payment service providers to facilitate timely resolution.
* Monitor chargeback ratios, refund trends, fraudulent transaction indicators, and recurring payment failures.
* Establish procedures for refund approvals, transaction verification, dispute escalation, and financial adjustment entries.
* Work with customer support and technical teams to identify the causes of payment disputes and prevent recurring issues.
* Maintain complete documentation of refunds, chargebacks, disputes, and their final outcomes.

**6. Financial Reporting, MIS & Analytics**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports covering subscription revenue, payment collections, transaction volumes, failed payments, refunds, and gateway settlements.
* Develop dashboards to track MRR, ARR, churn rate, renewal rates, payment success rates, outstanding receivables, and revenue leakage.
* Analyze payment gateway fees, subscription performance, client profitability, transaction costs, and revenue trends to support management decisions.
* Prepare client-wise and gateway-wise financial performance reports for internal management and business reviews.
* Identify financial irregularities, recurring billing issues, and operational inefficiencies through data analysis.
* Use Excel, SQL, Power BI, or similar reporting tools to automate financial reports and improve data accuracy.

**7. Financial Controls, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Establish internal controls for subscription billing, refunds, payment settlements, revenue recognition, and financial adjustments.
* Ensure that financial operations follow applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, payment provider policies, and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Maintain appropriate transaction records, audit trails, approval workflows, and supporting documents for financial reviews and audits.
* Coordinate with internal finance, compliance, and technical teams to support applicable PCI DSS requirements and secure payment-handling practices.
* Monitor suspicious transactions, duplicate charges, unauthorized refunds, and potential payment fraud indicators.
* Support compliance with applicable data protection, customer billing, and payment-related requirements across relevant markets.

**8. Product & Technical Team Coordination**

* Work closely with product managers, backend developers, QA engineers, and DevOps teams to improve Fonazo's subscription billing and payment management modules.
* Translate financial requirements into clear functional specifications for subscription plans, billing logic, invoices, payment retries, refunds, and settlement workflows.
* Validate payment gateway integrations, subscription lifecycle events, billing calculations, and transaction reconciliation during product releases.
* Coordinate testing of payment APIs, webhook events, recurring billing scenarios, failed payment recovery, and refund workflows.
* Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual reconciliation, improve financial accuracy, and streamline client onboarding.
* Contribute to the development of scalable financial workflows that support increasing subscription volumes and multiple client accounts.

**9. Subscription Performance & Payment Optimization**

* Analyze failed and declined transactions to identify the reasons for payment failures and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
* Implement and monitor dunning processes, automated payment retries, renewal reminders, and failed-payment recovery workflows.
* Evaluate payment gateway performance to improve transaction approval rates and reduce unnecessary processing costs.
* Monitor subscription cancellations, involuntary churn, payment-related customer drop-offs, and recurring billing issues.
* Recommend improvements to subscription pricing, billing frequency, payment methods, and collection workflows based on financial data.
* Work with product and customer success teams to improve renewal rates, customer payment experience, and subscription revenue retention.

**10. Accounting, Budgeting & Financial Planning**

* Support subscription revenue forecasting, cash flow planning, payment collection projections, and financial budgeting for Fonazo operations.
* Maintain accurate records of accounts receivable, deferred revenue where applicable, payment gateway fees, refunds, and other subscription-related financial entries.
* Coordinate with the accounting team on monthly closing, revenue reconciliation, financial statements, and audit requirements.
* Analyze client-wise revenue, platform operating costs, payment processing charges, and contribution margins.
* Support the preparation of financial forecasts and management reports for business planning and operational decision-making.
* Recommend process improvements to strengthen financial controls, reduce operating costs, and improve cash flow visibility.

**Required Technical & Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of subscription billing, recurring payments, payment processing, revenue reconciliation, and financial operations.
* Hands-on experience with one or more payment gateways such as Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, Adyen, Braintree, Checkout.com, Worldpay, 2Checkout, Square, Payoneer, or Amazon Pay.

The firm is owned and managed by experienced Indian professionals and has built a strong competitive presence with offices in 14 cities, including Hyderabad. KPMG India serves a domestic client base of over 2,700 companies, delivering value-added services through a global approach to service delivery. Its advisory services are industry-tailored, technology-enabled, and performance-focused, supported by advanced internal IT and knowledge management systems. Professionals are organized by industry, enabling clients to work with teams that understand their specific business context.

**Role Description**

Location: Pune or Gurgaon

Experience: 8–12 years

Notice period: Immediate joiners preferred; maximum 45 days

Role overview

We are seeking a Solution Architect with experience in digital manufacturing, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and IT/OT integration. The individual will translate manufacturing requirements into scalable, secure solutions and guide implementation across plant systems, enterprise applications, and cloud platforms.

The role requires strong technical architecture skills, manufacturing domain knowledge, and the ability to collaborate with business, plant operations, engineering, quality, infrastructure, and cybersecurity teams.

Key responsibilities

- Define solution architectures and technology roadmaps for digital manufacturing and MES initiatives.

- Lead solution design for greenfield implementations, brownfield upgrades, and manufacturing application modernization.

- Design integrations between MES, ERP, enterprise applications, and shop-floor systems.

- Translate business and operational requirements into architecture documents, integration specifications, and implementation plans.

- Define connectivity and security requirements across IT and OT environments, including network segregation and secure access.

- Support migration of manufacturing applications from on-premises environments to Microsoft Azure.

- Collaborate with quality and validation teams to address GxP and applicable regulatory requirements.

- Work with delivery teams and technology vendors through design, testing, deployment, commissioning, and production stabilization.

- Address availability, performance, scalability, and business continuity requirements for manufacturing systems supporting 24×7 operations.

- Conduct architecture reviews, assess technical risks, and recommend mitigation measures.

- Communicate solution options, dependencies, costs, and trade-offs to business and technical stakeholders.

Required skills and experience

- 8–12 years of relevant experience across enterprise applications, solution architecture, or manufacturing technology.

- Demonstrated experience designing and delivering MES or digital manufacturing solutions.

- Strong understanding of IT/OT integration and connectivity between plant systems and enterprise platforms.

- Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, FMCG, or other process manufacturing environments.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and application migration or modernization.

- Understanding of network and security components such as VPN, SD-WAN, DNS, proxies, and firewalls.

e64dd8bf.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
e64dd8bf.description:
**Description**
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

5fc22623.title: Senior Data Architect
5fc22623.description:
**Job Description**
CSS Innovation Studios is seeking Senior Data Engineers/Architects with deep expertise in PySpark and data engineering to deliver strategic AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s largest enterprise customers.
  
  
In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work directly with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, chief architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize legacy data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.
  
  
The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems supporting generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; lead complex platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply and evolve Oracle product capabilities through real-world customer deployments.
  
  

* 10–12+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms.
* Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Principal Solution Architect, Consulting Engineer, or technical leader in professional services.
* Expert knowledge of one or more modern cloud data platforms like Databricks
* Extensive hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Scala or Java, Kafka and modern data ecosystems.
* Exposure to building autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines.
* Deep expertise in Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance engineering, optimization, and tuning at scale.
* Demonstrated success modernizing enterprise analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads.
* Must have a solid understanding of networking concepts to design and optimize data transmission networks, configure network settings, and diagnose and resolve network-related issues.
* Strong understanding of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability.
* Outstanding executive communication, customer advisory, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Responsibilities**
Lead architecture and delivery of enterprise Oracle AI Data Platform transformations, including platform implementations and migrations.
  
  

* Design and build scalable, governed, AI-ready data architectures, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products.
* Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns.
* Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets.
* Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, cluster sizing, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance at scale.
* Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services.
* Create reusable migration accelerators, reference architectures, automation frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to solve complex technical challenges; share customer insights to inform product roadmaps.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout customer engagements.
* Mentor senior engineers globally, promote engineering excellence across CSS, and continuously evaluate emerging AI, cloud, and data-engineering practices.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

eeae227a.description:
At AlgoSec, what you do matters!
  
  
AlgoSec helps the world’s leading organizations secure application connectivity across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Trusted by more than 2,200 global organizations, our platform delivers visibility, security policy management, risk reduction, and compliance automation across complex enterprise networks.
  
  
AlgoSec is looking for an experienced Technical Support Engineer to join our global Support organization.

Support Team Leader / Support Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Gurgaon, India – office-based preferred; remote work may be considered
  
  
**Employment:**
Direct employment
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support to AlgoSec customers and partners worldwide via email, phone, and web sessions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues related to product installation, configuration, operation, cloud infrastructure, applications, networking, and security environments.
* Guide customers, partners, and Sales Engineers through technical issues and product-related questions.
* Investigate complex technical problems across cloud, Linux, application, and network environments.
* Work closely with global Support teams, R&D, Delivery, and Product Management to drive issues to resolution.
* Take ownership of customer issues and manage them through resolution.
* Develop and maintain operational scripts and automations to improve Support efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase service reliability.
* Document technical findings and maintain and improve the AlgoSec knowledge base.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Support processes, methodologies, tools, and automation.

**What We're Looking For**

* At least 3 years of experience in Technical Support or a similar customer-facing technical role within a software company.
* Practical experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Microsoft Azure, including troubleshooting cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and platform services.
* Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Linux/Unix environments.
* Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, PowerShell, Shell scripting, or similar technologies.
* Experience building or maintaining operational automations to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, or enhance service reliability.
* Experience supporting network security, infrastructure, or other complex enterprise software products.
* Good understanding of networking and security concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues across cloud and application environments.
* Ability to independently investigate technical issues and take ownership through resolution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.
* Willingness to work flexible hours as part of a 24x7 global Support organization.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation platforms such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
* Experience implementing AI-powered operational workflows, predictive analytics, intelligent alerting, or GenAI-based Support automation solutions.
* Experience with SaaS products or cloud-native application environments.
* Experience with firewall technologies such as Check Point, Palo Alto, Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, or similar platforms.
* Experience working directly with R&D, Product, or Delivery teams on complex customer issues.
* Experience creating technical documentation or Knowledge Base content.

**Personal attributes**

* Independent, resourceful, and results-oriented.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
* Fast learner with a strong interest in emerging technologies, cloud platforms, automation, and AI-driven operations.
* Strong team player with high integrity and a customer-first mindset.
* Comfortably operating under pressure and handling multiple technical issues simultaneously.

1b5b2443.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The **Lead Technical Program Manager, Fraud Technology** is responsible for driving end-to-end technology governance, architectural alignment, and delivery execution for Citi’s Enterprise Fraud Prevention initiatives. In this role, you will serve as a technical authority navigating critical cross-functional dependencies across distributed engineering squads, data science teams, core platform services, and risk/compliance partners. You will blend deep systems acumen with executive presence and crisp, diplomatic communication to guide multi-million-dollar programs from architectural discovery through production rollout. This position requires an in-depth understanding of how sub-functional units integrate end-to-end, as well as the ability to coordinate across diverse groups to achieve broad organizational objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**End-to-End Program Delivery & Strategic Roadmap Execution**

* Lead end-to-end technology planning, execution, and delivery governance across complex, mission-critical programs within Citi’s Fraud Technology Book of Work.
* Define, baseline, and track program milestones, critical paths, and deliverable commitments across multiple agile squads and hybrid legacy/modernized distributed platforms.
* Proactively manage complex cross-program dependencies, identifying technical bottlenecks, architectural conflicts, and resource constraints early to formulate and execute effective mitigation plans.
* Establish rigorous Definition of Done (DoD), release readiness criteria, and robust operational cutover strategies tailored for high-throughput, ultra-low-latency financial transaction systems.

**Architecture Alignment, Dependency Management & Systems Integration**

* Guide stakeholders and engineering squads through complex trade-off evaluations, balancing business priorities, customer experience, platform strategy, performance benchmarks, and long-term maintainability.
* Facilitate technical architecture reviews, interface design agreements (REST/SOAP APIs, Kafka/event-driven streaming), and binding cross-team integration contracts.
* Apply deep technical domain knowledge across core software engineering disciplines, including microservices architectures, distributed API protocols, hybrid cloud and on-premise infrastructure, and resilient data layers.

**AI-Augmented Program Management & Operational Excellence**

* Champion and integrate modern Generative AI (GenAI) and automated tooling to streamline and modernize traditional program management workflows:
  + Automate the synthesis of complex technical discussions, action items, and Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).
  + Accelerate the generation of executive dashboards, release notes, and milestone variance analytics.
  + Standardize AI-driven delivery best practices, prompts, and reporting templates across participating engineering teams.

**Executive Presence & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as the primary strategic liaison between engineering teams and executive leadership, articulating delivery health, technical trade-offs, blockers, and architectural risks with clarity, precision, and business context.
* Influence, negotiate, and align cross-functional stakeholders across organizational boundaries without formal line authority.
* Author and deliver high-impact executive collateral (executive one-pagers, steering committee presentations, risk heatmaps) and crisp briefings to Senior Leadership (MD/C-suite level).
* Cultivate strong collaborative partnerships across business units, external technology vendors, operations, internal audit, and technology peers.

**Risk, Governance, and Control Management**

* Proactively identify, evaluate, track, and remediate technical program risks, architectural vulnerabilities, and control deficiencies across all delivery tiers.
* Ensure strict compliance with Citi’s Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) governance, architecture review board standards, data governance policies, and relevant regulatory mandates (e.g., OCC, Federal Reserve, PCI-DSS, Model Risk Management).
* Champion operational resilience and release integrity, enforcing zero-unauthorized-change policies, comprehensive automated rollback strategies, and stringent incident management protocols.

**Qualifications & Competencies**

**Experience & Domain Expertise**

* **10+ years of experience** in Technical Program Management, Technology Project Management, Engineering Delivery, or related technology leadership roles managing large-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **2+ years of experience** supporting payments, fintech, fraud prevention, risk management, or other highly regulated technology environments utilizing Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Hybrid delivery frameworks.
* Strong technical fluency in modern software architecture patterns, including microservices, REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architectures (Kafka/MQ), hybrid cloud/on-prem environments, and distributed database systems.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing dependencies, tracking critical-path milestones, and supporting vendor integrations in matrixed organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex technology initiatives from planning through production deployment.

**Project Management & AI Tooling**

* PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or comparable project/program management certification preferred.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise delivery, portfolio, and collaboration tools including Jira, Confluence, Jira Align, MS Project, and ServiceNow.
* Experience utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, LLMs, or enterprise AI platforms) to support reporting, documentation, meeting synthesis, and delivery management activities.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Demonstrated ability to facilitate stakeholder discussions, drive consensus, and influence technical and business partners in a cross-functional environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business-focused messaging.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology, or a related discipline. Master's degree preferred.

**Other Relevant Skills** Delivery Management, Project Management, Stakeholder Management

Full time

Please see the requirements listed above.

5c60d19e.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
5c60d19e.description:
Works with management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain. Establishes scope and milestones for each aspect of a technical program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals. Manages technical programs and complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business. Manages highly complex issues, bottlenecks and/or risks, escalating issues when appropriate. Leads technical program improvement, implementing best practices and driving cross-team process optimizations to improve processes. Leads efforts to integrate continuous improvement within technical programs, driving insights across many workstreams to generate recommendations that deliver operational efficiencies. Facilitates collaboration across multiple teams, driving technical discussions that align priorities and program goals. Provides technical expertise, direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams. Creates and automates reporting, partnering with development teams to continue improving reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models to help manage technical program execution. Acts as a technical liaison with or between stakeholder teams, driving effective collaboration for customer success within Oracle commitments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:**

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Ensures that product or service delivery meets the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Drives rapid response to security escalations, coordinating across teams and communicating to executives to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and align and execute optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Forecasts program demands and resourcing to identify risks and ensure that goals are achievable.

– Leads the development and implementation of evolving processes to ensure that organizational SLAs are met.

**Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:**

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify, track, and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Supports planning by identifying dependencies and risks.

– Develops delivery standards and guidelines in alignment with Oracle best practices.

– Identifies and quantifies opportunities for process automations and advocates for prioritization.

– Contributes to incident management efforts and identifies opportunities to improve processes, as applicable.

**Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:**

– Aligns priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones for each program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals.

– Assists in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for program performance against established goals (e.g., scope, timelines, deliverable quality).

– Builds, maintains, and executes a clear communication strategy of objectives to partners and customers, influencing decision-making regarding best practices for Oracle systems.

**Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:**

– Manages both technical and non-technical programs and complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides the work of program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success) while providing technical support and direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

– Maintains comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and documents risks and issues.

– Ensures attention to detail in program management from planning to execution and reporting.

– Leads regular program status meetings and keeps teams and leadership informed.

– Leads initiatives within the team to improve operational efficiency and enhance adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity targets.

– Ensures ownership and accountability for forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Guides the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, or requirement changes.

**Program Oversight - Risk Management:**

– Manages highly complex issues, bottlenecks and/or risks, escalating issues when appropriate.

– Conducts comprehensive assessments of costs, benefits, and return on investment (ROI) to inform decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Manages critical issues while making trade-offs between business needs and technical constraints.

– Removes blockers for the program and identifies new technical and resource options to efficiently deliver solutions and drive adoption.

**Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:**

**Job Description**

Position Vice President – Trade Finance Solutions

Experience 10–15 years

Grade- VP Location Mumbai

Project-Fuel

**Mandatory**
-MBA-Tier 1

About FuEL

FuEL is Intellect's Flagship program designed to develop the next generation of transformation leaders for the global Fintech/Insuretech industry. Created for high-potential professionals, the program equips participants to help financial institutions reimagine business models, accelerate digital and AI transformation, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

**The Opportunity**

This role is for a Trade Finance leader who combines deep domain expertise with hands-on technology and process experience. You will shape solution propositions for banks, actively demonstrate Intellect’s Trade Finance capabilities, and work closely with Engineering and Delivery to evolve the solution in response to market needs and client requirements. The role spans consultative engagement, product solutioning, sales support, and ongoing product

development—not just domain advisory or relationship management.

You will engage business, product, operations, and technology leaders to understand their objectives, diagnose process and business challenges, and translate them into practical, differentiated solutions. You should be equally comfortable leading a client workshop, running a product demonstration, developing a solution approach, and working with internal teams on the changes needed to deliver it.

**Role Definition**

The Vice President – Trade Finance Solutions owns domain-led solutioning and supports growth across Intellect’s Trade Finance portfolio. The role combines customer discovery, process analysis and reengineering, product demonstrations, solution design, bid support, and collaboration with Product, Engineering and Delivery to ensure that proposed solutions are credible, differentiated, feasible, and aligned with customer needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

● 1. Prospect Understanding and Process Reengineering: Engage bank and financial-institution executives, business heads, product owners, operations and technology leaders to understand business models, workflows, pain points and strategic priorities. Analyse existing processes and identify opportunities for simplification, automation, control improvement and business transformation.

● 2. Domain Expertise and Solutioning: Apply strong Trade Finance knowledge to translate business requirements

into practical solution propositions. Map customer processes and requirements to product capabilities, identify

gaps, distinguish standard product functionality from client-specific changes, and define appropriate solution options, assumptions and dependencies.

● 3. Product Demonstrations and Client Workshops: Personally lead high-quality demonstrations of Intellect’s Trade

Finance solution across the trade lifecycle, solution walkthroughs, discovery workshops, use-case discussions, proof-of-concept sessions and technical/business presentations. Tailor demonstrations to the prospect’s requirements and articulate business value, product capabilities and competitive differentiation.

● 4. Solution Design and Proposal Development: Develop customer-specific solution approaches, scope documents, functional solution notes, implementation considerations, effort-estimation inputs, assumptions, exclusions and proposal content. Ensure that proposed solutions are commercially sound, implementable and aligned with the client’s objectives.

● 5. RFP/RFI and Deal Support: Lead or contribute to RFPs, RFIs, questionnaires, bid responses and presentations. Work with Sales and Pre-sales teams to qualify opportunities, articulate value propositions, address objections and support deal progression and closure.

● 6. Product and Engineering Collaboration: Work hands-on with Product, Business Analysts, Engineering, Architecture and QA teams to assess requirements, clarify business rules, prioritize enhancements and guide solution changes. Participate in solution reviews and relevant agile ceremonies; help ensure that requirements and acceptance criteria are clear and that changes address the underlying business need.

● 7. Delivery and Implementation Collaboration: Partner with Delivery, Implementation and Support teams to validate feasibility, integrations, dependencies, customization needs, effort assumptions and delivery risks. Support transition from sales to delivery and help resolve domain or solution issues during implementation where required.

● 8. Market and Customer Feedback Loop: Capture feedback from prospects, clients, demonstrations, implementations and competitive situations. Convert insights into actionable recommendations for product enhancements, roadmap priorities, solution assets and market positioning.

● 9. Commercial and Market Development: Support new sales, cross-sell and upsell across new and existing accounts. Engage senior stakeholders, contribute to pipeline development, and build trusted-advisor relationships

by connecting domain knowledge and technology capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

● 10. Sales Enablement and Knowledge Management: Develop and maintain reusable demo flows, solution notes, product collateral, proposal content, case studies, FAQs and competitive insights. Enable Sales, Pre-sales,

Product and Delivery teams through knowledge sharing and product training.

● 11. Innovation and Industry Awareness: Track market, regulatory and technology developments relevant to Trade Finance, including opportunities to apply AI and automation. Recommend practical enhancements and differentiated capabilities based on client needs and competitive trends.

**Experience and Qualifications**

● Extensive experience in Trade Finance, with a strong track record in one or more of technology development, technology sales, pre-sales/solution consulting, product consulting, business analysis, process transformation or implementation roles. Domain knowledge alone, without meaningful process or technology solutioning experience, is not sufficient.

● Deep working knowledge of Letters of Credit, Guarantees, Documentary Collections, Open Account, trade loans/financing, amendments, limits, document handling, settlement and reporting, plus relevant SWIFT/ICC and regulatory requirements, with the ability to understand end-to-end business processes, operating models, controls, products and client-specific requirements.

● Demonstrated experience in process analysis, reengineering or transformation, and translating business challenges into functional/technology solutions for banks or financial institutions.

● Proven ability to personally conduct product demonstrations, lead customer discovery and workshops, explain solution design, and respond confidently to business and technology questions from senior stakeholders.

● Experience working directly with Product, Engineering, Architecture and Delivery teams to define requirements, evaluate feasibility, shape enhancements and support implementation.

● Strong commercial acumen and experience contributing to complex sales pursuits, RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, executive presentations and deal conversion.

● Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage CXOs, business leaders, operations teams and technology stakeholders.

● Experience in banking technology, fintech or financial-services transformation is strongly preferred. Familiarity with agile product development and APIs/integrations is an advantage.

● Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent post-graduate qualification preferred.

**Why This Role**

You will work at the intersection of banking domain expertise, process transformation and technology—helping financial institutions solve real business problems while shaping the evolution of Intellect’s Trade Finance solutions.

The role offers direct customer exposure and the opportunity to influence solution design, product enhancements, sales outcomes and successful delivery.

9ff2fe58.title: Solution Architect - Senior
9ff2fe58.description:
The Solution Architect – Senior is responsible for defining and developing solution architectures that align with enterprise architecture strategies, principles, policies, standards, and business requirements. This role evaluates and applies solution designs for specific systems in collaboration with project and product teams and ensures solutions meet business, technical, security, governance, compliance, scalability, and performance requirements. The role involves translating complex business and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, evaluating multiple architectural options, conducting cost-benefit analysis, and recommending optimized solutions. The Solution Architect – Senior also stays current with emerging technologies and supports pilots and proof-of-concept initiatives to validate new technology capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define solution and system architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and technology principles.
* Decompose systems into components, perform functional allocation, and establish interfaces between systems and system components.
* Develop and evaluate multiple solution options, conduct cost-benefit analysis, and recommend optimized solutions based on business and technical requirements.
* Design scalable architecture solutions for cloud-based platforms, enterprise applications, data and analytics platforms, and integrated systems.
* Develop and maintain architecture deliverables, including conceptual and logical models, solution diagrams, architecture patterns, and technical documentation.
* Apply enterprise architecture standards, frameworks, technology stacks, architecture patterns, and reference models to solution designs.
* Architect and integrate enterprise applications, data platforms, APIs, and other technology systems to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Translate complex business requirements, industry requirements, and governance considerations into practical and scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure solution designs address security, governance, compliance, performance, scalability, buildability, and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with project, product, engineering, data, security, and business teams to drive successful solution development and delivery.
* Provide technical leadership and influence architecture decisions across cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Facilitate and support pilots, proof-of-concept activities, and technology evaluations to validate emerging technologies and architectural approaches.
* Analyze infrastructure and technology capacity and provide recommendations to support current and future business needs.
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, software trends, tools, and industry practices and assess their applicability to business solutions.
* Support the adoption of Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, and modern software delivery practices.
* Identify, assess, and manage technical risks and issues and drive appropriate mitigation actions.
* Build strong relationships with customers, business stakeholders, technology teams, and peers to promote effective solution development and delivery.
* Apply effective Business Relationship Management practices to ensure technology solutions deliver measurable business value.
* Drive changes in technical architecture and standards into solution designs when business or technology needs evolve.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Enterprise Architecture and Solution Design
* Cloud Architecture – AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Solution and System Architecture
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
* Data Architecture, Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, ETL, and Data Pipeline Design
* System Integration and API Architecture
* Enterprise Application Architecture
* Analytics and AI/ML Platform Architecture
* Machine Learning Lifecycle Management / MLOps
* CI/CD, Build Automation, and Version Control
* Security, Governance, and Compliance in Architecture Design
* Architecture Documentation, Design Patterns, and Reference Architectures
* Stakeholder Management and Technical Leadership
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and influencing skills

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Experience with IoT technologies and connected systems.
* Experience with Agile software development methodologies.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and automation frameworks.
* Experience with cost optimization and performance engineering.
* Experience architecting and integrating complex enterprise systems and data platforms.
* Experience designing AI/ML-enabled solutions and modern analytics platforms.
* Experience with agentic lifecycle management / AIOps.
* Familiarity with architecture frameworks, enterprise technology reference models, and architecture governance.
* Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or Neo4j.
* Experience designing Azure-native solutions.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch.
* Knowledge of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI-driven decision systems.

* Intermediate to advanced experience in solution architecture, enterprise systems, cloud architecture, or a related technical discipline.
