556c26d8.title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
556c26d8.description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.

**#ZEOLife at Zuora**
As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it’s exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as “ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we’re making what’s next possible for our customers, community and the world.
  
  
As Part Of Our Commitment To Building An Inclusive, High-performance Culture Where ZEOs Feel Inspired, Connected And Valued, We Support ZEOs With
  
  
Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs
  
  
Medical, dental and vision insurance
  
  
Generous, flexible time off
  
  
Paid holidays, “wellness” days and company wide end of year break
  
  
Learning & Development stipend
  
  
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match
  
  
Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing
  
  

* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.

Location & Work Arrangements
  
  
Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.
  
  
Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.
  
  
Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

d72ebe3d.title: Principle Integration Solution Architect
d72ebe3d.description:
**About Us**
Dyson is a global technology company powered by ingenuity and relentless curiosity. We reimagine everyday products through radical innovation—from vacuums and hair care to air purification and robotics. Our teams thrive on challenge and continuous improvement.
  
  
As we expand into new markets, our technology function is central to Dyson’s future—ensuring every solution scales securely and delivers best-in-class experiences for millions of people. Here, architecture isn’t just about systems. It’s about unleashing ideas, shaping outcomes, and making a real difference.
  
  
Join a community that celebrates disruption, values diverse perspectives, and empowers you to lead at the edge of possibility.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Principle Integration Solution Architect, you’ll be a senior technical leader within Dyson’s Solution Architecture team, reporting to the Head of Solution Architecture. You’ll set the direction for enterprise integration and interface solutions across a varied technology landscape, lead architects and engineers through complex delivery, and ensure our integration capabilities support Dyson’s global growth.
  
  
You’ll own integration solution architecture from discovery through delivery, designing secure, reusable interfaces across APIs, events, messaging, data exchange and batch or file-based patterns. Supporting communication across platforms including SAP Commerce, Salesforce, Adobe, SAP and other enterprise services, you’ll turn complex requirements into pragmatic roadmaps and high-quality solutions that deliver measurable outcomes.
  
  
Beyond individual solution design, you’ll provide technical leadership across the integration community: chairing design reviews, guiding delivery teams, coaching architects and engineers, and raising standards through clear governance. You’ll champion appropriate integration patterns, reusable assets, automation, observability and responsible innovation across MuleSoft and other integration technologies, while communicating trade-offs and recommendations confidently to senior technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve Dyson’s enterprise integration strategy, reference architecture, standards and roadmap across integration technologies – owning and running our Integration Centre of Excellence.
* Lead solution architecture for complex integration initiatives from discovery and options assessment through implementation and operational handover.
* Design scalable interfaces using the most appropriate patterns, including APIs, events, messaging, data synchronization, managed file transfer and batch integration.
* Establish reusable patterns and assets for security, error handling, logging, monitoring, data transformation, versioning and lifecycle management.
* Lead architecture and design reviews, challenge constructively, document key decisions and ensure solutions comply with enterprise, security and data standards.
* Provide technical direction to architects, engineers, partners and suppliers; remove ambiguity, resolve complex design issues and maintain delivery quality.
* Coach and mentor others through pairing, design critique and knowledge sharing, building a strong and inclusive integration engineering community.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to translate outcomes and non-functional requirements into pragmatic architecture decisions and delivery plans.
* Drive the reliability, performance and cost effectiveness of integration services through observability, capacity planning, automation and continual improvement.
* Manage architectural risks, dependencies and technical debt, escalating decisions clearly and supporting delivery against agreed scope, quality and timelines.

**About You**

* Prerequisite: significant hands-on experience designing and delivering enterprise integrations using MuleSoft Any point Platform in complex, large-scale environments.
* Broad knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, including RESTful and asynchronous APIs, event-driven integration, messaging, data transformation, managed file transfer, batch processing and hybrid integration.
* Practical experience across relevant MuleSoft capabilities such as Any point Design Center, API Manager, Exchange, Runtime Manager and Cloud Hub or equivalent runtime models.
* Experience selecting and applying appropriate integration technologies and patterns based on business outcomes, architecture principles and non-functional requirements.
* A strong grasp of security, identity, resilience, performance, observability, CI/CD and automated testing for integration solutions.
* Proven leadership of architects and engineers, including setting direction, delegating effectively, providing constructive challenge and developing others.
* Experience governing solution designs and working with delivery partners or suppliers to achieve consistent engineering standards and outcomes.
* The judgement to balance strategic architecture with pragmatic delivery, making clear decisions when requirements are incomplete or priorities compete.
* Confident communication with senior stakeholders, with the ability to explain complex technical choices, risks and trade-offs in accessible language.
* Experience integrating major enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Adobe or comparable applications.
* Experience in migrating integration platforms.
* MuleSoft certification is desirable; equivalent evidence of deep MuleSoft expertise will also be considered.
* A collaborative, inclusive and improvement-focused leadership style, with curiosity about automation, AI and emerging integration approaches.

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

The
**Lead Technical Program Manager, Fraud Technology**
is responsible for driving end-to-end technology governance, architectural alignment, and delivery execution for Citi’s Enterprise Fraud Prevention initiatives. In this role, you will serve as a technical authority navigating critical cross-functional dependencies across distributed engineering squads, data science teams, core platform services, and risk/compliance partners. You will blend deep systems acumen with executive presence and crisp, diplomatic communication to guide multi-million-dollar programs from architectural discovery through production rollout. This position requires an in-depth understanding of how sub-functional units integrate end-to-end, as well as the ability to coordinate across diverse groups to achieve broad organizational objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**End-to-End Program Delivery & Strategic Roadmap Execution**

* Lead end-to-end technology planning, execution, and delivery governance across complex, mission-critical programs within Citi’s Fraud Technology Book of Work.
* Define, baseline, and track program milestones, critical paths, and deliverable commitments across multiple agile squads and hybrid legacy/modernized distributed platforms.
* Proactively manage complex cross-program dependencies, identifying technical bottlenecks, architectural conflicts, and resource constraints early to formulate and execute effective mitigation plans.
* Establish rigorous Definition of Done (DoD), release readiness criteria, and robust operational cutover strategies tailored for high-throughput, ultra-low-latency financial transaction systems.

**Architecture Alignment, Dependency Management & Systems Integration**

* Guide stakeholders and engineering squads through complex trade-off evaluations, balancing business priorities, customer experience, platform strategy, performance benchmarks, and long-term maintainability.
* Facilitate technical architecture reviews, interface design agreements (REST/SOAP APIs, Kafka/event-driven streaming), and binding cross-team integration contracts.
* Apply deep technical domain knowledge across core software engineering disciplines, including microservices architectures, distributed API protocols, hybrid cloud and on-premise infrastructure, and resilient data layers.

**AI-Augmented Program Management & Operational Excellence**

* Champion and integrate modern Generative AI (GenAI) and automated tooling to streamline and modernize traditional program management workflows:

+ Automate the synthesis of complex technical discussions, action items, and Architectural Decision Records (ADRs).
+ Accelerate the generation of executive dashboards, release notes, and milestone variance analytics.
+ Standardize AI-driven delivery best practices, prompts, and reporting templates across participating engineering teams.

**Executive Presence & Stakeholder Communication**

+ Serve as the primary strategic liaison between engineering teams and executive leadership, articulating delivery health, technical trade-offs, blockers, and architectural risks with clarity, precision, and business context.
+ Influence, negotiate, and align cross-functional stakeholders across organizational boundaries without formal line authority.
+ Author and deliver high-impact executive collateral (executive one-pagers, steering committee presentations, risk heatmaps) and crisp briefings to Senior Leadership (MD/C-suite level).
+ Cultivate strong collaborative partnerships across business units, external technology vendors, operations, internal audit, and technology peers.

**Risk, Governance, and Control Management**

+ Proactively identify, evaluate, track, and remediate technical program risks, architectural vulnerabilities, and control deficiencies across all delivery tiers.
+ Ensure strict compliance with Citi’s Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) governance, architecture review board standards, data governance policies, and relevant regulatory mandates (e.g., OCC, Federal Reserve, PCI-DSS, Model Risk Management).
+ Champion operational resilience and release integrity, enforcing zero-unauthorized-change policies, comprehensive automated rollback strategies, and stringent incident management protocols.

**Experience & Domain Expertise**

+ 10+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Technology Project Management, Engineering Delivery, or related technology leadership roles managing large-scale enterprise initiatives.
+ 2+ years of experience supporting payments, fintech, fraud prevention, risk management, or other highly regulated technology environments utilizing Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or Hybrid delivery frameworks.
+ Strong technical fluency in modern software architecture patterns, including microservices, REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architectures (Kafka/MQ), hybrid cloud/on-prem environments, and distributed database systems.
+ Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing dependencies, tracking critical-path milestones, and supporting vendor integrations in matrixed organizations.
+ Demonstrated ability to deliver complex technology initiatives from planning through production deployment.

**Project Management & AI Tooling**

+ PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or comparable project/program management certification preferred.
+ Hands-on experience with enterprise delivery, portfolio, and collaboration tools including Jira, Confluence, Jira Align, MS Project, and ServiceNow.
+ Experience utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, LLMs, or enterprise AI platforms) to support reporting, documentation, meeting synthesis, and delivery management activities.

+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business-focused messaging.
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity.

a9ec8758.description:
**Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!**
Kobie, a 35-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
  
  
**About The Team And What We’ll Build Together**
Kobie is seeking a dynamic and highly organized Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive the successful execution of our product portfolio and optimize delivery across Data Science teams supporting our AI Product Set. The TPM plays a critical part in ensuring our Product and our Data Science teams operate efficiently, meet delivery goals, and align work with broader business objectives. The TPM is not a developer, but a process leader who is focused on driving innovation, improving operations, managing workflows, and enabling delivery through visibility, structure, and collaboration.
  
  
**About Kobie**
Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture.
  
  
As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award-winning culture to a new region - creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.
  
  
We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.
  
  
Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.
  
  
To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work - recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work-life balance.
  
  
As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.
  
  
Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.

27accf51.title: Domain Solution Architect
27accf51.description:
**Job Title: BFS Digital Solution Architect Lead Advisor - BPS**
**Req ID:**
372422
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a BFS solution architect to join our team in India (hybrid/remote), reporting to the Global Head of BFS Solutions, Agentic AI and BPS.
  
  
**BPS Solution Architect**
At NTT DATA Services, we know that with the right people on board, anything is possible. We’re building the next era of Business Process Services—AI-native, agentic BPaaS that fuses deep process expertise with LLMs, AI agents, and data-first design. This is not outsourcing 2.0—it’s services-as-software, built for scale, speed, and intelligence.
  
  
Join our founding team and reinvent how banks and financial services lend, serve, and grow, with AI native operations built to be faster, smarter, and more adaptive than anything the market has seen.
  
  
Location: Hybrid/Remote Type: Full-Time Role
  
  
Overview:
  
  
You will design AI native solutions for lending and banking operations within the BFS solutioning team. You will work alongside client stakeholders, product teams, and engineers to map current state operations and Co create the future state processes and solution designs for banks and financial services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Understand BFS client workflows (commercial / small business lending, onboarding, servicing, KYC / AML) and pain points
* Design solution components for ai-native landing operations, leveraging modular agentic platforms
* Define data and process models in collaboration with ontology and ML teams
* Translate client needs into use cases, requirements and demo scenarios
* Build business cases, collateral, and inputs to proposals, RFPs, and POVs
* Support client presentations and workshops, presenting solutions sections to senior stakeholders

**Required Skills**
:
  
  

* 8-12 years in the BFS domain, with depth in lending operations
* Strong understanding of digital transformation and BPS
* Experience in designing automation workflows or BPaaS models
* Excellent client-facing communication and executive storytelling skills
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, even if not hands-on

**Preferred Skills**
:
  
  

* Onboarding and KYC / AML familiarity
* Exposure to collections, loss mitigation, or mortgage and consumer lending business processes
* Understanding of model risk management and AI governance
* Hands-on knowledge of intelligent document processing for spreading, statements, and loan documents
* Lean Six Sigma certification; MBA

d82bc170.title: Senior Data Architect
d82bc170.description:
CSS Innovation Studios is seeking Senior Data Engineers/Architects with deep expertise in PySpark and data engineering to deliver strategic AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s largest enterprise customers.

In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work directly with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, chief architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize legacy data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.

The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems supporting generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; lead complex platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply and evolve Oracle product capabilities through real-world customer deployments.

* 10–12+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms.
* Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Principal Solution Architect, Consulting Engineer, or technical leader in professional services.
* Expert knowledge of one or more modern cloud data platforms like Databricks
* Extensive hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Scala or Java, Kafka and modern data ecosystems.
* Exposure to building autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines.
* Deep expertise in Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance engineering, optimization, and tuning at scale.
* Demonstrated success modernizing enterprise analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads.
* Must have a solid understanding of networking concepts to design and optimize data transmission networks, configure network settings, and diagnose and resolve network-related issues.
* Strong understanding of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability.
* Outstanding executive communication, customer advisory, and stakeholder-management skills.

  

Lead architecture and delivery of enterprise Oracle AI Data Platform transformations, including platform implementations and migrations.

* Design and build scalable, governed, AI-ready data architectures, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products.
* Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns.
* Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets.
* Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, cluster sizing, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance at scale.
* Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services.
* Create reusable migration accelerators, reference architectures, automation frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to solve complex technical challenges; share customer insights to inform product roadmaps.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout customer engagements.
* Mentor senior engineers globally, promote engineering excellence across CSS, and continuously evaluate emerging AI, cloud, and data-engineering practices.

1e97be04.title: AI Customer Engineer, Digital Natives, Google Cloud
1e97be04.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience working within tech startups or digital-native organizations.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in developing financial services or telecommunication agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or the Google AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Experience with cloud technologies including SaaS applications, iPaaS, business automation solutions, Cloud infrastructure, Agentic AI, and cloud networking.
* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) Gateways.
* Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
Leading with the future, the AI GTM team are trusted AI advisors, expanding across Google to deliver transformative customer experiences that shape the next generation of their business. Partnering to provide AI expertise, thought leadership, and industry best practices, we revolutionize customer outcomes.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the technical solution for complex workloads within AI product areas to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
* Combine business strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.
* Provide technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building customer relationships.
* Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go-to-Market team. Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.
* Work within product and engineering management systems to document, prioritize and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

cac8f488.title: Cloud AI Engineer, Technical Onboarding Center
cac8f488.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
  
  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, or technical consulting, infrastructure with 2 years of experience in building and deploying GenAI applications, intelligent agents, or LLM-powered solutions to production.
* Experience building and orchestrating agents using ADKs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen and in designing modern application architectures, including API design, microservices, and integrating AI models into existing enterprise software systems.
* Experience with Python.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Google Cloud Professional certifications.
* Experience implementing scalable RAG architectures and securely connecting LLMs with external productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace) and complex enterprise databases in high-traffic environments.
* Experience leading technical project deployments, working with engineering teams, or acting as the technical lead on large-scale cloud transformations.
* Experience deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise-grade generative AI platforms (particularly Gemini Enterprise), with an understanding of AI security, Large Language Models (LLM) governance, guardrails, and enterprise compliance requirements (e.g., data privacy regulations).

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Cloud AI Engineer, you will play a key leadership role in ensuring that strategic customers have the best experience adopting Gemini Enterprise alongside the broader Google Cloud Agentic AI suite of products. You will design and implement robust, production-ready application architectures to support customer use cases, leveraging Gemini Enterprise and core Google AI products. You will work with customers to identify opportunities to transform their workflows with autonomous agents, actively removing technical barriers to ensure successful deployment and high adoption rates of Gemini Enterprise. You will have access to Google’s technology to monitor application performance, debug and troubleshoot complex agent behaviors, and address customer and partner needs. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the delivery, deployment, and implementation of Gemini Enterprise solutions, utilizing Agent Development Kits (ADKs) to solve complex, enterprise-scale technical customer challenges.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to Google’s most strategic customers to shape their AI strategy, drive, and accelerate the adoption of Gemini Enterprise.
* Provide architectural guidance on existing product challenges, collaborate closely with the engineering team to address gaps, and architect scalable workarounds for edge cases.
* Deliver leading practice recommendations and technical presentations adapted to different levels of key business and technical stakeholders (including C-suite executives) to proactively foster Gemini Enterprise adoption and enablement.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

e49adf1c.title: GenAI Solution Architect
e49adf1c.description:
Lead Solution Architect – GenAI & Cloud  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Gurgaon, Haryana  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid  
**Experience:** 10+ Years

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Lead Solution Architect – GenAI & Cloud to design and deliver scalable, secure, and reliable technology solutions across cloud computing, application architecture, and Generative AI.

The ideal candidate will have strong software development and solution architecture experience, with the ability to take proof-of-concepts (PoCs) and minimum viable products (MVPs) into production-ready enterprise solutions. The role requires hands-on technical expertise, architectural decision-making, and collaboration with cross-functional engineering and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and implement scalable, secure, and resilient application and cloud architectures.
* Lead the development and production deployment of PoCs, prototypes, and MVPs.
* Design solutions involving Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agents.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance across application development, cloud infrastructure, APIs, integrations, and data platforms.
* Develop and guide the implementation of microservices, distributed systems, containerized applications, and serverless solutions.
* Establish CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps practices, automated testing, and application monitoring.
* Apply security, performance, scalability, reliability, and cost-optimization principles throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Develop reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with cloud, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and delivery teams to ensure production readiness.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend suitable solutions for enterprise adoption.
* Conduct architecture and code reviews and mentor developers and engineering teams.
* Support the transition of validated solutions to production and enterprise support teams.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, or solution design.
* Proven experience in hands-on software development and delivering PoCs or MVPs into production environments.
* Strong knowledge of AWS and/or Microsoft Azure cloud platforms.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, and application security.
* Practical understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI architecture.
* Familiarity with Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Understanding of cloud-native architecture, system integration, observability, and performance optimization.
* Strong problem-solving, technical leadership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred Skills

* Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and vector database integrations.
* Knowledge of AI guardrails, responsible AI practices, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience with serverless architecture, infrastructure automation, and cloud security.
* Familiarity with React or Next.js.
* Experience with enterprise security, data privacy, risk management, and architecture governance.
* Experience establishing reusable engineering practices and mentoring technical teams.

Work Details

* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **Work Location:** Gurgaon, Haryana
* **Work Arrangement:** Hybrid
* **Experience Required:** 10+ Years
* **Compensation:** Up to ₹35,00,000 per annum, depending on relevant experience and suitability.

Candidates who can join immediately or are currently serving their notice period are welcome to apply. Previous experience working with multinational organizations is preferred.

Pay: Up to ₹3,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

c577b1ae.title: Solution Architect – Data & AI Solutions
c577b1ae.description:
**Key Responsibilities**
Presales & Client Engagement
  
  

* Partner with sales and industry teams to design client-ready demos, proof-of-concepts, and technical solution blueprints.
* Present complex architectures in a clear, business-outcome-driven manner to both executive and technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, and deal shaping.
* Act as a trusted advisor in client conversations, highlighting differentiators of Data & AI Solutions.

Solution Architecture & Demo Environments
  
  

* Architect distributed, scalable, and resilient data and AI platforms for presales demonstrations.
* Design abstraction layers for multi-model AI orchestration, including fallback logic, dynamic model switching, and cost control.
* Lead implementation of event-driven architectures using messaging frameworks (Kafka, Pulsar, SQS, etc.) and state machines.
* Build reusable, industry-specific demo environments leveraging hyperscaler services and data platforms.

Observability, Security & Compliance
  
  

* Define and enforce observability standards for demo and enterprise environments (logging, tracing, telemetry, real-time alerting).
* Implement zero-trust security models (RBAC/ABAC, IAM, OAuth2, encryption, API gateways).
* Ensure all demo and client environments meet compliance standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Work with Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Governance teams to align demos with business/regulatory needs.
* Collaborate with IMUs (verticals) to build domain-specific demo templates (e.g., Insurance claims, Healthcare payment integrity, Banking KYC/fraud, Retail personalization).
* Provide hands-on support to engineering teams during delivery, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.

Innovation & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Stay ahead of hyperscaler advancements, AI/ML frameworks, and orchestration patterns.
* Drive technical due diligence, PoCs, and vendor/platform evaluations.
* Create technical artifacts (architecture diagrams, design patterns, runbooks).
* Mentor presales engineers and junior architects in solution design and client presentation skills.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Certifications preferred: - Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Kubernetes / CNCF ecosystem.
* Architecture frameworks (TOGAF, SAFe).

**Skills & Experience**
Must-Have Skills & Experience
  
  

* 15+ years in software architecture, presales engineering, or enterprise data/AI platform design.
* Hands-on expertise in at least two hyperscaler platforms: - Azure (Fabric, Synapse, Data Factory, Azure ML, Power BI).
* AWS (Redshift, Glue, S3, SageMaker, Lake Formation).
* GCP (BigQuery, Dataplex, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub).
* Proven experience architecting distributed systems, microservices, and scalable AI/ML platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata, Lineage, and DataOps.
* Expertise in event-driven systems and asynchronous workflows.
* Hands-on with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Advanced programming with Python (async), TypeScript/JavaScript, or Go.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, service mesh (Istio), serverless design patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD automation, GitOps, Terraform, Helm.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and client engagement skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms and usage-based billing.
* Familiarity with data mesh, knowledge graphs, and semantic interoperability.
* Knowledge of frontend architecture patterns (micro-frontends, data visualizations).
* Experience building presales demo or sandbox environments.

Exposure to agentic AI concepts and LLM-based orchestration.

5cc52ee4.title: Architect
5cc52ee4.description:
Area(s) of responsibility
  
  

* Role Name: IoT Architect/Lead

**Experience Level:**
*12+ years*
**Summary Description Of Role & Responsibilities**
*We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated IoT Solutions Architect/Lead to drive the design, development, and deployment of cutting-edge IoT solutions that leverage Docker, Node.js, MQTT, and other protocols. As a leader in our IoT team, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to create scalable, secure, and reliable IoT architectures.*
**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field with 10+ years for relevant experience
* Proven experience (4+ years) as a Solutions Architect or Technical Lead in designing and delivering IoT solutions.
* In-depth knowledge of containerization technologies, particularly Docker, and experience with container orchestration platforms (e.g., docker and Kubernetes).
* Strong proficiency in Node.js / C# / Python development for IoT applications, including asynchronous programming and event-driven architecture.
* Expertise in IoT communication protocols, including MQTT, SOAP, and RESTful APIs.
* Familiarity with SQL, NoSQL, Redis or other caching and storage technologies for optimizing data processing and storage.
* Time series DB applications
* Solid understanding of microservices architecture and design patterns.
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and serverless computing for IoT.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to architect solutions for scalability, performance, and reliability.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Leadership experience, with a track record of mentoring and guiding development teams.
* A passion for staying up-to-date with emerging IoT technologies and trends.
* Relevant certifications in IoT, cloud computing, or related areas are a plus.

8847d41a.title: System Architect - Senior
8847d41a.description:
At Cognyte, you’ll collaborate with expert colleagues around the globe to solve problems most people will never even know exist!
  
  
You’ll be part of building unique solutions shaped by real investigative methodologies, enabling our customers to identify, investigate, visualize and prevent criminal, terror and security threats worldwide.
  
  
These solutions are used by law enforcement, national security, and national and military intelligence agencies in almost 100 countries to turn massive, diverse data into clear, actionable intelligence for a safer world.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Senior System Architect**
to join our NI (Network Intelligence) Architecture Group. The role is focused on designing and evolving complex software and application architectures, with emphasis on scalability, performance, reliability, and cloud-native technologies.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a strong software architecture background and solid knowledge of telecommunication systems, networking technologies, and protocols. You will be responsible for defining end-to-end system architecture, application interactions, interfaces, data flows, and integration approaches while working closely with development, product, and R&D teams.
  
  
**As a Cognyter, you will:**

* Analyze requirements from product roadmaps and customer projects, translating them into detailed infrastructure designs and accurate effort estimations.
* Provide solution architecture recommendations and effort estimates as part of presales and business development activities.
* Conduct infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, and performance tuning to ensure optimal application and system performance.
* Serve as a technical expert, providing guidance and best practices to R&D teams across infrastructure and architecture domains.
* Collaborate closely with R&D and Product Management teams in an Agile environment to design scalable, resilient, and high-performance solutions.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive innovation and continuous improvement across products and platforms.

Requirements:
  
  
**For that mission you’ll need:**

* BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent degree (minimum requirement).
* 10-15 years of relevant industry experience in software architecture, system design, and distributed systems, including at least 5 years of proven experience leading and mentoring global R&D teams.

That’s why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry’s largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de-identified, real-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience. The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare’s most complex questions for our partners. Across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease.
  
  
As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver “wow,” and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way.
  
  
**Leadership At Komodo Health**
Mavens is a Komodo Health company focused on delivering Salesforce-based solutions that drive workflow and digital engagement across the life sciences industry. The Mavens Managed Services team partners closely with our customers post initial implementation to support long term success with our solutions. Our managed services team serves as trusted advisors who understand both the evolving technology and the business challenges our customers face.
  
  
Managed Services Consultants are the primary long-term partners for our customers, acting as a fully integrated extension of the customer’s IT team. They balance day-to-day administrative support with complex release management, ensuring that applications are functioning properly to support business-critical processes. They play a strategic role in building and maintaining strong customer relationships and continuously seek opportunities to further assist customers with their evolving needs.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a goal-oriented and self-motivated individual who is comfortable working in fast-paced work environments. They demonstrate strong collaboration skills by working effectively across internal teams and with customers to drive shared outcomes. They hold themselves accountable to commitments and follow through with a high degree of ownership. They bring creativity and resourcefulness to problem-solving, finding practical solutions in ambiguous or complex situations. They approach interactions with empathy, fostering trust with both customers and colleagues.
  
  
**The Opportunity at Mavens**
**Communications & Project Management**

* Lead Stakeholder Engagement: Lead weekly status calls, third-party vendor alignments, and design reviews.
* Manage Project Documentation: Prepare status call content (dashboards, agendas) and manage the RAIL (Rolling Action Item Log) by creating and updating items in real-time.
* Release Planning: Create and maintain release timelines and support customers with release candidate prioritization.
* Governance & Business Planning: Provide technical recommendations and work in collaboration with customers to define a clear roadmap.
* Internal Collaboration: Maintain clear and proactive communication with internal stakeholders - including practice leads, consultants, developers, architects, and QA - to share customer context, coordinate delivery activities, and surface risks or escalations through the appropriate channels.

**Requirements & Build**

* Analyze Business Needs: Prepare for and lead requirements gathering sessions.
* Technical Implementation: Assess Level of Effort (LOE) for functional items and complete or delegate build/configuration changes.
* DevOps & Deployment: Manage repositories and promote completed build to higher environments.
* Maintain Documentation: Manage requirements, test cases, functional and technical guides, integration specifications, and other application documentation.

**Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Validation: Perform System Integration Testing (SIT) and provide guidance/support for User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Spot Checks: Validate deployments by checking changes in higher environments.

**Ongoing Support & Maintenance**

* User & Data Management: Handle user lifecycle (creation, deactivation, permissions) and maintain data integrity (duplicate management, record updates).
* Issue Management: Investigate reported issues, monitor error reports, and triage/escalate problems as needed to ensure resolution.
* Reporting: Create and update reports and perform data extractions/exports for the customer.

**Competencies**

* Platform Expertise: Strong knack for understanding how applications work and envisioning solutions on the Force.com platform.
* Functional Advisory: Ability to provide "how-to" technical assistance and advise customers on product features and enhancements.
* Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to seamlessly connect and translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
* Documentation Mastery: Experience authoring requirements, system specifications, and application guides.
* Project Management: Understanding of core project management concepts, including timeline management and LOE assessment.
* Industry Knowledge: Life Sciences or Pharmaceutical experience is a significant plus.
* Education & Certification: Bachelor’s degree preferred; Salesforce Certification is required.

**Values**
If you are wondering if this is the right role for you, ask yourself if you are already a Maven:
  
  

* A Maven is open to saying yes and shows good judgment in ambiguity
* A Maven takes accountability and is constantly learning
* A Maven is fearless, resourceful, and scrappy
* A Maven communicates with integrity, empathy, and humility
* A Maven brings energy into the room and gives more than they take
* A Maven in an entrepreneur who creates opportunity and momentum
* A Maven is a craftsman who uses technology to solve business problems
* A Maven makes our customer the hero

**Additional skills and experience we’d prioritize (nice to have)…**

* Salesforce Certification and consulting experience a plus
* Life Sciences experience, particularly Pharmaceutical is a plus
* Experience interacting with, managing, or building with AI agentic workflows

* This position involves rotational shifts.

**Komodo's AI Standard**
At Komodo, we're not just witnessing the AI revolution – we're leading it. This is a pivotal moment in time, where being first to market with AI transforms industries and sets the bar. We've already established industry leadership in leveraging AI to revolutionize healthcare, and we expect every team member to contribute. AI here isn't optional; it's foundational. We expect you to integrate AI into your daily work – from summarizing documents to automating workflows and uncovering insights. This isn't just about efficiency; it's about making every moment more meaningful, building on trust in AI, and driving our collective success.
  
  
***Join us in shaping the future of healthcare intelligence.*
Where You’ll Work**
Komodo Health has a hybrid work model with hubs in San Francisco, New York City, and Chicago. Roles vary — some can be performed from anywhere in the country, others are scoped to a specific region, and some are based near one of our hubs. For hub-based Dragons, we're building intentional in-office rhythms alongside the flexibility that's core to how we work. Whatever your setup, expectations will always be clear before you join.

d45061a7.title: Customer Engagement Manager
d45061a7.description:
**About Ema**
Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
  
  
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
  
  
**The Role**
The Customer Engagement Manager owns a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship, every expansion opportunity. Think of this as the McKinsey Associate Partner model applied to enterprise AI delivery.
  
  
You are the single point of accountability for your accounts. The customer calls you — not your manager — when they have a problem. You staff delivery teams, oversee solution quality, run executive readouts, measure ROI, drive adoption, rebuild trust when things break, and grow the book through proven production value.
  
  
**This is not a project management role.**
This is an account ownership role that combines delivery orchestration, outcome ownership, customer leadership, and commercial growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Account Ownership
* Own your accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship. Everything good or bad stops with you.
* Be the single point of contact the customer calls for any problem — delivery, quality, adoption, escalation, or expansion.
* Maintain a holistic view of each account: engagement status, risk exposure, opportunity pipeline, and the customer’s strategic priorities for the quarter.
* Run account planning: engagement roadmaps, resource forecasting, risk assessment, and growth strategy.
* Delivery Orchestration
* Staff and direct delivery teams (Engineering Leads, Product Managers) across your accounts.
* Oversee delivery quality across all engagements: review solution architectures, attend go-live rehearsals, ensure evaluation rigor.
* Manage cross-engagement dependencies within an account (e.g., shared integration infrastructure between parallel deployments).
* Serve as the delivery escalation point: join war rooms, coordinate fixes across Engineering and Product, and communicate resolution to the customer.
* You don’t write code — but you review architectures, challenge unrealistic scope, and ensure go-live readiness. Your leverage is orchestration and judgment.
* Outcome Ownership & Continuous Improvement
* Own post-go-live outcomes: adoption, ROI, accuracy, and user trust. This role absorbs the Outcomes Manager function for your accounts.
* Run regular usage readouts: AI deflection rates, false positive/negative trends, HITL escalation patterns, user bypass rates, and trust signals.
* Separate product gaps from process, training, or expectation gaps. Not everything that looks broken is an engineering problem.
* Drive continuous improvement cycles: readout → diagnose → prioritize → fix → re-measure.
* Communicate outcomes in business language: efficiency gains, cost savings, error reduction — not just dashboards, but diagnosis and action plans.
* Executive Stakeholder Leadership
* Run QBRs with VP/C-level stakeholders: present outcomes, risks, improvement plans, and the strategic roadmap.
* Navigate internal customer politics: when the VP of IT and VP of Business disagree on priorities, facilitate alignment around shared success metrics.
* Communicate bad news credibly: present the data, the diagnosis, and the recovery plan — without losing trust.
* Handle C-level escalations. When the CTO threatens to terminate or the CFO questions ROI, you are the person in the room.
* Commercial Growth
* Grow your book through outcome-driven expansion: deliver the first SOW excellently, measure ROI rigorously, present evidence to the C-suite, then propose the next SOW grounded in proven value.
* Identify new use cases by deeply understanding customer business processes and pain points — not by pushing a product catalog.
* Know when to push for expansion vs. when to stabilize. Premature expansion erodes trust. You earn the right to grow by delivering first.
* Co-sell with Sales: provide the delivery credibility and outcome evidence that makes expansion proposals close.
* Product & Platform Partnership
* Act as the voice of your customers to Product and Core Engineering. Translate field patterns into structured, actionable feedback — not one-off requests.
* Identify cross-customer patterns that signal platform gaps or opportunities.
* Partner with Product on customer-facing roadmap discussions: what’s coming, what’s not, and how to manage expectations.
* Team Development
* Coach Engineering Leads and Implementation Managers on architecture quality, customer communication, delivery discipline, and outcome thinking.
* Promote shared standards and best practices across engagements.
* Build reusable account-level assets: engagement playbooks, QBR templates, outcome tracking frameworks, and expansion qualification criteria.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 15+ years in enterprise technology delivery, consulting, account management, or customer leadership.
* 5+ years owning enterprise accounts end-to-end: delivery, outcomes, relationship, and growth — not individual projects within someone else’s account.
* Track record managing or directing delivery teams (Engineering Leads, TPMs, consultants) assigned to their accounts.
* Post-go-live outcome ownership: measured ROI, tracked adoption, driven continuous improvement, and rebuilt trust after production issues.
* Commercial accountability: grown account revenue through outcome-driven expansion, not just retention.
* Enterprise stakeholder management at VP/C-level across multiple concurrent accounts.
* Production track record — beyond POCs. Scale and accountability required.

**Preferred**

* Experience with AI, automation, or agentic workflow platforms in production.
* Background at a consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte) or enterprise SaaS PS org (ServiceNow, Salesforce, UiPath) in a delivery-heavy account leadership role.
* Experience with partner-mediated delivery (delivering through consulting partners to end clients).
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations (APIs, auth, CRM/HRIS/ITSM platforms) at a judgment level, not implementation level.
* Experience in a scaling startup ($5M–$50M ARR) where account management practices were being built, not inherited.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

**The role sits between sales and engineering, and is accountable to both**

  

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India team through Flexiple. Deals are increasingly won or lost on whether a prospect's technical evaluator believes the product will work in their environment, and right now the founders are personally doing that call. It does not scale past about here. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

  

**What the week contains**

  

Technical discovery with prospects, which mostly means finding out what they actually have rather than what the RFP says. Building demonstrations against a customer's real constraints. Running proofs of concept and being straight about what did not work. Writing up integration requirements clearly enough that engineering can act on them without a second meeting.

  

**The uncomfortable part**

  

Telling a sales lead the deal will not work as scoped. That happens, and the people who last in this role are the ones who do it early rather than letting a proof of concept quietly fail three weeks later.

  

**Looking for**

  

* 4 to 8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering or a customer-facing technical role
* Enough hands-on ability to build a working integration, not only describe one
* APIs, authentication models and the usual enterprise objections around data residency
* Composure in front of a sceptical technical audience

  

Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Chennai, or remote within India, with some travel to customer sites. A screening call, a technical conversation, a live scenario, then time with the founding team.

  

*Applying once also puts you forward for later customer-facing engineering roles here.*

ac2ed729.title: Claude Platform Managed Services Lead
ac2ed729.description:
**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
The Managed Services Lead is the single point of accountability to the Customer for all Services delivered under the Three-Track Model (Support, Managed Services, Consulting) for the Anthropic Claude Platform Managed Services engagement. The role owns Transition governance and planning through to Steady State, and leads communications, hypercare, and continuous improvement across the engagement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the single point of accountability to the Customer for all Services delivered under the Support, Managed Services, and Consulting tracks.
* Lead Transition Period governance: establish the RACI and finalize the transition charter; run the weekly governance touchpoint with Customer stakeholders throughout the Transition Period.
* Own execution of the four-phase Program Timeline — Mobilize & Governance, Discovery & Readiness, Transition, and Optimize & Scale — and drive the transition from the Outgoing Providers (Accenture and Tribe AI) to BAU operations.
* Track and report progress against the transition milestones: BAU Readiness, BAU Assumable, Transition Exit, and the quarterly Industrialize marker (continued transition to agentic delivery labor).
* Coordinate the formal, time-boxed knowledge-transfer exercise with the Outgoing Providers, ensuring implementation artefacts (configurations, prompt/agent catalog, integration documentation) are captured and validated.
* Establish and maintain the executive dashboard for adoption, cost, and value reporting, and chair the reporting cadence with Customer's Executive Sponsor.
* Provide hypercare support through cutover to Steady State and own the transition to ongoing operations.
* Ensure ServiceNow/ITSM configuration (resolver groups, service level clocks, role-based access controls) is completed and fit for purpose for the Services.
* Own overall Service Level performance across SL-1 through SL-8, monitor risk to targets (particularly through the 60-day Stabilization Period), and drive remediation plans.
* Manage the change control process for any change to scope, rollout priority, or delivery expectations, escalating for amendment or Change Order as required.
* Serve as primary escalation point between the delivery team and Customer's AI Governance Lead, ITSM & AI Owner, and Executive Sponsor.

**Required Qualifications**

* Claude Certified Architect – Foundations (CCA-F) — Anthropic's official proctored certification for designing and shipping enterprise-grade Claude applications (or committed to obtaining it within an agreed timeframe of joining).
* Proven experience leading large, multi-track managed services engagements, ideally including platform transitions from an outgoing service provider.
* Strong command of ITSM/ServiceNow-based service delivery models, incident/change/service-request management, and service level frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience running structured transition/mobilization programs (RACI, transition charters, readiness assessments, cutover planning).
* Excellent executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable chairing governance forums and steering committees.
* Working knowledge of AI/GenAI platform operations (e.g., enterprise LLM platforms) sufficient to govern a Claude-based managed service.
* Experience managing knowledge-transfer exercises from incumbent/outgoing providers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience with the Anthropic Claude platform or comparable enterprise AI platforms.
* ITIL certification or equivalent service management credential.
* Experience in agentic/AI-augmented delivery models.
* Prior experience serving as an engagement lead for a client in professional/real estate services or similarly regulated industries.

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. **Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Infrastructure Specialist: Cloud Application Operations, you will provide 24/7 technical support for cloud-based solutions, addressing issues related to application, DevOps, middleware, security, and infrastructure. You will handle Level 1.5 remediation across the fleet using a standard workflow and incident handling process.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Provide Technical Support: Address issues related to application, DevOps, middleware, security, and infrastructure, utilizing various tools and technologies, including APIs, application services, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, microservices, containers, Kubernetes nodes, middleware components, network, security, and infrastructure.

* Ensure Cloud Elasticity: Manage Application ID and provide cloud elasticity by auto-scaling resources based on business requirements, ensuring efficient resource utilization.
* Monitor Client Environment: Utilize monitoring tools like IBM APM, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, NewRelic, Runscope, Netcool OmniBus to monitor the client's environment, identifying potential issues and taking proactive measures.
* Deliver Service Management Reports: Provide daily, weekly, and monthly integrated service management reports across the solution, ensuring transparency and visibility into service performance.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to Cloud Technologies: Familiarity with cloud-based solutions, including IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, microservices, containers, and Kubernetes nodes, with the ability to address related technical issues.
* Experience with Monitoring Tools: Exposure to monitoring tools like IBM APM, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, NewRelic, Runscope, and Netcool OmniBus, with the ability to utilize them to identify potential issues.
* Understanding of ITIL Processes: Familiarity with ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change management, and Integrated Service Level Management, with the ability to apply them in a cloud application operations context.
* Experience with Ticketing and Automation Tools: Exposure to ticketing tools like ServiceNow, IBM Control Desk & Remedy, and automation tools such as Rundeck and IBM Runbook Automation, with the ability to effectively utilize them.
* Knowledge of Cloud Application Architecture: Understanding of high-level cloud application architecture, with the ability to perform initial analysis on incidents and manage Application ID and cloud elasticity.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Familiarity with Scripting Languages: Exposure to scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash would be beneficial for automation and efficiency in cloud application operations.
* Knowledge of Cloud Security: Familiarity with cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks would be advantageous in ensuring the security and integrity of cloud-based solutions.
* Experience with Agile Methodologies: Exposure to Agile methodologies and DevOps practices would be valuable in collaborating with development teams and ensuring smooth deployment of cloud applications.
