**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**
CMC Program Manager, Technical Development
  
  
Role Description
  
  
The CMC Program Manager will oversee CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) timelines and workstreams across projects within the Technical Development (TD) Functional Excellence framework. This role is pivotal for extracting information critical for resourcing, strategic decisions, and the annual Business Plan. The incumbent ensures that CMC timelines are consistent and integrated, and that resource/vendor allocation is clearly understood to meet budgetary targets.
  
  
Acting as the operational data "engine" that informs broader TD Functional Excellence scorecards and platforms, this role interfaces between TPLs, the Project Management (PM) group, and TD Functional Leaders. The incumbent leverages project management expertise and TD knowledge to drive accountability, increase transparency, and improve spending accuracy across the portfolio.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
CMC Timeline & Milestone Integrity
  
  

* Integrated Timeline Management: Harmonize comprehensive CMC project timelines to extract critical data on siting, resource requirements, and potential constraints, enabling data-driven strategic decisions.
* Critical Path & Clash Analysis: Identify dependencies and resourcing "clashes" in CMC development paths to facilitate proactive risk mitigation and siting prioritization.
* TD Functional Excellence Support: Collaborate across the TD Leadership (TPLs, Functional Leaders) to integrate CMC operational frameworks (e.g., milestone definitions, suitable KPIs, leading/lagging indicators) into broader TD standards and support initiatives as needed.

Resource Tracking
  
  

* Specific Resource Tracking: Define robust mechanisms to track resource utilization (FTEs/Capacity) at the project and functional levels to flag constraints or availability.
* Business Plan Support: Directly support the yearly Business Plan process by providing accurate resource forecasts and conducting "what-if" scenario modeling based on portfolio priorities or potential project accelerations.

Financial Stewardship & Budgetary Oversight
  
  

* Budget Alignment & Forecasting: Partner closely with TPLs and the PM group to improve the management of project-specific CMC budgets, ensuring accuracy in forecasting and strict adherence to financial targets.
* Audit & Variance Management: Proactively audit project-specific CMC spending against the Business Plan to flag variances, and improve future forecasting accuracy.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor or Master level degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Pharmacy, or similar).
* Several years of Project Management experience specifically within an R&D environment, with a strong focus on CMC workstreams.
* Demonstrated understanding of the Technical Development (TD) space, including regulatory requirements and manufacturing interfaces.
* Proven exposure to resource planning and budget management for complex programs.
* Ability to work effectively and influence global, cross-functional teams with or without direct authority.

**Additional Skills / Preferences**

* Strong experience with portfolio-level metadata and resource tracking tools.
* Deep understanding of the Innovation Cycle, MR process, and Business Plan process.
* Lean/6sigma experience and a mindset for process optimization.
* Knowledge of R&D IT tools and an agile learner of new systems for data visualization.

d31319b1.title: Lead Infrastructure Architect (Network Design, LAN/WAN, RFP )
d31319b1.description:
**Overview**
***WELCOME TO SITA***
SITA is the leading specialist in air transport communications and information technology. We don’t just connect the global aviation industry, we apply decades of experience and expertise to address almost every core business, operational, baggage, and passenger process in air transport. As an organization, we cover 95% of all international air travel destinations and work with over 2,800 air transport and government customers in every corner of the globe. Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of technology while embracing our collaborative, and inclusive culture.
  
  
**Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.**
**About The Role & Team**
Architect and design the solution to meet the business requirements of SITA customers predominantly in the pre-sales phase (RFPs or unsolicited opportunities) with focus on deployment, infrastructure, network architecture, and cloud architecture.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Manage technical solution in response to an RFP or unsolicited case that can consist of multiple SITA products (and portfolios), which includes new or evolving technologies and SITA solution portfolios.
* Design the deployment architecture and infrastructure specifications- servers and networking(LAN and WAN) for a solution to the customer’s requirements.
* Design deployment architecture for SITA products, including runtime environment in various flavours – on premise servers, virtualized server environment, containerized application environment through Kubernetes, public cloud, etc., to meet functional and non-functional system requirements.
* Design the network solution – both LAN/WLAN (in the airport) and WAN.
* Develop the conceptual design, and high-level design, and provide suitable inputs for the low-level design.
* Develop Bill of Materials:
* Compute & Storage and Networking.
* Specifications for - Servers, Virtual Machines, Containers (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes), etc. based on guidance from SITA's product toolkits.
* Storage - including backup solution
* Networking – LAN/WLAN components including switches, firewalls, etc. and WAN components including telco circuits, and also SD-WAN.
* Software Licensing requirements – Operating System, Database, Virtualization, etc.
* Other Infrastructure – Power (UPS), Racks, Cabling, etc.
* Guides and contributes to the design coordination and development solutions working with multiple parties both internally and externally.
* Contributes to the transfer of projects for implementation.
* Interact with colleagues to gain knowledge and to share ideas.

**Qualifications**
***EXPERIENCE***

* Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology and/or Engineering.
* 7- 10 years of experience in Information Technology, Air Transport, Telecom, or any other relevant industry in a technical Pre-Sales role
* Proven track record in producing communicating and documenting successful technical customer solutions
* Proven track record in managing solution proposals, costing, and customer presentation with great level of details.
* Expert in Network design WAN/Campus LAN, Cisco SDA, WLC, ISE, ACI, Nexus or similar technologies
* Solid experience in designing compute, storage, and networking solutions in all possible deployment scenarios – on premise, virtualized environment, private cloud, public cloud, or a mix.
* Solid experience in Security: IPSEC, Access-lists, NAT, understanding of Firewall functions
* Understanding of Cloud Connectivity such as Azure Express Route, AWS Direct Connect, is a great plus
* Understanding of Cloud Security such as Zscaler, Cisco umbrella is a great plus
* Understanding of Systems Monitoring – Network Monitoring, Security Monitoring (SIEM), etc.
* Understanding of Versa (or Cisco) SDWAN architecture, Salesforce and Service Now is a great plus
* Adept at drawing technical diagrams - good knowledge of Visio, competence in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Network design and standard vendor products
* Server sizing (virtualized environment and cloud) and software licensing
* Commercial Acumen

**What We Offer**
SITA’s workplace is all about diversity, many different countries and cultures are represented in our workforce. We collaborate in our impressive offices, embracing a hybrid work format. As part of our global benefits, we offer:
  
  
🏡
**Flex-week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your Team's needs).
  
  
⌚
**Flex-day:**
You may wish to flex your arrival time at the office, to beat the rush hours or you may want to leave the office earlier to pick up your kids from school or to go to your favorite game: We support you in being open about your needs and routine with you manager.
  
  
🌎
**Flex-location:**
Benefit for 30 working days from anywhere around the world each year!
  
  
🙌🏽
**Competitive benefits**
according to the local market
  
  
*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and self-identify in the application process*

3b7b45ea.title: Commercial Solution Architect
3b7b45ea.description:
The Commercial Architect plays a critical role in shaping Convatec’s global commercial technology ecosystem across DXP platforms, CMS, enterprise eCommerce, D365 CRM, ServiceNow and related commercial applications. The role is responsible for designing scalable, secure, and future-ready architectures that enable personalised digital experiences, global product catalogues, marketing activation, sales excellence, and customer support operations.
  
  
The Commercial Architect operates as a senior solution architect, partnering closely with business stakeholders across Marketing, Digital, eCommerce, Sales, IT and external technology partners.
  
  
**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end solution architecture for DXP, CMS, eCommerce, CRM, PIM, DAM and customer support platforms, ensuring coherent integration across Convatec’s commercial ecosystem.
* Design scalable, API-led architectures using REST, GraphQL, middleware, microservices and event-driven patterns.
* Produce high-quality HLA and HLD documentation and oversee adherence throughout project delivery.
* Work closely with product owners, engineering leads and vendors to define architectural runway for digital and commercial products.
* Evaluate existing solutions and identify gaps related to scalability, security, performance or alignment with business strategy.
* Lead architectural governance for commercial platforms including Optimizely, Sitecore, Acquia, CommerceTools, Optimizely Commerce, D365 CRM, ServiceNow and associated MarTech systems.
* Facilitate vendor selection, RFP responses, and total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis for new digital and commercial technologies.
* Ensure robust integration patterns across enterprise systems including PIM, DAM, SAP, Hyperion, D365, ODP, CDP, analytics platforms and third-party integrations.
* Advocate and embed privacy-by-design, security-by-design and AI-by-design principles.
* Support global digital experience and eCommerce transformation initiatives by ensuring architecture alignment and best practices.
* Provide architectural guidance to delivery teams and act as Technical Design Authority (TDA) for commercial solutions.
* Contribute to maturity assessments and future-state models for Convatec’s digital and commercial technology landscape.

**About You**
**Essential experience**

* Proven experience in solution architecture across enterprise Commercial, Digital Experience, CRM, and eCommerce technologies.
* Expertise with DXP and CMS platforms such as Optimizely, Sitecore, Acquia, Adobe Experience Manager.
* Good understanding of enterprise eCommerce platforms including CommerceTools, Optimizely Commerce, BigCommerce Enterprise or similar.
* Hands-on experience architecting and integrating D365 Sales/CRM, Customer Service, CDPs and marketing automation systems.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow for customer service, case management and workflow automation.
* Strong understanding of commercial data flows including PIM, DAM, pricing, product catalogues, SPQ (Sales Pricing & Quoting).
* Deep understanding of APIs, GraphQL, microservices, middleware, ESB patterns (Azure Integration Services preferred).
* Experienced in creating HLAs and HLDs to a very high standard, operating independently and proactively.
* Strong communication skills working with PMs, BAs, engineering teams, C-suite, and business leaders globally.
* Experience with enterprise cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.

**Technical competencies**

* Architecture modelling (C4, ArchiMate or equivalent).
* Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD, cloud hosting models and containerization
* Good understanding of web technologies, headless architecture, Jamstack, React, Next.js, or similar.
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance, privacy, security controls and compliance frameworks.
* Knowledge of databases including SQL and NoSQL.
* Understanding of SDLC methodologies: agile, SAFe, waterfall, DevOps.

At Convatec, we’re pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch. If you’re ready to make a real impact, apply today and help us bring our Forever Caring promise to life.

If you receive a suspicious approach over social media, text message, email or phone call about recruitment at Convatec, do not disclose any personal information or pay any fees whatsoever. If you’re unsure, please contact us at careers@Convatec.com.
  
  
**Equal opportunities**
Convatec provides equal employment opportunities for all current employees and applicants for employment. This policy means that no one will be discriminated against because of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, nationality, citizenship, ancestry, sex, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, genetic predisposing characteristics or any other basis prohibited by law.

066bac16.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
066bac16.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics – Senior Manager - Databricks Architect**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Senior Data & AI Architect with 13+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  
This role combines deep technical ownership of enterprise Lakehouse and data platform architecture with hands-on experience building Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions on Databricks. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing large-scale, production-grade data pipelines, architecting modern AI-driven solutions, and engaging directly with clients on strategic proposals and solution design.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and deliver scalable Data & AI solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and consumption layers.
* Design and optimize large-scale distributed data processing pipelines using Hadoop, Apache Spark, and PySpark.
* Build reusable, production-grade Python frameworks and pipelines for batch and streaming data engineering workloads.
* Define and implement cloud data architecture on AWS and/or Azure, covering storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring, with native Databricks integration.
* Own end-to-end ETL/ELT design, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality frameworks across the platform.
* Design dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension tables, SCD) to support analytical and reporting use cases.
* Design and build Agentic AI solutions on Databricks, including LLM integration, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
* Architect and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using Databricks — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.
* Establish and enforce engineering best practices for Git-based version control, code reviews, and CI/CD across development, test, and production environments.
* Lead performance optimization and production deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, and pipelines at scale.
* Participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, solution shaping, effort estimation, and architecture presentations.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer workshops, translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
* Mentor engineering teams on Databricks, Spark, cloud architecture, and modern AI/RAG engineering practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
13+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture, with strong hands-on experience across Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  

* Databricks

+ Strong expertise in Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and Unity Catalog.
+ Hands-on experience with Jobs/Workflows, performance optimization, and production deployments.

* Hadoop & Spark

+ Strong knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS, and Hive.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processi

* Python

+ Strong proficiency in Python for building scalable, reusable, production-grade data pipelines and frameworks.
+ Cloud
+ Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including cloud storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
+ Experience integrating Databricks with cloud-native services.

* Data Engineering

+ Expertise in ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality.
+ Proven ability to design scalable, production-ready pipeline architectures.

* SQL & Data Modelling

+ Strong SQL skills, with experience in dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension models, SCD, and analytical data models.

* Agentic AI

+ Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI solutions with Databricks, including LLMs, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.

* RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

+ Strong experience building RAG solutions using Databricks, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.

* Git & CI/CD

+ Strong knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment across multiple environments.
+ Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and/or Terraform is a plus.

* Strategic RFPs & Solutioning

+ Ability to participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, solution shaping, technical proposals, and effort estimations.
+ Experience delivering architecture presentations and leading customer workshops.

* Client Communication
* Strong client-facing and communication skills, with the ability to understand business requirements, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and clearly communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Prior experience in a consulting, systems integrator, or client-facing delivery role.
* Relevant cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer / Solutions Architect, AWS/Azure certifications).
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, MLOps, or LLMOps practices.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

\* Security & Connectivity: Configure BTP global accounts, subaccounts, SAP Cloud Connector, Identity Authentication Service (IAS), and OAuth 2.0 / JWT security protocols.

\* Testing & Deployment: Execute Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, performance testing, and manage Multi-Target Application (MTA) deployments across subaccounts.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience:
4 plus years experience.

e4f1a01c.title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Moveworks
e4f1a01c.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

064a40cb.title: Senior Product Manager - Cloudera Manager
064a40cb.description:
**Business Area:**

Product Mgmt.

**Seniority Level:**

Mid-Senior level

**Job Description:**

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is seeking a Senior Product Manager for the Cloudera Manager product. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for one of the key lifecycle management tools serving the largest global enterprises across all industries including finance, manufacturing, tech and federal. Cloudera Manager is responsible for the lifecycle of mission critical clusters with thousands of nodes and petabytes of data.

In this role, you will lead and execute on a strategy to ensure Cloudera Manager provides enterprise capabilities with the ease of data SaaS products from on-premises to cloud. You will grow Cloudera Manager to be a tool once used by engineers to an experience that is straight forward for any data platform manager. You will partner closely with Engineering, PMO, Product Marketing, and Field organizations to deliver a market-leading experience in hybrid cloud.

**As a Senior Product Manager you will:**

* **Drive Intelligent Product Experiences:** Shift the product strategy from infinite customization to a simplified user experience that provides optimal settings no matter the cluster configuration and active guardrails to eliminate operational fragility to prevent self-inflicted outages. Incorporate configuration recommendations, actionable health alerts, and actionable bad-configuration warnings directly into the product using AI trained on Cloudera’s knowledge base and real-time observability telemetry.
* **Simplify Accessibility for IT Generalists:** Design intuitive workflows and self-guided administrative tools tailored for IT generalists with minimal big data expertise, making documentation a secondary resource and lowering the barrier to platform management.
* **Embed Intelligence:** **Execute Hybrid Architecture Modernization:** Lead the long-term evolution of Cloudera Manager into an orchestrator of clusters across multiple clouds allowing customers to deploy use cases in a hybrid cloud topology.
* **Achieve Uninterrupted Core Operations at Scale:** Optimize fundamental cluster lifecycle operations to manage environments up to 10,000 nodes, ensuring refresh and maintenance operations on 1,000+ node clusters execute within customer approved SLAs.
* **Define Predictable Lifecycle & API Guarantees:** Establish and enforce structured release lifecycle policies that guarantee public API stability and backward compatibility to remove upgrade friction for enterprise customers.
* **Track Operational Success Metrics:** Monitor and continuously improve key performance indicators, specifically focusing on increasing operational velocity, boosting prescriptive feature adoption rates, and reducing support escalation volumes.

**We are excited if you have:**

  

* Bsc/Msc in related field or equivalent experience
* **Enterprise Platform Experience:** 5+ years of experience in the enterprise software space with at least 2 years of Product Management experience. Strong foundational understanding of open datalakes, data movement, enterprise data governance, and big data architecture.
* **On-Premise Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of virtualization, data center networking
* **Public Cloud Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of VM-based public cloud deployments (IaaS/PaaS), object storage architectures (S3, ADLS, GCS), and network architectures for at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
* **Simplification & UX Modernization:** Demonstrated success in transforming complex, developer-centric platforms into intuitive, "opinionated" products with active guardrails that eliminate manual operational friction.

**You might also have:**

* **CSP Partner Ecosystem Experience:** Direct experience working with or within major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including partner co-development, cloud marketplace programs, or cloud-native integrations.
* **Competitive Landscape Awareness:** Strong knowledge of modern cloud data platforms and competitive solutions, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery/Bigtable, Amazon EMR/Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
* **Modern Datalakehouse Formats:** Familiarity with open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) and multi-cloud data architecture strategies.
* **Data Platform Administrative Experience:** Strong background with managing enterprise platforms or supporting customers running enterprise scale deployments with over 100 Terabytes of data.

**What you can expect from us:**

* Generous PTO Policy
* Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
* Flexible WFH Policy
* Mental & Physical Wellness programs
* Phone and Internet Reimbursement program
* Access to Continued Career Development
* Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages
* Paid Volunteer Time
* Employee Resource Groups

57100c08.description:
Apply
  
  

* Role: IBMi Strategic Solution Architect
* Employment: Full Time
* Experience: 10 to 19 Years
* Salary: Not Disclosed
* Location: Jaipur

Programmers.IO is currently looking to hire
**IBMi Strategic Solution Architect**
on
**IBMi**
Technology. If you think you are a good fit and willing to work from
**Jaipur**
location.Please apply with you resume or share your resume at Nidhi.Joshi@programmers.ai
  
  
**Experience Required:**
10 to 19 Years
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced
**IBM i Strategic Solutions Architect**
based in the United States who can serve as a senior technical advisor for some of our largest and most strategic IBM i clients.
  
  
This person will work closely with client technology and business teams, spend time onsite with strategic accounts, understand their IBM i landscape and future priorities, and identify opportunities where we can provide additional value.
  
  
The role will also work closely with our offshore IBM i teams, providing architectural guidance, technical direction, and ensuring that our delivery teams remain aligned with the client's technology strategy.
  
  
This is not just an architecture or delivery role. We are looking for someone who can build strong relationships with clients, understand their technology challenges, proactively recommend solutions, and help us
**grow strategic IBM i accounts**
.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Client Engagement
  
  

* Act as a senior IBM i technical advisor and trusted partner for selected strategic accounts.
* Develop strong working relationships with client architects, technology leaders, and key stakeholders.
* Visit strategic clients approximately once per quarter and work onsite for 3-4 days.
* Understand the client's IBM i environment, applications, architecture, technical challenges, roadmap, and business priorities.
* Participate in architecture discussions, technical discovery sessions, and modernization planning.
* Proactively bring ideas and recommendations to clients instead of waiting for requirements.

IBM i Architecture & Modernization
  
  

* Assess existing IBM i application architecture and recommend improvements.
* Provide architectural guidance around application modernization, integration, APIs, DevOps, databases, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Help clients evaluate modernization opportunities while protecting their existing investment in IBM i.
* Provide technical leadership for complex IBM i initiatives and architecture decisions.
* Guide teams on modernization of legacy RPG and COBOL applications where appropriate.

Offshore Team Leadership
  
  

* Work closely with offshore architects, technical leads, developers, and delivery teams.
* Translate client strategy and onsite discussions into clear technical direction for offshore teams.
* Conduct architecture and solution reviews with the offshore team.
* Mentor senior IBM i developers and technical leads.
* Help offshore teams better understand the client's business, architecture, and long-term technology direction.
* Act as a bridge between client stakeholders and offshore engineering teams.

Technical Background
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong experience across the IBM i ecosystem, including:
  
  

* IBM i / AS400 architecture
* RPG, RPGLE, ILE RPG and Free-Format RPG
* DB2 for i / SQL
* CL / CLLE
* COBOL experience or good architectural understanding of COBOL applications
* IBM i application architecture and integration
* APIs, REST services and modern integration patterns
* IBM i modernization strategies
* DevOps and CI/CD concepts for IBM i
* Application analysis, impact analysis and dependency understanding
* Security, performance and system architecture concepts
* Integration of IBM i applications with distributed/cloud applications

Experience with modern UI, Java/.NET integration, cloud integration, AI-assisted modernization, or IBM i modernization products/tools would be an advantage.
  
  
What We Are Looking For
  
  
**Beyond Technical Expertise, The Individual Must Be**

* Strongly client-facing and comfortable interacting with senior client technology leaders.
* Able to communicate complex IBM i concepts in simple business language.
* Consultative rather than purely delivery-focused.
* Proactive in finding problems and opportunities.
* Comfortable conducting technical discovery sessions independently.
* Capable of challenging existing approaches constructively and recommending alternatives.
* Strong at working with distributed US and offshore teams.
* Comfortable mentoring architects, leads, and developers.
* Commercially aware and able to recognize account-growth opportunities without behaving like a salesperson.
* Willing and able to travel within the US regularly.

Ideal Profile
  
  
We are looking for someone who has spent significant time in the IBM i ecosystem but has also evolved beyond traditional RPG development.
  
  
The right person should be comfortable having conversations such as:
  
  

* Where is the client going with IBM i over the next 3–5 years?
* What applications should remain on IBM i?
* What should be modernized?
* Where can APIs replace tightly coupled integrations?
* Where can automation or DevOps improve delivery?
* What technical debt is creating business risk?
* Where can AI or modern development approaches improve the IBM i development lifecycle?
* What additional capabilities can our team bring to solve the client's larger technology challenges?

**Skills And Knowledge**

* IBMi

84eecb52.description:
**SAP Signavio Architect / Techno-Functional Consultant**

**Location:**
Remote

**Budget:**
₹25–35 LPA

**Notice Period:**
Immediate / 1-2 weeks

**Experience:**
10 years overall experience preferred, with at least 5 years of hands-on SAP Signavio implementation experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the implementation of SAP Signavio solutions, focusing on Business Process Management (BPM) and Process Mining.
* Utilize Process Manager, Process Insights, and Process Intelligence tools to provide actionable insights and improve business processes.
* Develop and implement BPMN 2.0 and DMN standards for process modeling and decision management.
* Conduct data integration and technical implementation using SAP BTP and SAP Integration Suite.
* Engage in ETL/ELT development, data profiling, data cleansing, and event-log transformation.
* Work with REST/SOAP APIs and JDBC/ODBC connectors to facilitate data exchange between systems.
* Design and manage RDBMS, data warehousing, and schema to support business intelligence needs.
* Integrate SAP Signavio with non-SAP platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Oracle.
* Support SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migrations by utilizing process mining insights.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Approximately 10 years of relevant professional experience, including 5-10 years in Business Process Management and Process Mining.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience with SAP Signavio implementations.
* Strong practical experience with SAP Signavio tools, including Process Manager, Process Insights, and Process Intelligence.
* Proficiency in Advanced SQL and SIGNAL query language.
* SAP Signavio certification is preferred.
* Familiarity with Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), or Record-to-Report (R2R) processes.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migrations using process mining insights.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment.

2caed302.title: Associate, L1 Support Engineer- Data platform Cloud support
2caed302.description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
WM L1 Production Support is looking for a Support Associate who can work under general supervision (but works independently), responsible for day-to-day production support for Financial Applications L1 Production Support is responsible for 24x7 production support across globe (APAC, EMEA and North America) under Northern Trust Company.
  
  
**Role**

Some night/weekends may be required from time to time. Candidate should be available Monday – Friday with individual schedules based on coverage rotation/duties.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

25273fbc.title: Global GTM & Sales Program Manager
25273fbc.description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This is a strategic programs role at the center of Global Sales HQ. You own the portfolio of sales-development programs and strategic sales initiatives that turn strategy into repeatable, measurable motions across regions — and you are the connective tissue between Sales and Product, between demand generation and closure, and between global standards and on-the-ground execution.
  
  
In a matrixed organization where regional heads own their reps and delivery, you own the standard, the operating rhythm, and the cross-functional programs that make the whole sales engine more effective. It is a builder-strategist role: you design the programs, orchestrate the launches, instrument them, and scale what works.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**SALES DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS & STRATEGIC SALES INITIATIVES**

* Own the portfolio of sales-development programs and strategic initiatives that raise the productivity and consistency of the global sales organization, from skills and plays to new sales motions.
* Translate the annual sales strategy into a sequenced program roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and success metrics.
* Stand up initiatives as time-boxed programs with scale / iterate / kill decision gates, plus the governance rhythm — interlocks, exception desks, QBR cadences — that keeps regions on one standard.

**SALES – PRODUCT INTERLOCK**

* Own the operating interlock between Sales and Product: a structured, two-way loop that turns field signal into roadmap input and turns roadmap into sales readiness.
* Represent the voice of the field in prioritization, packaging, and pricing discussions, and carry product context back into the field.
* Ensure every material product change lands with the sales org through readiness, positioning, and enablement — nothing ships to market unsold internally.

**CAMPAIGNS — DEMAND & CLOSURE ALIGNMENT**

* Orchestrate integrated GTM campaigns that align top-of-funnel demand generation with the sales closure motion, so demand converts to pipeline and pipeline to revenue.
* Partner with Marketing and RevOps to define targeting, messaging, and the handoff and follow-up SLAs that connect demand to closure.
* Instrument campaigns end to end (demand → qualified pipeline → closed revenue) and drive continuous, data-led improvement.

**NEW PRODUCT INTRODUCTION (NPI) INTO MARKETS**

* Own the sales side of new-product introductions: the launch playbook, market-readiness criteria, and sequencing for introducing products into markets, countries, and corridors.
* Coordinate the cross-functional launch (Product, Marketing, Enablement, regional sales) so each introduction has clear ownership, ramp targets, and measurement.
* Define go / no-go gates and post-launch review so the organization scales winners and retires what doesn't land.

**COUNTRY & CORRIDOR SALES STRATEGY**

* Define where-to-play / how-to-win by country and corridor — grounded in market, revenue, and account data.
* Build and maintain the market and corridor tiering and prioritization that focuses sales investment on the highest-value opportunities.
* Partner with regional Sales heads to translate corridor strategy into coverage, targeting, and sequenced motions on the ground.

**What Success Looks Like — First 6–12 Months**

* A published, sequenced program roadmap tied to the sales strategy, with governance live and adopted across regions.
* A functioning Sales–Product interlock running on a regular cadence, with measurable roadmap and readiness outcomes.
* Integrated demand-to-closure campaigns live, with clean end-to-end metrics leadership uses to steer.
* A repeatable NPI launch model and an active country / corridor sales strategy directing prioritized investment.

**Required**
**What You Bring**

* 8+ years in GTM strategy, sales programs, sales enablement / excellence, or strategic sales initiatives, including running cross-functional programs at scale.
* Proven experience owning a Sales–Product interlock or equivalent alignment between the field and the product roadmap.
* A track record designing and launching go-to-market campaigns that connect demand generation to sales closure.
* Experience leading new-product introductions and / or market and corridor launch strategy.
* Strong analytical foundation — comfortable in the data, building market / corridor prioritization, and instrumenting funnels end to end.
* A record of operating in a matrixed, multi-region organization and driving alignment without direct authority; excellent executive communication.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on fluency with the modern sales stack — Salesforce, Gong, BI / SQL (BigQuery a plus), and campaign tooling.
* Familiarity with corridor-based, multi-currency GTM and with SMB / marketplace / platform segments.
* Experience standing up governance rhythms — interlocks, QBRs, and forecast operating models — across regions.

**Fintech / Payments Experience Strongly Preferred**

* Background in fintech, payments, or cross-border B2B financial services.
* Understanding of how compliance, trust, long sales cycles, and multi-stakeholder buying committees shape GTM in regulated financial services.
* Comfort translating product complexity (multi-currency, FX, working capital, stablecoin rails) into simple, sellable, market-ready motions.

**Who You'll Work With**
Product, Marketing, RevOps, regional sales heads (EMEA, APAC, LATAM), Sales Enablement & Excellence, Customer Retention & Expansion, and Strategic Accounts. You'll be a core member of the Global Sales HQ leadership team, reporting to the VP of Global Sales.
  
  
**Why Join**
You'll own the programs and cross-functional interlocks that a global sales organization runs on — the layer where strategy, product, demand, and execution meet. You'll build, not just maintain, in a company at the frontier of cross-border payments, with the data, tooling, and executive support to make GTM measurably better across three regions.
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

7eefb99e.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
7eefb99e.description:
Enterprise Bot is the leading provider of GenAI, Conversational AI, and automation software, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland. Our intelligent virtual assistants and automation tools help organizations improve efficiency, reduce costs, and deliver exceptional customer experiences across industries such as banking, insurance, and logistics. Our mission is to become the world’s #1 AI-driven automation software provider within the next five years.

We work with leading companies such as the SIX Group (Swiss Stock Exchange), SWICA, Generali, and others to enhance customer interactions and automate business processes using our cutting-edge Conversational AI technology.

Our global team includes more than 70 highly skilled professionals from diverse backgrounds.

We foster an open, progressive company culture with state-of-the-art technology and flat hierarchies. At Enterprise Bot, you’ll experience a unique blend of passion, purpose, challenge, and fun.

We’re growing rapidly across Europe and looking for a **Senior Solutions Engineer** who combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help our customers succeed.

**Tasks**
---------

As a **Senior Solutions Engineer**, you’ll act as the technical backbone of our sales and customer engagement process. You’ll collaborate with Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to design, present, and deliver impactful automation solutions. This role blends hands-on technical work with strategic engagement — ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology, business value, and customer experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pre-Sales & Technical Enablement**

* Partner with the Sales team to understand customer requirements and design tailored AI automation solutions using Enterprise Bot’s platform.
* Deliver compelling product demos, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and presentations that clearly communicate technical and business value.
* Lead technical discovery sessions and develop architecture proposals and integration plans.

**Solution Design & Delivery**

* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams during pilots and implementations to ensure seamless technical delivery.
* Provide technical validation and support during critical phases of the sales cycle.

**Customer Engagement & Partnership**

* Build trusted relationships with customers by acting as a technical advisor throughout the engagement.
* Ensure customer success by proactively identifying risks and helping resolve technical challenges.
* Be available to support key customer engagements or escalations when necessary.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to align roadmap priorities with customer feedback.
* Contribute to technical enablement materials, training sessions, and playbooks to strengthen overall sales effectiveness.
* Advocate for customer needs within the organization and help improve solution delivery processes.

**Thought Leadership & Market Engagement**

* Represent Enterprise Bot at industry events, webinars, and conferences.
* Stay up to date on AI automation trends, cloud technologies, and emerging best practices in the B2B SaaS landscape.
* Contribute to positioning Enterprise Bot as a trusted technology partner and thought leader in intelligent automation.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 5+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Solutions Engineering, or similar roles, with at least 2 years at a senior level.
* Proven track record in B2B SaaS or AI-automation environments (experience with conversational AI, RPA, or cloud-based automation is a strong plus).
* Experience with voice technologies such as ACD and IVR workflows is a must.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong English communication skills and the ability to engage effectively across technical and business stakeholders. Proficiency in French and Spanish is an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, cloud infrastructure, APIs, etc.).
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform under pressure in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with CRM or presales tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, and related certifications.
* Understanding of NLP, automation workflows, or integration frameworks (e.g., REST, GraphQL).
* Experience in enterprise-scale solution delivery and customer success collaboration.

**Benefits**
------------

* Be part of a rapidly growing company at the forefront of AI automation and conversational AI solutions used by leading global enterprises.
* Shape solutions that make a measurable impact for Fortune 500 clients and leading European enterprises.
* A culture comprised of diverse, global teams who have a passion for collaboration, creativity, and excellence in client service
* A competitive salary and scope for further advancement.
* A great environment that promotes open feedback and a flat hierarchy, working at Enterprise Bot is a refreshing mix of purpose, challenge, and fun.

0052c1c0.title: ServiceNow Architect
0052c1c0.description:
**About the Role:**

We are building a ServiceNow platform practice and its flagship solution

As Architect, you will own the technical design of this offering end-to-end and set the architectural standards for the

broader ServiceNow practice as we scale delivery.

**What You will do :**

• Own solution architecture across ITSM, ITOM (Event Management, Discovery, CMDB), and Integration Hub for

the AuditIQ platform and future offerings

• Design the integration architecture connecting log/monitoring sources (application logs, infra telemetry) into

ServiceNow via REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, and Integration Hub spokes

• Define the pattern-matching and incident-correlation design — how known error signatures, anomaly detection,

and duplicate-incident checks translate into ServiceNow workflows and data models

• Establish CMDB and data model standards to support incident-to-CI linkage and historical incident referencing

(root cause, resolution)

• Lead technical design reviews, environment/instance strategy, security architecture, and performance/scalability

planning

• Define coding standards, integration patterns, and reusable components for the delivery team to build against

• Act as the technical anchor in client/pre-sales conversations — solutioning, effort estimation, and technical

proposals

• Mentor Lead Developers and Developers; run architecture governance and code/design reviews

• Stay current on ServiceNow releases (AI capabilities, Predictive Intelligence, Now Assist) and evaluate fit for the

**AuditIQ roadmap:**

• Proven ServiceNow architecture experience across at least 2 of: ITSM, ITOM, Event Management, Integration

Hub, CMDB/Discovery

• Strong grasp of ServiceNow scripting (Glide API, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, Scripted REST

APIs)

• Experience designing integrations with external monitoring/log tools (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, ELK,

Datadog)

• Solid understanding of CMDB data modeling and the Common Service Data Model (CSDM)

• Experience with ServiceNow's AI/ML capabilities — Predictive Intelligence, Performance Analytics, or Now Assist

— is a strong plus

• Track record of solutioning and presenting to client/leadership stakeholders

**Good to Have:**

Join Digital Engineering Team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity, Health, Government, Power and Utilities, we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. 3730d4dd.title: Senior ServiceNow Solution Architect - ITOM & CSDM
3730d4dd.description:
Pragma Technologies is an innovative IT company specializing in consulting and technology services across the German-speaking region (DACH). With a team of around 50 dedicated professionals, we deliver modern digital solutions and help organizations transform their processes, platforms, and technology landscapes. We are headquartered in Hamburg, Germany and Lucerne, Switzerland.

We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Solution Architect with a strong development background and deep expertise in ITOM, CMDB, CSDM, and NowAssist to join our growing offshore delivery team based in India.

**Tasks**
---------

As a ServiceNow Solution Architect, you will be a key technical driver in our offshore team. You will design, develop, and deliver robust ServiceNow solutions for enterprise clients across the DACH region — working independently and collaboratively with our onshore consultants in Germany and Switzerland. You will be responsible for both architectural decisions and hands-on development. Design and develop complex ServiceNow solutions with a focus on ITOM, CMDB, and CSDM 5.0 alignment.

**Project Leadership & Autonomy**

* Take full ownership of ServiceNow workstreams - plan, prioritize, and drive delivery independently with minimal supervision
* Lead projects end-to-end: from initial scoping and solution design through to go-live and handover
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for assigned clients, managing expectations and communicating progress proactively
* Coordinate with developers, consultants, and client teams to ensure on-time, on-quality delivery
* Identify risks early, propose mitigation strategies, and escalate when necessary

**Presentations & Client Communication**

* Prepare and deliver structured presentations to senior client stakeholders — including architecture overviews, sprint reviews, and solution demonstrations
* Present complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Create high-quality documentation and deliverables: solution designs, architecture diagrams, and implementation reports
* Represent Pragma Technologies professionally in client-facing situations — written and spoken English required at all times

**Presales Activities**

* Support presales processes by contributing technical input to proposals, RFP responses, and solution concepts
* Conduct discovery calls and technical assessment sessions with prospective clients
* Estimate effort, define scope, and propose solution approaches for new opportunities
* Develop reusable presales assets such as solution templates, demo environments, and capability decks

**Process Workshops**

* Plan and facilitate process workshops with client stakeholders to capture requirements and define target architectures
* Lead CMDB scoping workshops: define CI classes, discovery scope, data ownership, and governance rules
* Run CSDM alignment workshops to map business services, technical services, and application portfolios
* Document workshop outcomes as structured decision logs, process flows, and solution blueprints
* Drive stakeholder alignment across IT, business, and management levels during workshops

**Technical Delivery**

* Design and develop complex ServiceNow solutions with a focus on ITOM, CMDB, and CSDM 5.0 alignment
* Lead and execute Discovery configurations and troubleshooting (patterns, MID Server, credentials, probes/sensors)
* Architect and maintain a healthy, well-structured CMDB including IRE, normalization, deduplication, and CMDB Health dashboards
* Implement and govern CSDM 5.0 data models — mapping Business Services, Technical Services, Application Services, and supporting CIs
* Configure and extend NowAssist (AI features) including Now Intelligence, Predictive Intelligence, and Virtual Agent flows
* Develop advanced platform customizations: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Flow Designer, and REST/SOAP integrations
* Perform code reviews and enforce ServiceNow development best practices — minimizing unnecessary customizations
* Document solution designs, architecture decisions, and implementation guides

**Requirements**
----------------

**Certifications**

* Certified System Administrator (CSA) – mandatory
* Certified Application Developer (CAD) – mandatory
* CIS-ITSM – mandatory
* CIS-Discovery – mandatory
* CIS-DF (CMDB & CSDM) – scheduled/mandatory or demonstrable equivalent expertise
* Additional certifications (CIS-Service Mapping, ITIL) are a strong plus

**Technical Expertise**

* Expert-level scripting (JavaScript/GlideScript), Flow Designer, REST APIs, Integration Hub, App Engine ServiceNow Development
* Hands-on experience with Discovery (patterns, schedules, MID Server, credentials), Service Mapping, Event Management, and Operational Intelligence ITOM
* Deep knowledge of CMDB architecture, IRE (Identification & Reconciliation Engine), CMDB Data Manager, Service Graph Connectors, deduplication strategies, and CMDB 360
* Strong familiarity with CSDM 5.0 framework — Business Applications, Technical Services, Application Services, Hosted On relationships, and lifecycle management
* Practical experience configuring NowAssist, Predictive Intelligence, or Virtual Agent — AI-powered workflows and case deflection use cases NowAssist / AI
* Experience with REST/SOAP integrations, Integration Hub spokes, and third-party connectors Integration
* CMDB Health configuration, ATF (Automated Testing Framework), and instance performance best practices Performance & Health

**Language Requirements**

* English: Fluent (written and spoken) - required for daily client and team communication
* Hindi: Fluent - required for internal team collaboration

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) modules
* Experience with DACH-region enterprise clients or German-speaking stakeholders
* Experience in a subcontracting or offshore delivery model

**Soft Skills We Value**

* Highly self-driven and autonomous - you take ownership of your work and deliver without being micromanaged
* Natural leader - comfortable running workshops, steering project meetings, and keeping teams aligned
* Confident presenter - you can hold a room and explain technical solutions to executives and IT teams alike
* Strong analytical thinker - you systematically diagnose complex issues and communicate findings clearly
* Reliable communicator across time zones - proactive status updates, clean documentation, no surprises
* Culturally adaptable - experienced in working with European enterprise clients and DACH business culture
* Continuous learner - you stay current with ServiceNow releases and proactively develop new competencies

b8a8e594.title: VP, Solutions Architect
b8a8e594.description:
**Description**
VP, Solutions Architect
  
  
**Full Location:**
remote - IN
  
  
The VP, Solutions Architect is a pivotal role for the assigned product specialty area vertical growth agenda and provide Clients with compelling Digital Solutions. The VP, Solutions Architect is responsible for identifying, quantifying and delivering transformational change across the assigned product specialty opportunities. This role will work closely with prospect/client (“client”) and ResultsCX (RCX) stakeholders, as well as RCX internal partners, to drive an innovation agenda to meet the client’s strategic goals. This role will initially concentrate on Customer Experience and the transformational changes will enhance that experience to bring about a closer relationship between client and its customers. It will also focus on delivering the best business insight to client, which will form the basis of new consumer and process strategies. In this role, it will be important to foster close working relationships between local client stakeholders and vertical leadership in order to continuously drive business value for both client and RCX. The role should additionally support the Transformation Roadmap for Large Multi-Tower Deals, in new Geos or with new Service Offerings.
  
  
We expect greater of ourselves... What’s Your Greater? Come find it at ResultsCX!
  
  
**In This Role You Will**
Establish partnerships to work collaboratively with internal and external constituencies to drive a cohesive solution.
  
  
Drive the process with a sense of urgency, but always being mindful of delivering a quality driven solution that include:
  
  

* Timely responses to proposals, and contractual obligations.
* Development and delivery of client presentations and solutions.
* Orchestration of proof-of-concept work.
* Preparation of cost estimates.
* Coordination of additional supporting functional and technical resources as required.

**Identify Solutioning Opportunities By**

* Conducting comprehensive process, functional, and technological discovery
* Capturing pain points, as well as business and technical requirements – “as is” and “to be” scenarios

Obtain comprehensive understanding of client’s current infrastructure to best:
  
  

* Synchronize RCX solutions with client needs.
* Identify client challenges and recommend implementation options.
* Assess risks and implications due to regulatory challenges that are impacting the client.
* Architect customer solutions using innovative and cutting-edge solutions.
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Has**

* A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in area of Business, Management, Marketing, Finance or other closely degree. Equivalent experience may be substituted for education.
* A minimum of 16 years of progressive leadership experience in roles demonstrating growth, creative and operational excellence; demonstrable success in defining and driving comprehensive programs to transform customer experience and delivering concrete business value.
* Strong background and executional experience in industry area experience transformation technology/platform domain areas as it relates to back office (F&A, Supply Chain, etc.) and/or customer facing areas, with solid (top tier or boutique) consulting company experience preferred. Digital agency experience also relevant.
* A deep domain expertise in the core vertical for which they are being hired.
* A demonstrated ability to drive sales origination in a prior role.
* Cross-industry experience required; Must have breadth across multiple verticals and understand how to apply those earnings across.
* Experience in a leadership role focused on identifying experience transformation, marketing, and content opportunities.
* Experience with large, complex customer experience transformation programs that deliver demonstrative business value, data driven insight, improved operational efficiencies, and new forms of customer engagement.

**Preferred Education And Experience**

* Experience at ResultsCX or BPO industry.
* Strong credentials in foundational areas that directly touch the customer; “Interactive agency” experience a plus.
* Master’s Degree a plus.

**About ResultsCX**
ResultsCX is a premier customer experience partner to Fortune 100 and 500 companies. We design, build, and deliver digitally influenced customer journeys that achieve the satisfaction and loyalty brands need to thrive and grow, while improving efficiency and reducing costs. ResultsCX’s 30+-year track record for reimagining the customer experience to meet consumers’ evolving expectations has driven growth to more than 20 geographic hubs and approximately 20,000 colleagues worldwide. Our core expertise extends to actionable analytics, contact center as a service (CCaaS), and our own SupportPredict AI-powered digital experience platform. Our strength lies in exceptional individuals working together in a high-performing, fun culture to deliver next-generation customer experiences on behalf of our clients.
  
  
Results-CX is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factors under federal, state, or local law.
