16961825.title: AI Architect
16961825.description:
**Role Summary**

The AI Architect is responsible for designing end-to-end AI/ML and GenAI solution architectures that translate business requirements into scalable, production-grade systems. This role bridges technical strategy and delivery, working closely with AI/ML Engineers, GenAI Engineers, and client stakeholders to ensure solutions are robust, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and own end-to-end architecture for AI/ML and GenAI solutions, including data pipelines, model serving, orchestration, and integration layers
* Evaluate and select appropriate frameworks, cloud services, and toolchains (e.g., Azure AI, AWS, GCP, LLM providers, vector databases)
* Define architecture patterns for RAG systems, agentic workflows, MLOps/LLMOps pipelines, and model governance
* Partner with client stakeholders and internal delivery teams to translate business problems into technical solution designs
* Establish best practices for scalability, security, cost optimization, and responsible AI/model risk management
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide technical guidance to engineering teams during implementation
* Create solution blueprints, reference architectures, and technical documentation for proposals and delivery
* Stay current with emerging AI/ML technologies and assess their applicability to client and internal use cases
* Support pre-sales activities including solutioning, effort estimation, and technical proposal development

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* 8+ years in software/data architecture, with 3+ years focused on AI/ML or GenAI solution design
* Strong hands-on background in ML system design, cloud architecture (Azure/AWS/GCP), and MLOps practices
* Experience architecting LLM-based applications (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, prompt orchestration)
* Familiarity with data engineering, APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration patterns
* Strong communication skills for client-facing architecture discussions

**Preferred**

* Relevant cloud/AI certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer/Solutions Architect)
* Experience in a consulting or professional services environment
* Exposure to model governance, responsible AI frameworks, and cost/performance optimization at scale

3563ca69.title: Software Architect
3563ca69.description:
**Be the technical backbone of products that real people depend on.**
Techdome is a profitable, product-focused engineering company with 80+ engineers building across healthcare, fintech, AI, and SaaS. We’re looking for a Software Architect who treats production as the final exam: someone who designs it, ships it, and stays accountable for how it holds up under real traffic.
  
  
**The Role**
As our Software Architect, you’ll set the technical direction for systems that handle sensitive health records and money movement for large user bases. This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll make the big calls, write code, and raise the bar for everyone around you.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Architecture, end to end: system design, APIs, data models, security, scalability, observability, and cloud cost.
* Reliability at scale: uptime, latency, and performance for products serving large user bases.
* Security-critical design: safe handling of PHI and payment workflows, with compliance built in from the start.
* Cloud-native delivery: MERN applications on AWS, GCP, or Azure, using Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and secrets management.
* Key technical decisions: microservices vs. monolith, event-driven patterns, third-party integrations, and build-vs-buy.
* Production firefighting: diagnosing and fixing bottlenecks in performance, scalability, and availability.
* Engineering standards: reference architectures, reusable patterns, and clear guidelines the whole team can follow.
* Hands-on contribution: regular coding, design reviews, and code reviews.
* People growth: mentoring senior engineers and developing the next generation of technical leaders.

**What You Bring (Must-Haves)**

* 8+ years in software engineering, with a clear record of owning architecture.
* Experience running a production system with 100,000+ users (mandatory).
* Proven history of finding and fixing major bottlenecks at scale.
* Strong hands-on Node.js and React; MERN experience preferred.
* Solid cloud architecture experience on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Background in healthcare, fintech, payments, insurance, or another security-critical domain.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, API design, databases, and reliability engineering.
* The ability to explain and defend technical decisions clearly to engineers and stakeholders.

**Bonus Points**

* Hands-on HIPAA, PHI, or PCI-DSS compliance experience.
* Familiarity with Stripe, Braintree, or tokenization.
* Experience with high-availability, event-driven, or microservices systems.
* Exposure to SaaS, consulting, or venture-studio environments.
* Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot.

**Why You’ll Like It Here**

* Ship products used by customers worldwide.
* Your architecture decisions go straight to production, with real impact.
* Define engineering standards for an 80+ person team.
* Work at a profitable, stable company with minimal bureaucracy.

a4cd2bd4.title: Architect
a4cd2bd4.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Join us as an Architect in Gurugram, Haryana, India. Full-Time, On-Site, joining within 30 days. You will take large scale museum exhibition theme park and cultural projects from client brief and feasibility through design documentation and execution.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Analyze and interpret client briefs to prepare detailed feasibility studies, concept designs, schematic proposals, and 3D massing studies.
2. Develop comprehensive architectural plans, elevations, sections, layouts, working drawings, detailed BOQs, technical specifications, and construction documentation using industry-standard CAD workflows.
3. Lead design development from initial concept through detailed design, value engineering, and preparation of tender-ready drawings with material schedules and finish specifications.
4. Coordinate closely with MEP, structural, interior, landscape, AV, technology, lighting, and specialist consultants to integrate multidisciplinary inputs into cohesive BIM and CAD models.
5. Conduct regular site inspections, supervise execution, resolve on-site design conflicts, and issue revised drawings and RFIs as required.
6. Ensure strict compliance with NBC, local building codes, heritage regulations, fire safety norms, accessibility standards, and sustainability guidelines.
7. Liaise with external consultants, vendors, contractors, and government authorities to ensure timely approvals, smooth project delivery, and quality control throughout the project lifecycle.

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

1. B.Arch degree from a recognized institution.
2. 4 to 7 years of relevant architectural experience.
3. Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, and other advanced CAD and 3D modeling tools.
4. Hands-on experience in end-to-end architectural design, detailed working drawings, accurate BOQ preparation, specifications, and construction documentation for large-scale institutional and cultural projects.
5. In-depth understanding of construction methodologies, material science, structural systems, building services integration, and statutory building regulations.
6. Excellent coordination, technical communication, problem-solving, and project management skills with proven ability to manage complex stakeholder interfaces.
7. Willingness to travel extensively for site visits, client meetings, and project monitoring as required.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Up to 7 LPA based on role fit, experience, skills, interview performance, and current compensation structure. You will work on prestigious national projects with a certified leader in experiential technology. The role offers opportunities to innovate in museums exhibitions and cultural spaces while collaborating with government and private clients across India.
